text: Let me start by saying that if you want to "build your own garden" its just not going to happen anymore. Used to allow you to pick a lot of customization for the items but not anymore. Its frustrating as the stars take a while to gather only for me to not be able to pick my own decor. The game just picks for you, especially in the later areas. Don't even get me started on how I have to click out of 5 popups at a time to even start playing. Its lost all its charm and it keeps pushing you to spend

Used to really love this game. Progression is almost impossible even when you're spending money. It's impossible to finish the events. You can try and do a level 50 times and still not pass it. I used to be able to get through a fair few levels at once especially with boosters/timed booster rewards. They make absolutely no difference now. If you're not willing to spend money you'll be stuck on a level for weeks and weeks. I've played for years, spent a lot of money. You've ruined it.

edit: as of 29.06.26, there has been issue after issue. firstly, our chats stop, that's ok, It's a UK thing. Now we can't play without our data being on and still says not conneced if we do have it on! it use to be a lovely game. not anymore. Great. But the 900 coins for an extra 5 moves is a bit silly. Winning coins at the end of a level is less like 50-65 coins.... then taking 900 coins for an extra 5 moves is a bit harsh.

This is an amazing game that has sadly been ruined by the nonstop nerfing of rewards and power ups. I assume this is to drive up purchases. In the past I happily bought things, but my whole team is about to quit now that they've made it impossible to progress without paying. it's a shame, as this game has been something I've enjoyed for a long time.

I loved this game. I've been playing it for years and I'm increasingly disappointed. The Golden Ticket used to cost £4.99 a month, now it's almost £9. Completing a level gave you 50 coins; now it's 10. All the boosters have been reduced. Even their timers work differently. Half an hour of unlimited lives combined with a half-hour booster like Rainbow Blast, and guess what? A half-hour Rainbow Blast ends 10 minutes faster than a half-hour of unlimited lives. Interesting, huh? Feed up with this.

Game used to be good... not anymore I've reached over 3000 levels & every other level is either hard or super hard & impossible to pass without several power ups. The coins you get for passing a level is hardly anything so unless you want to spend actual money you won't get anywhere. I don't want to spend days on one level & I won't spend actual money.

I am part of a team but there is a lot of pressure to keep up. Our latest team challenge requires the team to beat 2050 levels in 3 days. That's 68 levels each in 3 days!!!!!!!! Also when there are challenges up for grabs it suddenly becomes much harder to beat levels....almost to the point of an easy level taking 40+ plays to complete and there is always JUST ONE MORE MOVE TO WIN when your game ends...like its rigged to make you buy more and more. impossible to play without spending money

I've had this app for over 7 years and love it, although the latest card challenge has really frustrated me. Last weekend I had 146 cards, and I've opened about 100 cards since by completing all the challenges and I've only received one. What's the point?? I know the game is supposed to keep you coming back for more, but this has really taken the mick. I might consider unistalling.

This used to be such a great game, but each time I come back after a couple months away it's gotten worse. Decorations are non existent, mini games are non existent, expeditions got a HUGE downgrade in terms of quality, collectibles, routes etc, as everyone has said the cards thing sucks, it's just nowhere close to what it once was

I've been playing this game since 2017. it's been my go to clear my head game. but must say recent changes in updates start putting me off. why changing boosters from Garden glove and Rake to Darts and Kettle bell? no only that it's not garden related, but also the functionality of these updated boosters is rubbish. The Story games and Cards are boring and repetitive. and never achievable unless money spent. There used to be other side games that were more fun. Long time user thinking of leaving

would not recommend unless you want to spend all your hard earned money on this app. once you reach a certain point it will never let you pass a level unless you spend money. been stuck on the same level for hours unless I spend money to buy coins to continue or buy power ups to help finish the level. either way you have to spend money to win and I refuse so I'll never progress any further than where I am so eventually I'll have to Uninstall it because I'm stuck.

Completely pay to win. Once you get to a certain level stage - it's impossible to complete levels without additional power ups or tools that you have to pay for. I've been stuck on levels for months before - it makes the game unenjoyable. I recently downloaded after having not played for a year or so, now deleting three days later. dont have the energy to be getting frustrated with a game thats meant to be fun

Downgraded from 5 stars to 1. I've been playing this game from its launch, 8 years ago. Just as I was thinking their unannounced changes couldn't get any worse, they did. You now only receive 10 coins (plus a few more if you have any moves or boosters left) to complete a level - down from 50! For those who have never played, to buy just 5 extra moves to complete a level costs 900 coins! It was already extremely difficult. Playrix, you are losing many long-term players. I guess you don't care

Interesting puzzles, but that's it. The game is all about microtransactions. When you reach certain level, it becomes a struggle to move on, because some levels are purposely designed to be unbeatable without powerups and extra moves. Now, I know developers need to earn their share and I actually paid a few times for some goodies, but it feels like they go out so quickly, it's like you need to buy them again every second day, and they are not cheap.

Fun, until it's impossible to beat levels without spending coins. I also play Homescapes, and the best part about that game vs. this game, is when there's a level that is impossibly hard, and you keep trying to beat the level over and over, eventually the level gets easier to help you beat it. Gardenscapes does NOT do this. I have played the same level over 20 times, using all the power ups, and only spending coins on several life refills, and still can't beat the levels. Not fun.

Great game with no ads. However, it is designed to be addictive and leads to levels where you will have to spend money to beat it! Addicting because there are easy bonuses which leads to hours of free play, which is phsycologically manipulative and dangerous. Beginning in level 233, there is a requirement to collect butterfly pieces. The problem is that they give you less pieces and not enough chances to get them. I deleted then . 14 turns but they do not give you 14 pieces in those turns

Been playing this since 2020 . However this new map with no collections is a waste of time, like the terrible merging thing, it's time consuming for little reward. Also please bring back the one hour half energy usage every day. It was a bonus. I think challenge levels should be optional. Working hard for super rainbow then losing it on a challenge you probably won't pass is soul destroying. Needs tweaking slightly but please listen to your players!

I think it's going to take many more bad ratings before they change this game back for the better. Like many others, I'm just sick of all the negative changes. The coin rewards are ridiculous, among many others. It's always "our games are winnable". Well playing days on one level isn't fun. So your reply about this is just stupid. Anyway. 2 stars. I've had it.

All the latest and new changes RUINED this game. I have been playing this game for YEARS and spent A LOT OF MONEY to support the game. Now, not only the payout gone to nothing when you win a level (it was so much higher when I started. For example, when you win an easy level, you use to get 75 to 80+coins. That number went down to half, and now it's 10 or so. They also changed one of the powerups, which was dynamite with rainbow blast to just dynamite. I'm way cutting back playing this game.

Update (June 2026). these devs are getting more and more greedy. I've been playing for nearly 10 years and at the verge of uninstalling. I echo what all other 1 star reviews are saying. Update (Aug 2024): festival ticket was just $4 and the latest is $13. That's an insane increase. I will not be making anymore purchases. Used to love this game. I just noticed that the prices for the coin packs have increased. I will not be making any more purchases for this game. Very sneaky and greedy.

Starts off addictively, but the greedy programmers make it so that you cannot progress after a certain point without paying, which comes very soon. The "candy crush" part takes up most of the game, and it makes it impossible for you to progress, unless you pay, of course. Pity, could have been a good game. Uninstalled.

Edit: Based off latest reviews, I've gifted the property to Austin and the town and am uninstalling this App. Ad watching simulator. Ads appear even when you have option to decline for a bonus, so screwed either way. Excruciatingly slow progression. Cute Storyline, but the amount of 30 second Ads is torture and the puzzles are setup to profit on them at the expense of pleasure.

Imagine being stuck at 1 level for 5 days unless you pay. That's what the game is all about. Pay to win, or lose all your combos, coins, and everything you earned. You will anyway. It was bad a few years ago with a wicked algorithm, now they implemented unbeatable AI that will ruin all you strategies and combos forcing you to lose or pay! I paid a couple of time but it's never enough for the devs. They implemented the AI to never back off on forcing a payment. Uninstalling.

Well, I have uninstalled for the last time. I love the game buuuuut a game is suppose to be fun and not stressfull and frustrating! I can not play for more than a few minutes and either the game freezes, crashes or screen is blotchy. I have to log out and back in numerous times in minutes, that is frustrating and stressfull! THAT IS NOT FUN.

This game is no longer fun. As you go up levels, you feel pressured to buy power ups. Even the $.99 pack gets expensive after a while. It's so ridiculous! The new power ups are so lame too. There's a difference between challenging games and ones that make you stressed. They use addictive tactics to keep playing. I am close to uninstalling the game, even though I spent money throughout the time.

After 19,000+ levels, I'm giving up playing. This game has steadily gotten worse. From gameplay that requires boosters to win a level, to "easy" levels that are anything but, to erosion of boosters, - the latest being a reduction of starter boosters - the devs have enshittified what was a once fun game. It's now boring, frustrating, and unrewarding. I don't plan to return to gameplay and I definitely do not recommend this game at this point. Save your time and your money.

I really enjoyed this game for years, but recently the changes to game have made me decide to stop playing. Every incentive in the game has been reduced, and it most definitely has become pay to play. I don't mind spending money on a game, but no more with this one. Giving certain players added bonuses and excluding others is ridiculous. Don't even get me started on the STUPID side games or the impossible scavenger hunt, HATE THE CHANGES!! DO BETTER PLAYRIX!!

Game is good, I find it fun at first but most of the time, the levels are too hard to win, and it's quite depressing to be stuck on one level after trying several times. Without coins and boosters, you will be stuck in hard, super hard and challenging levels. Maybe more opportunities to get free coins can help. And give more chances of winning than losing the levels to make it a fun and not depressing game at times.

Quite good. This is the only game I've always come back to. I've had it for years now and still play it. *update in 2026. Recent changes to gameplay (complete revamp of game) are terrible. The power-ups, the texture, and the animations. All the extras, (bird hatching, cards, etc) are annoying, but most of all I hate having Austin face in the corner, emoting. Yuck! I will probably delete the game since all the changes have me avoiding the game instead of playing. Sad to go.

This game is really nice, but the levels are way too hard. You are given only a few moves, yet you need to finish so many objectives just to clear the stage. I’ve been playing for years and I play fairly no cheating at all. But it’s disappointing that I often have to spend a lot of money just to pass a single level. I hope the developers will listen: please make the levels more reasonable. Don’t make it too difficult for loyal, honest players like me. It feels unfair and exhausting.

I agree with many of the other players...some levels are too hard to get through! Not enough coins as I will never spend money on here! update Jun 2026: the administrators have taken away so many items in this game in the last few weeks. I am ready to delete. I have been playing this game for over 10 years. Only get a single bomb now, no blaster with the med dynamite. The adventure zone is boring. Only collect nuts and bolts. Out of hits after 3. This will be an all paid game next update I bet

I've played this game for years and the past few months the makers of the game have done anything they can to make money. They have reduced bonuses, power-ups, and when you fail to pass the level they intentionally place buttons and time them so that you accidentally push on them to spend your coins without intending to. And now the every other level is so difficult to pass that you spend days stuck, because they hope you get frustrated enough to just spend your money.

Game starts out fun then quickly becomes much less enjoyable. Once you hit level 100 about every second to every fourth level is either hard, super hard or one shot. You run out of the boosters to help you very quickly and they're very slow to replenish. It's very aggravating. I honestly don't know how much longer I'm going to put up with this before I uninstall the game and I'm definitely not spending real money on it. Having a hard level every once in a while is okay but this is ridiculous.

I echo the comments from other long time players, the bonus structure and coins awarded from each level have decreased so notably over time, it makes game play less fun and it makes it harder to advance levels (which is what they want of course, to make $ when you have to buy moves or bonus items to beat levels). There used to be 2 bombs and the dynamite sticks used to come with a one of those things that looks like a CD. I'm just going to stop playing, it's not worth it any more.

Used to be a fun relaxing game, but it's become too overwhelming. So many events and in-game games, the screen is filled with buttons and popups are endless... The interface lags until all the animations are finished. What killed it for me is having to see a character face with exaggerated emotions during the actual 3 in a row play experience, I'm not sure it's such a problem for anyone else but I just can't stand it. But I played for free and didn't find it that impossible as others write.

I've played this game for years and have loved it UNTIL THIS LATEST UPDATE! It's ridiculous. They reduced the power ups, reduced rewards for completing tasks, made everything harder to complete, treasure hunts are harder and take an absurd amount of energy, and made it harder to pass levels. All in an effort to make you spend literal money to be able to progress in the game. So frustrating and disappointing.

ok I like this game a lot, and it is it's actually what they say it is! However, I HATE how there is usually a EXTREMELY hard level that is SUPER HARD TO BEAT and after a few tries, you run out of life's and won't get more until 25 min later! what the heck?! Their other game, Township is WAY better, with easier levels and more customization for your buildings

I have been playing this game for over 10 years , I would normally give it a 5 star review , BUT for the last week when I open the game and start playing all of a sudden with no warning it just shuts down ,which has made me lose rewards and progress!! very very frustrating and basically makes the game unplayable!!!! VERY DISAPPOINTING😞

Changing my review from a 5 to a 1. Haf so much fun playing this game for YEARS, but the recent updates and changes SUCK. They made the power ups weaker!! So instead the offered 2 boms or the bomb and dynamite combos you could've chosen from ahead of the game, now you can only get one bomb or a single dynamite. During the game there use to be a hand that you could use, they took that away as well, so all the power ups that could've helped pass levels are now gone. Tsk tsk tsk

The latest updates make this a '1-star' game. The developers decided to make significant in-game shifts that clearly made powerups/tools significantly worse and levels increasingly harder. The only logical reason is a money grab. Levels have become exceptionally more challenging to the point they are not passable without significant luck, powerups and gold. I have spent a significant amount of time and money on this game. Unfortunately it is no longer fun, and feels a lot more like work.

been playing this for years and now changing my rating to 1 from 5 stars, negative even. the recent updates robbed us from the enjoyment we once had before. no more hours of unlimited power ups. the 'One try' level is designed to break your streaks, if u don't buy power ups, you will lose them altogether. This game is all about buying everything now. if u have coins, it will be almost impossible for you to beat the hard levels. they want you to spend your earned coins so that you can buy more.

I'm about to leave this games. everything getting expensive. every month spend more than $500 bucks. used to be around $30 & $50 for the package bundle. but now is around $50 & $60. not even last more than 4 days. then bought again in between $8 & $15 juz. too much for me to spend. and now I juz notice they changing ( reduced to be more exact )the booster to worst. good bye. time for me to save my money. Thanks for those WERE the good days. Been playing since Oct 2017.

You've ruined the games! I've been playing Gardenscapes and Homescapes for years. Every time you make an update to the game, it gets worse. Playing the games used to be fun to do in my spare time but it gets less fun every time you make an update. The cards are a stupid addition because it takes forever to get them all. Most of the challenges are impossible to finish unless you spend a lot of money or play 24/7. I'm just about finished playing both of them. You've really ruined the games for me.

IMPOSSIBLE to pass several games in a row since every other game you generate is HARD or SUPER HARD level!!! Was my favorite and the 1st mobile game since 2010's. More than a decade has passed, I've examined strategies, gained experience but now, especially with the latest update I feel like this game stopped being a relaxing one and turned into money making machine- It's impossible to enjoy, if you prefer to play for free. If I wanted to play something complicated I'd choose Assassin's Creed

Very much disappointed by the service. The game closed due to a software mistake. I lost the game, the magic hat and the super rainbow blast. I informed Gardenscape 3 days ago about this problem. But there is reaction, no proposal for solution, nothing. I was a frequent player but now I'm frustrated by the service and stopped playing. They have to significantly improve their service.

Decently interesting game but not really how it's advertised. Been playing for years and it's been mostly okay but it's almost impossible to get far without paying for bonuses and power ups. And then when things glitch and you lose your power ups it takes them ages to get it sorted and they sometimes just blame you and give you a couple of average power ups to somehow make it up or not give you any assistance or compensation for money or time wasted. Don't waste your money on this game.

money grab. dont waste your time playing. the game is good dont get me wrong. but the developers dont care about the players at all not like other games that reward players with daily check ins. plus when reaching some levels its obvious they want you to spend money cause they make it so difficult to win. the stage will only have like 5 - 10 moves but you have to collect 130 pieces of 2 different colored items with so little space on the board. thats just them forcing you to spend money.

Love the game, but special items have changed and suck now. Moles are gone because people had too much of a challenge. They have modified to the lowest common denominator. Okay to play when you have nothing else to do, but not as good as before. Also seems to be money grab, we have team players that buy the pass all the time, that shouldn't be necessary.

They seem to take away ways to earn boosters with each new update. The levels also become significantly more difficult to pass during special events, making it essentially impossible to progress far or complete the special events without paying. In effect, they put the prizes for these events behind a pay wall. The game wasn't like this when I started playing. You can easily spend days on a very hard level trying to pass it, and then as soon as the event is over you pass it easily.

I have played this game for more 10 yrs. but the latest update is extremely disappointing. The value of items has been drastically reduced, and advancing through stages now feels heavily pay-to-win. Players are forced to spend an unreasonable amount of money just to make progress. This update has made the game far less enjoyable.

do not install this game. it used to be so fun, I've been playing for about 15 yrs now but I'm tired of being cheated and customer service does nothing! when I first started playing you got up to 300 coins per level you beat, now they give minimum of 10 coins and maximum of a little over 100 but you have to beat a super hard level. this is so they can get you to purchase more coins, which you must do if you want to get out of a level that's impossible to beat unless you spend 900 for 5 more move

I used to love this game but these past few months, it's been acting weird. It's turning into pay-to-win. I've been stuck on a hard level (which is fine because it happens) but I used all power ups to clear the level - it only gave me one bomb, one rainbow and one dynamite. What in the actual hell happened to the second bomb and the rainbow that comes with the dynamite power up??? I'm done with this game.

Editing 1 star to 3 since "no more moves" was added. When "continue game" was removed, I was robbed of over 20k coins due to accidental touch. I'm still mad about it. The removal of the restoration side game and accumulated holiday decor is still disappointing. I'm not a fan of the new side games and the removal of the glove that swapped pieces, but the catch when you run out of moves is a huge improvement.

Lovely game, but these constant upgrades are annoying! Why have we reduced the number of rewards we get! For example the Blueberry challenge awards! May we please go back to the way it was with awards if not better, if you'd love to upgrade, suree! Add more features and improve the graphics(they are amazing btw) but not lessen the awards we get! The game is already expensive as it is!

This game gets greedier with every update. They are constantly reducing the opportunities to earn power ups in game, taking away the best power ups completely, and reducing the time certain earned power ups are active. Coupled with the 'random' levels that more often than not are almost impossible to win without either coins or power ups. This used to be a fun game. If you're not already invested, go find a less money hungry game to play.

How long does it take y'all to respond when someone submits a "I made an in app purchase and only got part of the bundle I bought" queries? It's been over a week. I spend too much money in this game to let it slide; but I'm saving money in the long wait. ******* It takes 2 weeks, and repeatedly filling out forms through the game. Then they just assure you that you definitely weren't shorted on a purchase, bc Their info shows that your purchase was completed, even when it wasn't. FF: REPEAT 07/26

The developers are ruining this game with every update. They cut the coins you get per normal level from 50 to 10, but kept the cost of 5 extra moves at 900 coins - making it much harder to afford. They removed any preview of what the level is going to be so you have no idea what boosters to use before you're in. They also removed the level numbers and stopped showing the rewards earned at the end of each level. I could go on for days. They are actively making their product worse.

I have been playing this game for years. Used to be fun but now has become a money grab. I don't mind spending on a game I enjoy since there are no ads. Understand they need money to continue putting out the game. Now feel like they force you to buy all the time. Levels have become so hard to pass and boosters most of the time are put where they do the least amount of good. Will be uninstalling.

what happened to the 3rd powerup.... NOT HAPPY. You took away the best one. Edit.. 27th June. I have been playing this game for years and years, not until now with all the changes, another one being this silly gold league tournament thing... it makes me NOT want to play the game at all. Before I would log on everyday, now I'm playing it less and less and when I "automatically" get added to the gold league tournament, I don't play it at all until the 3 or 4 days of the tournament is over.

Game partially stopped working somewhere after level 500. I'm so sad! I can play the garden portion but the adventure side keeps racking up energy and there's a location icon to tap to continue the story, but nothing happens when I tap it. if it doesn't work soon, I'm going to delete it, which sucks but it is so limiting, it's not worth it. Hoping someone sees this and fixes it.

Horrible game. They just recently changed the RNG (random number generator) of the game and made it almost impossible to play or pass any levels without having to pay real cash. I've been a long time player of this game and have enjoyed it over the years. But, I refuse to put any more money into this game and I would highly recommend others to avoid this. Do not play this game. They will immediately lure you to reaching into your wallet.

Game is good, except for the times when you get stuck on a level for days. It is really boring if you must play the same level over 100 times just to get through it. some of us don't have money to spend on special things to get through levels faster. Its sad when games get designed only for people who have money.

EDITED: 5 stars to just 1 star and here's why: support and help is nonexistent. Gemstone expedition glitch caused me non-progress (can't use any energy up whatsoever despite racking xxxx amount); and gardening duties also stalled as a result. posted messages and emails asking for help but to NO AVAIL. Will probably uninstall if gemstone cycle ends in a few days -- without the ability for me to progress.

well everything is good. The graphics, levels and so on, however, some levels, specially the hard and super hard ones, are very frustrating. Super hard level or hard level shouldn't be that hard. Specially when you exhaust almost every full lives that you have for almost 2-3 days and still not get pass through the hard levels. it's kinda frustrating and the hardness of some levels are unreasonable.

Levels are getting insanely difficult to play without spending real money. I used to at least look forward for the electric showdown to get one hour of unlimited play, but now you took that away from as well, although my team still gets it. Honestly contemplating deleting the app, although it used to he my favorite

this is supposed to be fun but for how many years of playing.. its more like stressful because most of the levels are very difficult. and the adventure it's very hard to accumulate the energy cos its very huge figure. it's very intentional cos u want us to spend more money just to add more life. this is very costly. I enjoyed this game before but now I'm more stressed than ever. can u please do not make this hard for us players. this is only a game that meant to enjoy and stress free

I had a problem with the game and contacted support , I gave every detail as well as a video clip to the support robot and yet I haven't received any sort of support .I have been trying to contact anyone except the robot and failed . I even rechecked the support hub for updates but there was nothing . The robot keeps on saying that my problem has been sent to the technical team since last month .

Disappointing and total pay-to-win. This game is getting worse. It feels like you can't pass levels anymore without spending real money. They reduced the free boosters, making the game frustratingly difficult. To make matters worse, the booster packs are overpriced and definitely not worth the money now. Please revert it to how it used to be!

this used to be a 5 star game but every time they do an update they take more away. the safe gave 5000 coins for 2.99 now its 3000, for completing a regular difficulty level you'd get at least 50 coins and now they've taken the rainbow blast out of the third poweup but it still cost the same and the customer service is terrible. I've been trying to reach them for days because the game crashed but says I failed a level and I lost my streak that was over 1000.

I'm giving this game another chance until the next update.. if it still takes out your life and loses all the power up even if you exit the game, I'm uninstalling this game after 5 years.. Adios! Edit: Actually, after playing through the game now after the changes, it is good if you know when to pick and choose your battle. I've cleared 60+ stages in a row by using the boosters at harder stages. Once you get the 10/10 rainbow blasts (that's the KEY!!), everything else will fall into place... 😅

Had this game on my phone for at least 8 years now. It has definitely changed since I started playing. I noticed that they started giving you less moves to pass the higher levels. Although the game is still challenging they really need to be more generous with the amount of moves you're able to make on one level. It would be great if you give you more stars as well, since it takes between 500 to 700 stars to restore one area in the garden.

Absolutely love this game! 🎮🌿 Gardenscapes is super fun, relaxing, and addictive. The levels are interesting, the garden designs are beautiful, and the storyline keeps the game entertaining. I also love how satisfying it feels to decorate and unlock new areas. Perfect game for passing time without getting bored. Highly recommended!

changed my review from 4 to 1 star. Been fine until you do have a problem. No assistance or support given that actually helps. I won a level that should've activated a 30 minute free play and it didn't even after another round was won. Support says they will investigate with no results being relayed to me or anything else. Only apologies for the inconvenience. Fair play indeed.

Been playing this game for years and I don't like the new updates. It just seems like they're designed to make the game more annoying. The new colors and graphics are also a bit off but maybe I just dislike change. Also, am I the only one who the game shuts down on in the middle of a level once I'm on a winning streak causing me to lose my power ups and rainbow blast? It has happened a lot and I'm contemplating deleting the app altogether.

Decent game depending on what version you are playing. Yes there are different things my partner has had on her game that I never have and vice versa. Have no idea what triggers this. Also as for cost her Garden Passes that you can purchase is significantly cheaper on her game than mine. I can not see it being a location thing as she is sitting about 10 inches from me as I type. While the core game is the same not all features necessary will be. Just the luck of the draw.

BEWARE. As a long time player, they have systematically downgraded everything. All the bonuses have items taken away, as well as a change in boosters (ex: no more horizontal/vertical booster; it's now one or the other). In this new world we seem to be living in, greed is more important than loyalty. I'm out - uninstalling.

i have played this game for ages, i am addicted and i love it, but please move the option to buy power ups at the end of the round, or at least includw confirmation before buying. I dont want to spend my coins on power ups sometimes but i click end the round or play, and it just pops up the power ups, if you are moving too fast - you just buy them, which i dont need and is kinda dissapointing. Please move the mower up option or double confirm if u wanna buy....

I've been playing for almost 10 years, since 2017, and currently on the level 19.176. I've been very loyal, but lately i feel cheated by the way the developer kept changing the rules abruptly. First they downgrade the in-game power ups, then they downgrade the starter power ups. Also on the last card collection season, I only need 1 more gold card to complete my collection, but it never came. What a huge bs scam

This game is messed up. I used to think it was my old phone. Got a brand new phone and same issues. There is a problem with the top of the screen. this game can become addictive. unfortunately it gets very expensive. payouts and wins are meagre, but it costs a whole lot more to buy boosts, extra cash, and lives. some of the advanced levels are deliberately programmed to encourage the player to spend real cash just to level up. so this is not really a free game at all.

They are trying to rip you off. Game consistently says you have no more moves even when there are. Then tries to get you to buy in game currency to continue. If continuing is an option there must be more moves. I verified this buy earning enough in game currency to continue and it doesn't change anything on the board to give me more moves. Then I finished the level successfully. And its nothing like the ad, which looked way more interesting.

Awful. It used to be fun playing gardenscapes. But now it's all about paying. You can't beat a level unless you've spent money to get extra moves. Even with a combination of powerups, it's so so difficult to beat the hard levels. You are forced to either spend money to buy coins or keep trying the same level for hours and days. It's so frustrating. Playing gardenscapes can get you ruined financially if addicted to it. I had to quit. Do not spend a dime on this. It's a scam.

One of the best and worst games ever. Love the garden part, sooo beautiful and really fun! HATE how hard the game is. I played one particular level well over 20 times before I could beat it. It is ridiculous how freakin hard some levels are....well unless you spend real money for extras, which is the whole premise of this game. I did spend real money but sorry, it's not relaxing, entertaining or fun anymore and you get no more of my cash. Enough for me. Uninstalling. Buh bye.

This game itself looks fun when you first start playing. Repair a huge mansion little by little. BUT, once you are hooked, there are fewer and fewer moves. Why? So you spend money to keep playing. It is not worth it. Just don't even download it! Also, the ads show characters getting killed in various ways. Not suitable for children to view!

I've downloaded a couple of these types of games based on the preview puzzle they show... but that's not what the game is like when i play it. it seems misleading. maybe there are tiny parts that are like that, that i have to play hours to get to, but i don't care to play through all that (if that's even the case). i just would like to solve the puzzles.

Not a bad game, but every new ad I see is increasingly irrelevant to the actual game. The actual game is about playing match-3 stages to earn points to upgrade and repair your garden. The "pick the right item to fix this problem/get yourself out of this situation" mechanics have nothing to do with it. I installed the game wanting that mechanic, played for a few days, and uninstalled in disgust when it wasn't. Why bother advertising if you're not advertising *your* game?

To unlock places and get improvements on the game, it requires money, and if you dont have money, be ready to play months. The game story determine the progress of the game, for example: In the main hall, after cleaning old statues, the game will demand you to replace them with an aquarium later. This game is game is NOT about saving characters (as shown in some pictures) NOR choosing the best object to survive or whatever. All the game is about pairing shapes and fruits in line. Don't wastetime

Like all the others, I downloaded thinking they added or changed the game. I always ignored home&gardenscapes because I really don't like the candy crush style games. But the ads were showing like a survival choice game. Played for a couple weeks thinking eventually they'll let me play what's advertised. It's just candy crush with Sims quality. I even searched to see if I downloaded the wrong game. When I noticed I didn't, I gave it a few more levels then uninstalled when it didn't change.

Lots of creativity, time, hard work went into this game for these I loved it!...but some levels are extremely hard to win(can't stand the gnomes). Need to play a game for almost every little step (game for finding #, make phone call, get estimate, start building, etc.) I think I made my point! ..In the future I'll come back and see if it's worth playing & look forward to renovations of all gardens. Thank you for all you do!

Beware. This game like any game has the possibility to glitch and freeze. This happened to me when making a purchase of a $15.99 package. The charge went through to my bank account but I didn't receive any items from the package. I have sent 4 emails with one response and no resolution. I won't be playing this game anymore because it's impossible to get through certain levels unless u have boosters to start. Boosters that typically have to be bought. Thanks for ignoring me playrix.

Trying to unwind from a stressful week and I hit one of the super hard levels that seem designed to force you to spend money. I quit the game thinking to myself "I need to play something that will let me just have fun. Something a bit easier." I enjoy a fair challenge but some of these levels are ridiculous. The game overall is enjoyable. I just don't want to have to dump money into it to beat a few of the levels.

So sick of playing the puppy dog levels. You get so used to hitting the retry button on the normal levels it puts "play on" in the same spot and makes you spend coins!!! I will never play those levels again until you move that button! Also some of the supposedly easier levels are harder and take more time and power ups than the hard levels, thats not right. Tired of spending coins. Maybe you should give mire coins.

If you love gardens, this game has very beautiful gardens to build. I love the fact that I can turn on all the lights in the different gardens. When the developers tweak the game so you can win, it is fun. However, the game's algorithm is set up, so it leaves you with just one item left on the board. As others have mentioned, it is IMPOSSIBLE to COMPLETE SUCCESSFULLY without paying money. It is a nice game, plenty to keep you involved and very nicely designed. Unfortunately, it is a money pit.

The game is good, but the coins that you buy dont go very far when you are playing the very hard levels. I also noticed a few times that the characters dialogue was leaning a bit too left wing for my taste. Anyone with any sense knows that higher taxation and big government creates more corruption with a ruling class and a subservient surf class. Maybe the reason for revolving the game around a butler. Conditioning acceptance is best done through entertainment and repetition.

I enjoyed playing this game for years, even spent quite a bit of money upgrading the events. I'm not sure if they recognized me as a sucker or if the game is programed to only let you play a certain amount of time before you are forced to buy power ups to beat a level. I cannot even enjoy the events that I paid for anymore because without buying power ups, I can no longer beat any of the levels.

I loved this game. I could play for hours but not anymore. They are just trying to rip us off now. We used to get 50 coins for a regular level, 100 for the mildly difficult level and 150 coins for a difficult one. Now we only get 10 for the regular level?! The levels are getting harder and harder with fewer moves. And the golden ticket is twice as expensive now. They are doing everything to force you to buy boosters and keep buying. Enough! I'm deleting it

I agree w/ all the recent negative reviews. I've played for years, it has become greedy. Used to spend $ a little when I wanted it to be a easier, now they make it extremely difficult to play w/o spending, so no thank u. Fewer prizes for winning levels & tournaments, higher prices, impossible difficulty. I played a level & it wouldn't let me win even after adding 5 moves - the pieces I needed to eliminate to win simply wouldn't generate on the board. Hope they go back to how it was.

With the new update it is almost impossible to pass the advanced levels. I always play but enjoyed getting the double boosters in higher levels. I will be using all my boosters and coins then stop playing this money grubbing game. When you win coins it's never enough to buy anything and you barely win the rainbow blast. I've spent years playing. I've even stated over a few times and play on multiple devices. I've always paid to pay in special events. Over the years I've spent hundreds of $$$

Honestly, I've enjoyed playing Gardenscapes. So why 1 star? Because Playrix as a company engages in false adverts on their app ads. I won't be spending any more money on Playrix apps. I got bored with the GS gameplay awhile back, and based on an ad mini-game, decided to try it out again, as it looked like they'd added updates and extra gameplay to change things up. 50 levels after more same-old, same-old, I decided to look it up. Sure enough, it's only on ads. Why the bait and switch?

The RNG is made to frustrate you to the point of using actual money to bypass levels. And even then, it's not guaranteed. I still keep the game but I will never buy anything in it. Also, little inconvenient issues I've noticed with the pink flowers growing. If you complete one growth cycle, the next items that drop while the flowers are spreading do not count towards further growth. Eg: two chains followed up a completed growth cycle. I'm so very disappointed in eve single game company that does this micro transaction bs. Justify it all you want, you guys know you're wrong to do it. Also, the butler is useless. I'm doing his job for him and adopted a dog I never wanted. I want to build a garden not train a dog. Cute game but hugely wasted potential.

New review edit.1.why you didn't give plenty of green coins to build the special decoration. It takes so much green coins to build but you give us that coins when only we beat the hard level.2nd- the fox challenge. You're very funny. How did you think that 3 point can fill up the 80 point quickly?? Wow.. brilliant idea! And we can't even take the one that we've already unlock just because the event has already ended. Wow... brilliant!

Whoever is working on advertising the game, needs to stop and play the game. The ads are COMPLETELY 100% DIFFERENT than the actual gameplay. You've officially fallen under the category of clickbait and you oughtta be ashamed of it. Gardenscape is such a fun game on its own. It doesn't need false advertisement. If you're reading this review and wondering if you should download it, it depends if you've played the false advertisement beforehand. if you have, don't bother.

First the good...Engaging graphics /stories, great events/challenges, good diversity of activities. Now the bad...Only 1 out of every 3 levels can be completed without "paying" (buying points/lives/other). On average, you will spend $1.50 per level, and since a minimum of 10 levels can be completed in less than 1 hour, you are spending over $10 per hour to play. If you have cash to spend, download and enjoy. If you don't have the cash, DON'T.

Match-3 puzzle game which adds nothing new to the genre and mostly steals from other games. The story is almost non-existent, and it's so bad it physically hurts. As most of the games from this genre, after a while it becomes impossible to play properly without investing lots of money. The so-called "mini-games" which are shown in the ads are bland, repetitive, not challenging and very disturbing in content - always showing pain and suffering of young mothers and small children. Utter garbage.

I downloaded this game because I kept seeing the ad where you have to save someone by figuring out which bars to raise/lower. THAT looked fun, but to my surprise, I have only been able to play candy crush type games (the last of which I haven't been able to beat). I didn't download this app to play candy crush and I don't want to have to wait 10 more levels to get to the type of puzzle that's advertised. It seems like my complaint is pretty common among the "scapes" games. Will be uninstalling.

I've been playing this game for a long time and used to find it fun and relaxing. The levels have become increasingly difficult to beat unless you're willing to spend $$ on power boosts, etc. You'll get a couple of easier levels and then back-to-back hard levels followed by super hard levels. This has led to me to play less ans less and to lose interest. I no longer find it relaxing and enjoyable. It's becoming more and more frustrating. Ready to uninstall and go back to Lily's Garden.

It's ok. Nothing special. More of a time killer. Something to do while your waiting to accrue free play time on other more interesting games. It's a shame really. With just a bit more effort, they could've actually made it fun, challenging, interesting to play. Instead, they settled for, in my opinion, making the game equivalent of a "Gilligan's Island" rerun. It's an "Oh well, guess it's better than nothing" type option. They add external enhancements often but never improve the game itself.

I really liked this game, however, recently the number of renovation tickets used to get 1 item in the room is getting way too high. It used to be in the hundreds when the renovations were first introduced, but it slowly increased to 200+, 300+, 400+, and the most recent room, it was at 600+ for a lot of the items. I spent quite some time and bonuses on it because I really wanted to complete the room, but until 2hours before the end of the event, I only managed to get 21/28 items. It got tiring.

Very disappointed in the game. Made it to a point that it's impossible to continue without micro transactions. I like that they took out ads every second. But just put the whole game behind a paywall then. I had to spend $10 to get power ups just to pass one level. Then I tried to save the power ups and the in game money for harder levels, but the game kept giving me difficult levels to pass. And now I'm stuck. The game isn't worth the $10 I spent.

I don't usually leave reviews, but I was so disappointed. Firstly, it's NOTHING like the game that was advertised. I wanted to be able to figure out how to "fix" plumbing, electrical, etc. What I got instead was another version of candy crush but with a storyline. It's not a bad game, it's just nothing what I expected when advertised while playing my other games. And not to mention level 8 is impossible to beat.

I have played this game for 3.5+ years. Sure, some levels have always been hard, but it has become ridiculous lately. I am absolutely positive that after I purchased the golden ticket recently, the levels have become 10x harder than they used to be. Even those marked as normal. I will probably uninstall this game soon, having loved it for so many years. Shame.

Game is not at all like it was advertised. I spent a lot of money to be able to advance. I was past level 1000 and spent money to buy coins (Again) and the level kept shutting down because of multiple "gas cans" exploding. There was no way to get them all at once and spent 900 coins for 5 more moves, 1200 coins for a few more moves, then 2000 coins for a few more moves. It kept happening. Finally I uninstalled this game and really wish I'd done it much much sooner.

Concept is good but honestly some of the levels are almost impossible to play without spending money or spend days on one level. Almost impossible to earn enough coins for power ups unless you buy it and can't get far on some levels without power ups. This game frustrated me to no end and I usually do well on puzzle games. It would have been more fun if there were more ways to earn coins to buy power ups without spending real cash. Buy to win type of game.

Not what I was expecting. I clicked on the downloading link because I was hoping to play a game of silly scenarios. This is more involved than what I thought or want. I was confused as to how an advertisement about people stuck on a desert island would be related to fixing a garden. It's a cute game, but I'm not interested in a building my landscape game right now. Maybe later.

Some of the games I would spend 2 or 3 days trying to complete. I felt like they wanted you to have to buy coins in order to finish that game. I am just looking for a stress reliever and something to keep my mind active with a challenge. But when that challenge gets to be frustrating then it is not serving the purpose I am wanting it to. Other then that I enjoyed it.

I consider myself a person of average intelligence but the fact that I can't get past level 65 is infuriating!! There is a huge amount of gardens that I should be able to go on to design but having to repeat the same level over and over AND OVER AGAIN makes the game incredibly less fun. And expecting someone to pay for a safe that already has money saved in it just so the player can access that money is rather ridiculous as well. Obviously the game makers were more intent on creating a game that would earn them money and then marketing it as "free" than they were on making a game that people would enjoy playing and share with their friends. Up until level 65 I actually thought it was a pretty good game, but obviously the game levels are going to continue into the hundreds if there are that many gardens to expand, so it is going to lose it's fun value quickly if every level after 65 gets increasingly more and more difficult.

I played this for a while, but it got to a point where there were so many updates required every time Iogged in that I couldn't actually play. Also, there would constantly be four or so "events" happening at any time. If I have five minutes to dip into a game, and it takes three minutes to do all the downloads and another two to get through all the pop ups about the "fireworks festival" and dog agility and I so on, there's no time to play the game. Also, the new ads lie about the game.

I would have given it 5 stars but it's hard to get people to join your team, it is difficult when your team members don't help other team members and because some other levels are ridiculous Hard It's a great game if you like a challenge and puzzles. But as I said they don't rotate the teams and enough in order for people to be able to join your team at random. Basically you have to make friends through Facebook to find friends in the game. I thank the players in the game should be avail 2 all!

Used to be one of my favorite mobile game to wind down and relax. Lately they're bombarding the player with events and challenges you have no time to relax. Just to start the game you have to close\click multiple pop-ups telling you what's new and what they want you to do now. You can't even ignore them because they open up each time you start the game. I'm also really disappointed in seeing ads for the game that have nothing to do with it! It's now an annoying, throw-away game. Uninstalled :(

I enjoy the game for the most part. My only complaint is that they didn't design it so after say 6 or 7 tries on some level you still can't win that level. I just stop playing for a few days then go back. but sometimes it will take 3 or 4 times of doing that before it finally clears. at one point I was going to delete the game all together. like I said frustrating, cause I do like the game.

Irritated! I guess there a whole new genre of click bate going around where all the games have ads unrelated to the storyline or game play now. I like match games, but they have gotten repetitive, there are tons of them offering only slight differences like the main character and items to match. Clearly people are intrigued by the ads promise of something new and different...Yet instead of creating a game that delivers as advertised, or add that puzzle addition to the game, you bait and switch.

I have edited this to a 3 star rating. be cautioned, if you spend money on this or any other "scapes" game. once you buy, the levels become so much more difficult. the algorithm will change and make most levels near impossible. most times you will be left with one move to go and run out of moves. it's a fun game, just don't spend your money.

I saw an ad for a puzzle game, like a maze where you have to remove things or choose the proper tool to get thru. It was called Gardenscapes (there was another version with a fish), so I excitedly downloaded it bc it was different & really exactly the kind of brain teaser puzzles I wanted. UNFORTUNATELY it was false advertising. Only about 5% of the game (if that) is those puzzles. The game is your standard Crush matching game with goals, but it's not at all like the ad. Uninstalling.

This ad for this that is often shown on YouTube is very misleading. This game is nothing more than a game where you match different tiles to get the right combination. It is just like many of the games in facebook and internet. Looking at the ad you would think that the game consists of solving interesting puzzles to save the gardener or guy. But I have been playing this game for sometime now and I have never played a game where I had to solve a puzzle. These people are cheats.

NOT AS ADVERTISED! Been playing this game for a few years, and this new advertising lately is false and misleading. This is a match 3 game, NOT a make a choice game. The game isn't bad, it's fun, but each area is SO time consuming to compete, it's really annoying. And after awhile, it all but becomes a pay to win game

Not as advertised! I see ads for killing the spider, and different crazy puzzles like that. That's NOT what this game is! It's basically rebuilding a garden by playing a cheezy form of candy crush and after each level you get one more step done on your garden. Like replacing the benches, sweeping, etc. If that's the kind of game you want then this is for you, but it is not what these in game ads are telling you. Those ads should be removed. Unbelievable that this false advertising is aloud.

If you came here because of their deceptive ads, don't bother. The actual game itself is like Candy Crush, but worse, 'cause you can't combine any bombs with other things. It started off fun, until around level 130 or so, and then every level became unreasonably difficult, likely because they want people to spend money on boosts and more moves. Each additional 5 moves cost 900 coins, but you only get maybe 60-100 coins per level that you win. All progress is halted, and you lose interest.

This game is utterly horrible. In the advertisement, this game was portrayed as a problem solving game wheareas in real life it is a puzzle game. When i first download this game, i thought that it was amazing but this is just simply horrible. I put a lot of effort in making my garden beautiful and then the higher the levels got, the more difficult the game became. Games are supposed to be fun, this game is the opposite of fun... do not download and waste your time in this garbage game. Thank you

This game caught my eye as an ad from another game I play. It showed intricate puzzles and alot of brain teaser contraptions you could place, move, delete, or slide to get the desired outcome for the puzzle you were trying to solve.. looked amazing! I downloaded it quickly, only to find out this game is just a dam developer trap, just like all the others in the app store anymore, that blatantly lie about what the gameplay is. This game is basically Candy crush. Zero stars. Shame on you

game is ok but I hate how you have to play a puzzle each round it gets very annoying. I just want to renovate the garden. then you have to use stars for everything, 1 to rake leaves, another to dig a hole for the leaves and another to bury them. it would be nice if you got more compensation to get through the puzzles easier. great story good game play but it is not what I thought it was.

Tired of annoying ads of this thing everywhere. Tried it - and as usual, the most advertised thing is as usual the most mediocre. It consists just of two types of mini games - first and main one is ordinary three in a row where 95% are very simple even for 3y.o. child, and 5% - technically impossible to solve even by computer, without wasting coins. Second one - removing pins in particular order, it is too dull, intended for IQ=0. But drawings are nice though.

Something happened with the new year. Suddenly the game stopped loading. I don't want to uninstall and lose my progress in the game so I'm hoping it gets fixed soon. I'm on level 700 or so. The game wasn't what was advertised and the levels are often overly difficult, taking 20 or more tries to beat. That's why I gave the lower star rating. However, it's a little addictive, so I keep going. I don't Ike being at a standstill now that it won't even load. Update 1/19/2020- Still no response.

This one star is based on the advertising. It's the "sea monkeys" of games. I'm not into the type of game it actually is, which is boring ass to me although others may like it... but likely not the type of people who would like the ads. It's slow and relaxing but frustrating. I could see if the ads were just trying to be representative, but there are interactive versions where you actually you play an entirely different game. Super extremely deceptive.

The concept of this game is good and I like playing it. But I find it ridiculously hard, PLUS ...why do we get such a low number of moves like in level 523,that's only one in many of them,, where you only have 14 moves and have to hit every blocks at least 3 times. Seriously ! I want to play a game to sit and relax. Not to frustrate and where I have to spend tons of money to buy boosters that's dont even help! Therefore, I have to delete until they rethink this better.

Seriously getting tired of being stuck for weeks on the same puzzle, especially when they aren't even the ones that are classified as hard or super hard levels. I want a game I can relax and enjoy playing and both this and Homescapes is just getting frustrating beyond belief unless you are willing to spend real money or really long hours/days/weeks to progress...close to tossing it in.

Overall the game is fun to play... The reason for only 2 starts is the log in time takes 2 to 3 minutes! And to get any rewards for completing garden takes forever too, you have to try to fast forward through the repetitious captions & after playing this game for as long as I have it gets VERY old! Which I believe the mass of the garden is part of the reason for the extended log in time. If they could speed those two processes up I would give it five stars. Unfortunately that won't happen 👎👎

NOT AS ADVERTISED. DO NOT DOWNLOAD. I thought this was a fun mini-puzzle game, based on the YouTube trailer. IT IS NOT. It's another Bejeweled rip off. Companies like this should die. This is basically false advertising. The ad content might be in the game (I don't know I deleted it after 5 min) but it's not the core of the game. I want my time and data back.

I've been playing the game for 2+ years now, I have nearly 800 hours of play time, just reached level 4150something. It's hard, some levels are insanely difficult and take forever to beat, and other times I beat levels in 5 moves with 25 moves left?? Also I believe some levels aren't rated as hard or super hard when they definitely are much harder than normal. I also miss when you got 2 stars for beating a super heard level, that should be brought back! Overall I'm low-key obsessed though hahaha

I have played this game for years, and I am a "pay to play" person ( I understandthe developers gotta eat too). I just reached level 6210 and for the last 1000 or so levels every other level is either "hard" or "super hard". It takes either days to beat the level or 3000 coins. Even most of the regular levels are hard to beat now. I'm at the point where I will not spend anymore money to play this game. I may buy a golden ticket every now and again but that's it. Very disappointed 😞.

I am disappointed. I am on level 272, and it only took a month. When I first was introduced to this game there were timed levels, but now there isn't. Some of the levels are too easy while others were too hard. There's no super-hard levels in the 200s, and the event prizes are just not worth the time, or effort. I tried my hardest in the event of the gold league, and my prize ended up to be a bomb pack. I thought the higher the league, the better the prizes, but that was not the case.

I started playing and I'm stuck on game 418. Very little moves butterflies don't come out and your down to 4 moves. Flowers down to only 5 left. Joined a team so as to get friends. No friends to help send lives. Love the game. It's almost like kitten match. I have been trying for 4 days to pass this level. I'm about to give up and uninstall. At least with kitten match after so many fails it makes it so you can pass. Love the game just tired of being stuck!

The ad is very misleading. You would do what the ad says about once every 60 levels. There seems to be a update every month and the games seem rigged during special events. The levels get hard to beat like they give impossible number of moves to beat the level. At first the game is fun then it gets real boring quick. If you dont spend your real money it would take days to beat a level. You have to wait 30mins to gain 1 life and you only get 5 lives. They are very cheap with the rewards. delete

I love the game but it is expensive at the higher levels. I agree with other comments that they do pressure ppl to buy more and make levels harder to pass without spending. Really fun game short term. They dont put the sales often enough to make it a long term game. I had to uninstall bc it felt more like a casino game. The longer you play, the more expensive it becomes.

I enjoy playing this game on the whole and I understand higher levels should be a bit challenging, but it can take several days to get past a level and it is only worth 1 star. What are the other areas, that are dark now, going to be like? When do you reach them? It would be nice to have some easier puzzles / games / challenges thrown in once in a while. Maybe different kinds of games, other than match 3 types could be used. Please and Thank you.

Ads for this game are misleading, you do not have to choose the correct item from a selection to proceed in this game. Instead, you have to have to play a tile match and break style game to earn gold to pay for garden upgrades. What you see represented as gameplay in the ads is not the actual gameplay. This game will also use a lot of data, so be careful!

I used to love this game, but recently they bought in to the advertising campaign that a lot of other mobile games are trying, showing gameplay that looks interesting but isnt present in their game at all. I disagree completely with this practice, it is EXTREMELY anticonsumer, and is dangerously close to false advertising. For those that are still interested, this is a tile matching game, like bejeweled, or candy crush, with a progression system in the background in the form of a garden.

I've played this game daily for over 7 yrs. The last two years Gardenscapes has really gone downhill. The rewards are at minimum, you hardly get any rewards when you pass a level. If you are doing a team event you get small rewards. You cannot progress levels easily some times I would be stuck on one level for more than two weeks even when using my power-ups. The price increases on coins for power-ups is also stupid. This game is now a waste of time and no longer fun.

so, I'm seeing all these reviews that say Gardenscapes is running "bait and switch" ads. I haven't seen the ads myself (probably because I already play the game), but if this is true, shame on you, Gardenscapes! Also, literally all but like 4 of the reviews were 1's, but the play store is saying most of the reviews r 5's. What's up with that google?! Personally, I like the game. It's cute. The graphics r good. Edit: Still playing the game, but much less frequently. The events r too expensive.

Okay, at first. The ad was extremely misleading. This is not a decision making game of consequence. I was disappointed but okay for a while. And as you progress to the harder levels it is nearly impossible to pass some without purchasing little boosters to assist you. I quit at level 97. A game should never be so difficult that you can't pass it without having to buy something.

I feel like the developers have increased difficulty to force in-app purchases. E.g you need to set off more explosives now, to get a Rainbow Blast. Also limiting the specific item you need to collect e.g collect 30 green leaves but the game only supplies 1 drop at a time. Maybe it's my imagination, but I don't enjoy this game as much as I used too.

Bait and switch. I thought I downloaded the wrong game until I confirmed the screenshots. It's bejeweled. 45 minutes in: no trap doors, lava, or gold. Just a match 3 game with battery draining graphics. "Cleaning the garden" is just a graphical representation of what level you're at. There's no real user input (except buying in-game currency). Couldn't pay me to re-install this misleading dumpster fire.

After watching ad, thought I was going to play an original puzzle game about a woman and her child, doing puzzles to build them a home. Instead I got the same old boring make-a-line-of-matches game like zillions of others. If you want to play the puzzle game advertised, don't download this. That isn't what this game is at all, and it is a complete waste of time. Uninstalling it, and won't believe any ads for this developer's games now. Going back to Paradise Island 2 with mini games to choose.
