Basically you people are cheating because if they advertise the real thing they won't get so many downloads. Very very disappointed. I would give 0 stars but that isn't an option.

The game is ok, but it's nothing like the game that is advertised. Ads, show a game where yu have to choose an item to save the character and that's not this game. And the other disappointing part is the money. Yu pay a lot to get very few powerups and its hard to win. I'm on level 170 something and my goal is to attempt to beat rounds in 1 try because yu get more money and prizes but its almost impossible for me to complete tasks. Fix it and I'll recommend this game and give a 5 star rating.

I have been a loyal player for 3+ years, and I am done. I spend money each month, I think I am the perfect example of customer Playrix wants to have, yet the degradation of bonuses is just too much. Prices stay the same, yet you get less and less benefit by beating levels, solving puzzles, etc. Today I see they reduced the benefit on Treasure Hound, after beating 3 levels you get 1 extra move instead of 3. Just one example of many. You lost a customer, goodbye!

This game has held my interest forever. I didn't buy helpful items for ages. Now, I'm wondering why you charge so much -- it cuts out much of the fun. It can take a long time to solve some levels. All puzzles can be solved, eventually, but it's hard without boosters. Austin & his dog & cat are funny. I like how the rabbit, frog, birds, squirrel & hedgehog jump if I touch them. Very good graphics! Thanks! Still TOO expensive!!! Update: App won't open today. Help! Then, make it cheaper, PLEASE!!!

I enjoyed this game at first but would be frustrated that it didnt allow you to get more lives. You had to wait, forever. And then the games are set up so that, unless you have an arsenol handy, theres no way to just clear them without several tries. Sometimes you'll get unlimited lives for like 30 mins but if you close out, time keeps clicking. How useless is that when I'm just playing on my break to clear my head for a moment! It's just stupid. I spent money one but not again!

I have played this game for years and really enjoyed it. Unfortunately, much has changed with it recently. Most of the in-game rewards have been reduced or removed, which is of course to encourage players to spend more money on the game. I don't mind spending money on passes, except that those too have been greatly reduced. Even the safe has gone from 5000 gold to 3000. Disappointed in the developers. Please go back to providing fun rewards for playing the game!

I wish this game could just be a game instead of a moneygrab. It requires luck/in-app purchases to proceed instead of skill. Would much rather pay 1.99 or whatever for a game than constantly be advertised to in order to play it. I was stuck by level 14 and unless you use the in-app purchase powerups, you aren't going to get very far. Sucks because I actually like the idea of it. I also wish the ads were more honest about what the game actually is, it makes it feel sleazy overall. Uninstalled.

I would give "Gardenscapes" a lower rating due to its heavy reliance on in-app purchases, which can hinder progress and limit gameplay. Additionally, some players may find the abundance of ads or feel that the game lacks fresh content. These aspects could impact the overall gaming experience. However, ratings may vary based on individual preferences.

I've been playing this game for years, unfortunately they are getting to where all they care about is money. For their 6th birthday they were so generous they gave all players a profile picture! That's their way of saying thank you to their loyal players who keep them in business. For challenge levels you used to get unlimited bombs for 15 mins, gone, when updating you used to get coins, gone. There used to be a side game to get power-ups if you completed levels, gone. Pay for everything now. :(

This game has some fun puzzles, but also a lot of issues. While you get decorating choices, there are so many side stories and things you have to do to decorate whether you want to or not, that it gets a little frustrating. Also, there are some really difficult puzzles that you can get stuck on for days unless you want to spend money for helpers, and that gets pretty tedious.

Top 5 Grossing for a reason. I could see after only 50 levels why they make so much money, which lets face it, is why these games are made. Don't fall for the thought that if you make a purchase, you'll pass the level. Did not work on higher levels. It's over 9.00 for the package. There are mini games for extra coins. The rest is a little confusing, since the main levels are a matching game, like cc.

Ads show a completely different game. Developers caught on to the complaints so they still show the same ads that drag us in, but now shows "not all footage represents actual gameplay" on the ads. I don't see how this is acceptable to promote, but whatever. If you're going to download the game because of the puzzles you'll be highly disappointed. Otherwise enjoy it I guess, I havent played it I'm just going based on the false advertisements and other reviews

This is a dishonest attempt to separate you from your money. An honest approach to selling the game would be to offer some number of levels for free. A gamer could then decide whether the game is worthy of purchase and buy it once. As it is, the game play encourages frustration to try and trigger a spending impulse. The open ended game structure is meant to keep a player paying and paying and paying. Stay away from this one.

First thing first, false advertising. I saw this ad in another game multiple times, sad stories about mothers and childs figuring out a solution to not freeze, u have to place planks, repair things, warming up rooms and so on. This game is not about that. In fact, its a candy crush mechanism match different fruits, combos, and every now and then you will get a little short quest remotely close to the advertisement. Other than that, 90% candy crush wanna be.

Content wise it is a very good game and keeps you engaged. However, once you reach the top levels, the game transforms into pure greed, spelt with a capital G. It becomes almost impossible to move forward without purchasing coins or power ups. And even that doesn't guarantee that your move to the next level. On many occasions, the game algorithm will not let you move forward at all and will try to exhaust your purchases immediately. I am not going to purchase anything in this game again.

It used to be that I couldn't wait to play, but anymore the levels have become so hard whether regular, hard or super hard. There doesn't seem to be any difference in difficulty. Now I play the game once a day until my lives are used up and go on to another game. I realize you make them tough in order for us to spend money on power ups, but I will not pay money to play a game that is advertised as being free to play. There are other games available to play without doing so.

Won't even bother loading it after reading reviews. I was interested in the mini-logic games. Those were unique, something different finally! Who needs another candy crush? One is enough. I would have gone thru it to get to logic games, if there had been enough of them. Sounds like I'm not the only one who would like to play them. Maybe ur game designers need to get busy. 🤔

This game is beautifully designed. The puzzles are smart and the garden itself is fun and pretty to work with. But the game has a dangerous, addictive quality designed to take your MONEY. There are certain levels you just can't pass without powerups, and those powerups require 💰. They're cruising for a lawsuit if you ask me. I spent more in one week than I would if I'd purchased a fancy box game. Stay away if you have an addictive personality.

Undisguised money grabbing. The levels are too hard to be enjoyable, way too few moves and buying more moves is often not feasible, because earning the gold is very slow and if you don't want to spend real money on the gold you've already earned through gameplay, you're out of luck. Aside from the fact that the game is not, what is advertised. Uninstalled.

CHANGING MY RATING INTO NEGATIVE IF THAT'S EVEN POSSIBLE. Update sucks!! It now takes time to load the game which has never happened before. PLUS, I've been playing this game for years now, and you made it not fun anymore. All we have to do is purchase anything what you offer so it'll be easier for us to surpass every level. While if you just play not relying on any booster, it'll took months for us to pass just one! Thinking of uninstalling it right now. So disappointed.

I dont do in app purchases so this game can really be a time-sucker. The further along you get, the price of the tasks makes playing the game (again, without purchases) almost not worth continuing. And what if i never wanted the dog? I want a lush landscape, not to take care of my pet. Good time-waster, but also bad bc I waste so much time on this game.

Not as advertised. All of the advertisements that they've paid to put in front of me involve the key-pulling aspect of the game. I enjoyed the look of it, so I downloaded. I play one key-pulling mini-game and rhen they hit me with some interior design levels and a match-3 minigame. That isn't what you lured me with, so you shouldn't expect me to stay. Not only did you waste your ad investment, but you also misrepresented your product and thus invited unsavory criticism. 3/5 sell it honestly

this game is frustrating! some levels are impossible to pass coz of the move numbers you give does not much the hardness of the level and please don't get me started on the time it takes to get 1 life half an hour, really ? it takes two hours and a half to get all 5 of them do you really want people to play ? i get it this way people start to buy gold and you earn some money but they can delete and install some other games too😒😒😒

Its a fun, simple, puzzle game. That also lets you decorate your land. What I truly enjoy most about the game, is it's not a game made for the sole purpose of making money off of you. I've encountered quite a few games like that. Games that make it almost impossible to play, or even win without spending your actual money. Much like 'Coin Master' or similar games to it. You can actually play this game an succeed without spending a dime. If you love puzzles an want a fun way to kill time, try it.

Played for years, the recent "makeover" challenges get you to take a poor disadvantaged or angry woman and make her over to improve her life. After 7242 levels completed I'm uninstalling. Hideous message. Make it about gardening, like the name of the game. Plenty of misogynistic games out there for people to choose if that's what they want, this shouldn't be one of them.

Get your credit card ready. Once you get to a certain level the only way you're going to pass most levels is by paying for more powers and even those won't last long.If you have the patience to play on the same level for days,then eventually they will drop a couple of bombs to move you to the next level,,,then it's same thing unless you want to keep paying for just enough powers to get you through a few levels,,and then it's time to buy more. Trust me...find another game,save your money.

Frustrating. I wish I had read the other reviews. I saw these puzzles advertised in other games and thought I'd give it a try. After playing up to level 40-some, I'd done one, boring puzzle. The primary game is matching. Sometimes, they're ridiculously low in probability so it takes you days to pass them... unless you spend money. Just not worth it.

Update: since my last review the ads are even WORSE. They depict a lecherous man fondling a french maid and STILL depict inaccurate gameplay. I feel compelled to write a bad review because the game's advertising is NOTHING like the actual gameplay. This game is just another "Match 3" game. The advertising makes it look like you are choosing from an array of tools to find the correct one to repair the house, which is completely different gameplay. The advertising is misleading.

This game is a cash cow. You will spend hours trying to beat levels hoping the "random" selection will let you win this time. Or you will have to spend dollar after dollar of real money. The levels are intentionally designed to force you to spend money on extras. The game could be fun, the premise is great. But who wants to sit around waiting for lives to fill up so you can try to beat the same level over and over again? I'm embarrassed by how much of my money I let this game have.

As a game designer, I have to say, I am very disappointed in this game. As others have said, this game is very much misleading. The ads show quite a fun game to play, only to be disappointed because you've run into another version of candy crush. The game that is played should match the ads that is shown. For the amount you put into advertisting, you would have a great game. However, you chose a dishonest route by lying to general population. If only there was an action to have this game removed.

What I have encountered is that if you pay money on one weekend and you can't pay anymore money, you can't beat any levels for at least 5-7 days no matter how many times you try. You could be on an extremely high level and been playing for a couple of years, it doesn't matter, they want more money. My advice don't pay any money, if you do they won't let you win until you pay more or stick it out 5-7 days till THEY Decide to let you win!!

Edited: I'm on level 1700ish. I have well over 500 stars racked up. At least 10 of each powerups that I'm saving. Probably only 7-8k coins. Game still sucks. There is no point in playing this deep into the game. The levels are 100% luck now. Ya just gotta hope it randomly gives you moves that are actually worth it. I probably average about 1 level increase per 3 days or so... And this is supposed to be fun..?

The ads are a blatant lie. I'm ashamed to say I was fooled. I downloaded this expecting a neat puzzle game, like the current ad. The ad, showing people in dangerous situations where the player has to employ unique solutions to rescue them, looked different from anything else. Well, too bad it doesn't exist! This company is lying to get more downloads. I don't need another match game, but especially not one from a company that lies. If you want a fun, relaxing match game, try Lost Island.

Pretty good in the early game, but then you hit a paywall. It gets to the point where the level is too hard for you to beat but you don't have any power-ups and you've ran out of in-game money. The game makes you spend money so you can buy more lives or power-ups. You don't have any other options than to spend money or stop playing. This game is also the prime example of deceptive advertisement, with these Mini-games barely being in the game, even though they're the only things to appear in ads.

It's just another app after money. Had this on my phone for about 3 days and got impossibly stuck, the ONLY way to progress I found out is to pay. I'm not very far along and to be stuck on such a low level for over a week, no. I pay, I don't mind buying but if you're forcing ppl to pay so early on, it makes me leary of going on, I know it'll just be that way again in another level or two. Deleted!

I deleted the app when I realized that everyone was right about the false advertising. The sad thing is, it was actually a fun game - way more interesting than a typical Candy Crush! Has an actual plotline and the ability to customize your world. I liked it. I just CANNOT support a company that misleads people. If they lie in their ads, where else do they have to lie..? I would give them 0 stars, but the play store doesnt give me that option. So they get 1 star.

Downloaded the game because of an in-game ad from another game. The ad showed different problems and a bunch of solutions along the bottom you can use, not all are correct. Header says "Why is this game so hard?" Im well over 400 levels in, still havent seen anything even close. This game could be so much better if there were different types of puzzles, instead of a Candy Crush type game only. VERY DISAPPOINTED

This game is a total bait and switch from the ad. it advertises its self as a "choices" game. It is a "connect 3 gem game". Levels become prohibitively hard after level 9. I've played gem type games for years. This game is ridiculously hard, and tries to force you to spend money out of sheer frustration at not being able to complete such a low level. total rip off in my oppinion. I'll be deleting this game.

It's your typical match three game. Make no mistake. You absolutely will not win a level of the algorithm doesn't want you to. You can spend real money to put the odds in your favor, but you have no real agency to complete any given level. Also, the levels are designed to totally negate any power ups used in the first place. Utterly predatory game. Don't spend money on it.

Starts off as a get 3 identical objects in a row type of game, much like candy crush. I don't like this kind of simple game. I had been hoping to play the game where the logic of which pin gets pulled and in which order (as it shows in the ads) advances play. I deleted the game after a disappointing 5 min. No fun for me, just a waste of my time.

False Advertising. Immediately uninstalled after playing for 5 minutes This is a "match 3" tile-moving style game, and has nothing to do with solving puzzles to make your way through rooms or past hazards as the advertisements would lead you to believe. This is the same with all of the "..scapes" games. These developers should really be ashamed of themselves for how they present such a garbage game.

Worst advertisement. Pretty much gameplay like candy crush. 3 match play is what you do 95% of the game. 5% is expanding and cleaning the area. Nothing like the pictures. Thought it was going to be fun and easy. Instead you gotta play and get the points and decorate. Can't do anything if you get stuck. Spent so much time on those hard levels and I refuse to spend money on it. No type of escape feel to it like the pictures and ads like I was seeing while playing other games.

I used to enjoy this game, but as of lately, not so much. I have invested quite a bit of money, too. I'm on level 2857, so I expect it to be more challenging. Levels where you have to fight through fog have also changed. It takes more energy points to clear the fog than before. It's just not fun when you're forced to spend days and days on 1 level. Update: As of Feb. 29, game also eliminated the free 5 pts that we used to get during the merging game. Not worth the download, or the $

The game just got greedy and too complicated with this last update. I just burned through 10,000 coins in a day. They changed too much and are expecting you to pay real cash now to make it fun. I'm very disappointed in this downgrade of an update. I've played this game for years, but I'm not going to play anymore if they don't change their greedy ways. It was a fun, soothing mind escape game for several years. I gave them my occasional in-app purchases. But this flower update is so NOT FUN!

This game is misadvertised as a logic puzzle game. In reality you get one logic puzzle per game day. The rest of the time you must play a version of candy crush to gain lives to advance each game day. The only way to pass the "super difficult level" (their description not mine) is to buy credits. Even then there is no guarantee of advancement. Also facebook is a requirement for extra lives. Frustrating and disappointing. I had reached level 70 but had only advanced 4 game days.

This game used to be really fun, but their recent updates (forcing you to lose lives quicker, positioning the "pay" button in the same place as the "quit" button used to be) are really quite deceitful. I see some comments from them saying "it's meant to make the game more fair", but really, it's just a scam to trick you into buying things in the game.

How this game has positive reviews is beyond me. It is not very rewarding. I downloaded it for the puzzle and brain teasers I saw in an advertisement. Does it have ANY of those? NO. It's just like every other gem game (bejewelled, candy crush, etc.) out there. Oh sure, it has a story, but it is boring. The levels don't reward you for spending gold for extra turns. You're as likely to have wasted all your coin as you are to win. The deceptive ads are the WORST however. Pure dishonesty.

Here's the thing. I gave this game 30 minutes or so and that's it. First of all, the ads lie about the game play. It's not some brain teaser game on how to get to the treasure. Maybe down the line, but not where I played. It's a general candy crush swap and get three type of game. It's the same basic mechanics with a few twists. Probably fun building your garden, but I can't see it. You notice early that this game also relies heavily on microX

it was fun a first. just recently I noticed that the game has been making the "normal" levels impossible to pass without using the coins. it's a patterm actually. The normal levels before the "hard" or "super hard" levels will force you to use the coins so that you don't have enough coins to get a few extra moves when you can't pass the hard levels which are right after. Do not think using the bombs or rainbows will help you. YOU WILL HAVE TO PAY.

HUGH money grabbing game. I enjoy playing it, but I also spend lots of money. WARNING this is a match 3 game and nothing more. The ads showing a list of tools and you have to pick the right one are FALSE! This kind of bait and switch should be illegal! The developers are just trying to get you to play the game by showing you something different that they have no intention of ever making for real. They hope that you will spend money trying to quickly get to the levels you saw in the ads. DON'T

I played this game years ago and I enjoyed it, it's your typical match-3 game with a decoration twist. It's fine to advertise it as such and once upon a time they had their own original ads. I'm completely baffled as to why this developer decided to cheap out this way because it's a good game in its own right. Normally I wouldn't post a review of a game I haven't played in a while like this, but trying to skip an ad brought me here instead so...anyway Gardenscapes, fire your ad people.

game is definitely pay to win 100%. They rail you in at the beginning by having you play relatively easy levels. However as you play the game, it becomes so difficult that it takes days to beat a level (even with power-ups). It's become overwhelmingly frustrating. I've deleted the game and won't be playing any longer. I don't recommend this game.

I used to enjoy playing, but it's now not worth it any longer. Its VERY FRUSTRATING and when you are stuck on a level that gives limited moves and so much to achieve well not any longer it's not worth the time or giving them your WiFi. I have already uninstalled a good number of times and reinstalled but alas you get so much infinity with boosters but then get stuck on another level which can take up to 2 weeks to get through it. A game like this should be enjoyed not FRUSTRATING. IM DONE!!!!!!

I started playing this game because I got gems in another game. It was pretty fun, basically a candy crush reskin. I have started seeing ads for it now where it looks like some decision making puzzle game. I can't stand false advertising , so I am done with this game and a 1 star review. Advertise the game for what it is and people will want to play. Lie to people and nobody will want to play. I know you "are constantly testing new mechanics" what a load of croc. TRUTH IN ADVERTISING!!

Wow, I fell for the bait and switch of their adds. They make the game seem as though it is a problem solving game, something that takes some sort of intellectual thought to pass the levels. Nope, its just Candy crush wearing the mask of a better game. What a waste of time and effort, on their behalf, for making this atrocity. Too bad, the adds actually made the game seem like fun.

Nothing like the ads that sucker you in to installing this game, but thought I'd give it a go anyway. It's just another version of candy crush that then allows you to complete tasks to build your garden. Like most games, easy and enjoyable for the first few days, then you hit levels that are can't be beaten unless you part with real money to buy the boosters. I don't see why developers can't just charge a small nominal amount to buy the game in the first place but make everything achievable.

Far too heavily reliant on purchasing of coins etc to complete levels. You can do a level 100 times and still not get through it. Even after purchasing and using bombs and extra moves is no guarantee and is most likely that it will not help you. Has the making of a good game but not if you cannot complete levels within reasonable attempts or use of extras. There are better games out there. Don't bother with this. Just not worth it. That's it cya, better games out there!!!

I used to really enjoy playing this game, but lately it's becoming impossible to beat any levels. I've used all 3 power ups at once and still can't get passed without paying for additional moves. I have played the same level over 30 times without succeeding. It becomes redundant to play the same level for 4 days. And the expeditions aren't even passable anymore. You can only make 3 moves with the banked energy. I used to always finish the expeditions, but something changed. It's not fun anymore.

When you start, the games are challenging but doable. Bonuses are given. As you progress, bonuses are few and far between. Levels take forever to get off of. It takes more and more coins to move on the map. They just want you to pay for bonus items with cash. Not happening. I'm on level 2716 so I would know. You're given 100 coins to move through the map. That gets you three spaces at my level. Getting ready to delete this and move on to something else.

lots of effort for small rewards. absolutely ridiculous to go through 4 rounds of 30 min unlimited lives (at different times), then 4 rounds of donated lives, use boosters more than once and still unable to pass a level. Its absurd effort for a small amount of coins but will cost 900 coins to continue a level. Absolutely ridiculous costs for anything in the game. The expeditions are just as terrible. You can barely get a couple of items before you run out of energy. So not worth the time.

I have enjoyed playing this game. But it has become a pay to play game in order to keep progressing. Lvl 10,000 something, and every few lvls I'll get stuck for days unless I pay for power ups just to get passed the lvl. I have spent my fair share of money, and now it's time to call it quits. Good luck on your garden adventures everybody.

Gardenscapes started out as a really fun game and now it's the worst game I ever played. This game was designed to be impossible to move forward from level 94. I've been stuck there for 2 days. I tried different strategies, used up all my boosters, coins and lives multiple times. I even watched videos on YouTube that show how to complete this level. I'm done with this. The frustration isn't worth it. Uninstalling after leaving this review.

This game is nothing like any advertisement I've ever seen for it. Difficulty starts ramping up around level 10, dwindling what little free resources you get to keep playing without paying. Several hours logged and I have yet to see a single one of their self described "match 3" mini games. It's all about the fruit and flower mixing and matching game to clear a level and open more of the garden. IF what they advertise even exists...you're not likely to ever see it without paying some amount of $

I read the reviews and was looking forward to the mini games. I did the beta thing on my PC. I am on level 57 and have yet to see a mini game! The Gardenscapes ad that keeps popping up today is a spiel about "don't you hate ads that show fun games but when you download the game it is completely different? Don't worry friends, Gardenscapes is exactly as advertised." As I said, level 57 and no mini games! Just a poor imitation of Candy Crush. So disappointing.

Great match 3-game. On a side note if you were to create a new game based on your latest advertisements I would download and play it. I'm referring to the trailer where the butler and his lady friend are in trouble on the island and you have to choose to give them 1 of 3 options (umbrella) to help them. Make that into a whole new game and I'm in! Or incorporate that into the original game, but that would probably be too cost worthy. Have a good day! ☺ P.S. I'm serious about this make that game

Meh. Just uninstalled this. I played it at the level 207 but got bored. The ads are misleading. It is mostly like Candy Crush and the fun puzzles you see in the ads are mini games that appear occasionally. The puzzles become increasingly more difficult requiring you to use boosters which are rare unless you, of course, buy them. It is a nice fun time waster at first but now it's just annoying. They jacked me for about $30, I'm done.

The blatantly false advertising for the games from this company (Home/Garden Scapes, Fishdom, etc...) imply logic mazes and escape scenarios, but instead they are basically "Candy Crush Meets The Sims" with matching and decorating. Fine, if you're looking for that, but nothing like I expected or wanted. The game levels also quickly reach a point where you can no longer effectively progress without substantial real-money purchases, locking in-game earnings behind a pay wall.

Ok so in all honesty i think that this is a good game. obviously a fair amount of effort has gone towards the game both inside and outside of the levels. but really the thing that truly brings the game down is the advertising. it's nothing like the game, and i see no reason why it exists. In itself the game is good, so advertise what you have IN the game not a obviously faked minigame that isn't in the game. I'm not mad, just disappointed.

What the hell is this?? I saw the advertisement for the game where you choose between 2 things to help or hurt the characters but when i downloaded the game it was just some stupid candy crush puzzle thing and buying garden stuff to make the garden nice just like all the other games. So unoriginal and really misleading. Why not just make the game the actual thing that was advertised??? That looked like so much fun which is why i installed it to begin with. I uninstalled immediately. Stupid.

It's fun, but it's a hoax. For example, one of the levels you have to clear 5 glasses but only 2 come down until your time almost ends forcing you to to add more time. Once yiur time runs out you still haven't seen the other 3! By then you've run out of time but your caught up because you think your almost there so obviously want more time which you probably don't have so then the only option is to buy more time! NO THANKS, wont get my money again. I'll wait until my FREE time is up again 😒

Game won't load!!! I've been extremely patient waiting for developers to fix the loading problem. I'm on level 800 and something. I refuse to uninstall and reinstall. I'm way too far into the game. Fix the loading issue!!!! I spent way too much time and money for this issue to happen and not be resolved in a week!!!! I will edit my review once fixed.

I've been playing Gardenscapes for years. Love it! Well, loved it 😕 What happened recently? Change of owners? It has become painful obvious that the algorithms have changed. They are bent towards the gamer paying to play. Now, I know that's what it's about but it's borderline ridiculous! You guys must have brought in a company to really do some work on keeping the player engaged. I think it was just too much right off the bat. The algorithms are too obvious. I'm just sad and disappointed.

Games get so hard you spend ALL day getting one puzzle, sometimes days. Will never spend money on this game. It's be a waste of cash, as the next level or two would stump you again right away. Great game with one horrible flaw, way too hard, and not once every dozen, but once every three or four. I'm about to erase this game as a matter of fact.

At one point of the game the puzzles come down to luck, and not necessarily skill. It beats the purpose of solving puzzles when sometimes you simply can't solve a puzzle, however, you will get punishment for failing. Finally, this game requires a lot of time and effort, but you'll receive little in return. Careful, because this is a money trap.

I like the game. I dislike the gnomes! Austin is pretty funny sometimes. I dislike the piggy bank!! That is pure greediness, trying to make me pay for something I earned! I will Never buy it! You should give me those coins! Also, the piddley 60 - 69 cents for completing a level should be doubled or tripled, so I actually have a chance at earning enough to play this game! I am on an extremely low fixed income; I will buy a little bit, but the constant need to buy that your games expects, never!

The game is really a great way to enough some pretty garden colors while distracting myself briefly from life. The puzzles are challenging and the design aspect is engaging. Some of the tasks become a bit redundant and it can be annoying having to earn stars to make a phonecall, again to start the project, and sometimes more times to finish it, but aside from that I enjoy the structure of the different aspects of play. The temptation is strong to spend actual money on coins or boosts in the game, so know ahead of time how much you're willing to commit!

I played for years and enjoyed it, used to be 5 stars. BUT the game gives you impossible levels when you are out of cash or items to force you to spend real money to continue. And finally...The storage it takes up. I was up to 390 MB, and it was still growing. That's just too big. It's over 100 MB more than any of my other apps. Total waste of time!!! Levels are beyond passable unless you spend mega amounts of money! Its designed for failure unless you line their pockets!! You have to beat Candy Crush like levels in order to continue each step. If I wanted to play Candy Crush like levels, I would continue to play Candy Crush. I really love this game but the levels get so hard sometimes that we have to buy extra moves or we need a bomb or a rainbow to complete it. We should get more stars for those. I have been playing for 6 years now.. Just as eveyone says, its advertising is deceptive. Your not solving a puzzle to figure out a life or death scenario or to gain an item. I have NEVER spent this much money on a game! And I have spent DAYS on some levels. I have read some comments and they are spot on. One star per EVERY level is not ok. Not like advertised, you don't move objects to fix issues, free people from lifts etc... instead it's match the colours to beat levels for points like candy crush & then things fixed automatically, with no choice to keep or restore. I think the fact i have completed over 3000 levels proves i enjoy the game. I am however disappointed that you have taken away the dog training, it was a great way to build up some extra coins. Well, although I do like this game and it's fun to play but what's the point of playing if levels can't be beaten including using the tips given. Not the game you've seen in ads: Are you looking for a game with an adventure filled with puzzles as you've seen in the ads for this game? Great animation, graphics etc, but its obvious that they don't want you to play for free for long, as levels get hard and nigh on impossible to get past with the standard 5 lives pretty quickly. Tried heaps and heaps of times to pass the last two levels i did, days worth of trying, but then gave up and uninstalled it. Not everyone can afford to (continually) pay to play, a one time purchase is better.

Don't download this game is you're expecting what you see in the ads. It's a matching game similar to candy crush. You earn points and then use those points to create your garden. Misleading ads, bad game.

Good time waster and kind of addictive. Updating my review. I'm nearing level 2500 and have run into a pattern. I'll run into a level I end up getting stuck on for days. The levels are really hard to complete and to complete one you only get ONE star to complete the next task. I don't usually purchase anything for games but I really enjoyed  this and decided yeah, why not only to experience not receiving what i purchased.   Also, the ads are misleading!!

Now we are at the higher levels it's starting to become ridiculous to pass a level. This was once a game I would play over and over even while waiting for new levels. Installed this game because it was supposed to be a life choice problem solving game... that's not the game I got...I see many others fell into this trap the same way. The Gardenscape game is entertaining but quickly becomes impossible to move forward without spending real money... Replaying same level over and over, trying to move forward. It shouldn't be this hard.... This is not fun it's Frustrating. I think they just want you to give up and spend money.... meanwhile you feel like an idiot.

This is NOT a rescue game. Matching game that cheats and requires way too much money to actually get anywhere. Recently I downloaded the game again on a different device and did see that they let you play two rescue scenarios. So I guess that's their way around getting sued for false advertisement. Way over 1000th level on the first device and still no rescue challenges to date. False advertising to get you hooked. I wish I could give negative stars.

The game is ok. Some levels are very hard and 900 coins is not worth it to keep playing for only 5 more moves. edit: once you get to the higher up levels things cost 3 stars, and sometimes even more as you have to complete something in steps. if you have tons of power ups you can use them to beat hard levels but if you dont then you just spend forever on 1 level trying to get 3 stars to do something only for the next part to be another 3 stars. I'm almost to the point where I'm about to delete!

I love this game!! I got hooked to a different match-3 game, but was bored with it. I found Gardenscapes and was hooked to the story! It's fun having a goal to pass levels (you collect stars to complete tasks that renovate the garden). Being able to choose and change the decorations throughout the garden are also fun. (I'm currently playing level 1637 😊)

Really addicted to this game. I'm only giving 3 stars because there can be some improvements in gaining rewards and coins. As you proceed higher, you should get more coins when you finish a level, not just 50 or 100 coins for a hard level or at least gain an additional life. It's far to "expensive" to keep playing. 900 coins for 5 moves is highway robbery. And you can no longer purchase thru your service provider. You need google points, reward coupons or credit card.

Ive been playing this game for a long time. I don't have patience for playing a level 100 s of times so I buy xtra help. But the further I go the harder the levels are getting, some of them impossible without spending money (lots).I dont mind spending a little money to keep games going by helping pay the employees but I dont want to spend enough to send their kids to college! Come on guys!! Lighten up on the hard, super hard and impossible levels. Otherwise I will be forced to quit playing

The game is fun, but the levels are extremely hard. I've been stuck on a level for about 3 months and I'm about to uninstall because you just cant get past it. If you want a challenge and dont get frustrated than try the game but if you're looking for something relaxing this isn't the game for you. It's sad because the game could be way more fun if you didnt get so frustrated with it.

Fantastic game in every aspects. Or at least I would buy it to have fun and relax. However it is free to play but after a while you find some barrier you cant jump unless you pay for gold, which probably would be only the beginning of this ride. If you don't have problems investing a price of a higher tier board game to this, then you may be lucky enough that may be enough until the end. Or maybe you just pay again and again.It gets fustrating really fast without paying for it.

Advertising misleading, there is almost no escape games, just another candycrush. Waste of time to hope to get to the escape games, really annoying! All advertisements are about the escape parts and yet it is almost no existent in the game. I dont understand the intent behind it. It is just frustrating for those who want to play tha escape games and dont find it.

Do not like timed games. Other than that, it's enjoyable. Level is not hard, it's impossible. I'm convinced the only way to beat it is to buy your way through it, unless you already have plenty of boosters. I have been playing it for days now and just about to uninstall game. Only 17 moves on this level, and everything locked down. It's not fun, it's rediculous!

Fun little time waster. Was a little disappointed at first, as the desktop version is hidden object. But the match 3 in this one is still fun. The whole lives thing gets annoying sometimes. Austin's antics are entertaining. The dog is cute. Edit: I hate all the events! I just want to play the game, not spend 10 min dismissing the event notifications! This used to be fun, now it's just annoying.

If I could give this game a 0 or a ½ star I would. PERIODT‼ Don't let the 5 stars fool you, If you go on their facebook page and read some of the comments there you'll see that alot of people are having different problems with this game and it might seem like everything is okay at first when you're playing but they will pop up on you later on in the game. There were times where I couldn't past one so called "easy" level for two to three weeks even if I used money to buy the packages they offer.

The game play is fun! Therefore why 1 star ? You start the harder levels and with barely any coins you have to be stuck there for days. You accidently hit the button to spend coins on doing the level over because it pops up right when your gonna make another move. hate that! I know someone has had to of said this before me, you need a confirmation beforehand, for example DO YOU WANT TO SPEND 800 COINS ON THIS? ALSO notice that none of these reviews are getting feedback! Pathetic!

First of all they are doing false advertising on social media. Showing as if you would be solving interesting puzzles but in reality it is just a glorified Candy Crush. Still I gave it a try to kill time, but now after reaching higher level, there is no getting ahead. You end up playing the same level multiple times hoping some luck would clear that level.

This has the potential to be an excellent game but the levels are so hard to complete without spending money, which I won't do. The tasks take way too many stars which are so difficult to get in the first place. Make the levels easier to achieve, give more rewards, provide some incentives to stay with the game! I'm sorry, but I am uninstalling, life is too short to spend DAYS trying to complete a level and not even earn enough to carry out one task.

I find it disappointing. I was playing this game a long time ago, and I installed it back when I saw the new ads campign. I thought you've added a new staff and adventure gameplay even though in a conjunction with the classic type but I figured out that it's just for the sake of fooling users to install it. thank you for the trick. good try.

This game is fun and addicting. Some levels might be extremely hard but that's about it. Typical match-3 games can always be frustrating and you have to be prepared to rage quit when you can't pass a level. Remember that, folks. My BIGGEST complain here, however, are the new ads. They don't match the game at all. False advertisement! Other Playrix games such as homescapes and fishdom have the same problem as well. It's a shame 'cause Playrix used to be one of my favorite game developers.

The ads are very misleading, like very much am not even sure that if it legal or not. You download it to play something but get something else. The renovating part is fun and all but the match making game, it's boring no doubt but also difficult. You gotta wait and play in patience again and again to just renovate something. If we had to play that then we could have played candy crush instead, why would we come here. It should have been fun escape and renovating game. Very disappointed.

The game is okay but definitely not the same game from the ads I seen. It's mostly a match 3 game with a puzzle level every now and then. The pin pulling puzzles are way much more interesting than the match 3. So this definitely is not like the game in the ads. After so many levels, they become too difficult to beat and using 900 coins just to get a few more turns is ridiculous.

I love the graphics, I really do enjoy this game but why so little amount of dollars ($20) when you completed the hard/red levels?? Funny, earn a little amount of money from the red levels and yet have to purchases those upgrades for your garden areas is extremely high?!?! smh, just don't makes any sense ...I would love to give this game a five stars but can't do because I don't have enough dollars

Honestly never thought I'd get into Match 4 games, but this one is genuinely enjoyable. The garden itself is a visual treat, and themed decoration sets help give you goals to work towards. Daily free power-ups help break down hard levels, and frequent events give you the chance to earn quite a bit. Biggest complaint is the pacing of each "day"; diversions abound that clearly exist only to pad game length. Other than that, really solid game.

It was really fun, until I got into the 100s and the fourth garden. I spent more than 50 stars and didn't get to pick anything. There's nothing on the to do list that's anything customizable anymore. Sprinkle in the constant pop-ups, and that the levels get so difficult you don't get any stars without the unlimited lives or returning every few hours? I can't with this game.

This game is NOTHING like the ads for it. It appears you will be using problem solving skills to save a husband and wife when in reality it's like Sims but making a garden. Want to continue? Sure just buy these tokens that will only give you 2 extra tries to beat an insanely hard level. Absolutely ridiculous. I uninstalled it 2 days after playing it.

All PLAYRIX game ads are a LIE and deceptive!!! Gardenscapes, Homescapes, Township, Fishdom ads reel you in with false advertisement. You don't try to help a human or a fish or a spider get out of a well or something of the sort. Is the game fun, yes. Are you playing the same type of game the ad displays, nope. This is really a shame because you are expecting that after a few levels or hundreds of levels that you conquer that maybe there is a level you pass so you can play a game like the ad.

Game is fun and addictive but it has many glitches that just aren't right like if you need to pause and get back to life for a moment and you are on a level with all of your progressive boosters when you come back you automatically lose that level and all of your boosters that you have worked hard for to progress through the game. I've reached out to technical support about this numerous times. They did not care really. Time to let this game go for me.

I saw an add about doing puzzles to get characters out of trouble but got this aligning fruits instead. That was weird but I kept playing. Basically I get that apps entice you to spend money but with this game it's so blatantly obvious. I played for a month and spent $100 already just to enjoy the game and finish levels. Though the graphics are nice I didnt appreciate how it forces you to spend money. I uninstalled it today and will not install again.

Uninstalled it. Simply put: false advertising. It is a match 3 game, not a puzzle game to fix up a garden as shown in the ads. I don't like match 3 games, so I found this game boring and tiresome. Gardenscapes: if you don't falsely advertise, people like me won't try your game and leave a bad review. Instead, you'll get people who really do like the game to try it and leave a review.

Its good but I downloaded it thinking it was something else. All the ads I have seen for this advertise a pull the pin type game or a game where you can just design your own garden. Same with homescapes. Its a candy crush type game and you don't advertise it at all in the ads and in the pictures when you download you have to scroll pretty far back. I would rate it higher but it is not good for how it is advertised.

I downloaded this from the "what comes next" puzzles show in ads. Those are less than a small part of this game. It's just another match 3 game. The game annoyingly tempts you into spending money at every twist and turn. If you're someone who doesn't spend money on games, be prepared to play the same levels over and over until you get lucky. Another annoying thing about it is the safe. For only $2.99 I thought I could continue to collect it. Nope, you have to pay $2.99 everytime it's full.

Starts off relaxing and simple with good characters and desisn but reaches a point where it's impossible to complete puzzles without tools which you have to pay real money for. It's a good experience till it's not. If I have to pay money just to finish a puzzle, what's the point of the puzzle? Sad because the game is nice up to that point though it was starting to become overcomplicated in areas.

Pathetic social engineering. The games seem reasonable enough until you have to "find" the gnomes. There is no indication of their location, and the farther you get the more mysteriously "unlucky" you become at finding them. It only took about two hours to figure out what a complete ripoff this concept is. Save yourself the time and avoid the ridiculous learning curve of futility.

I'm not the only person saying this in these reviews, there are soooo many people saying this exact same thing ;- The levels need to be made a little more easier to complete as you progress along to the higher levels. It's ridiculously hard to beat and will result in players just becoming bored of playing the app trying to pass near impossible levels therefore you will lose alot of players as they'll just uninstall after so long.

I like this game, but it has locked up. I can't move on until it's resolved. I've done everything the support has suggested to do but it has not worked. Currently in the 3700 level in the magic land where the rabbit den is. Trying to build the bridge to the rabbit den and this is where it freezes up. UPDATE- Put the game on a new device and still does the same thing. Now, it's taking the stars away and not even Doing what it's supposed to. I will delete if it doesn't resolve. HELP!

Like the other reviews say if you came to the game based on the ads this isn't it. If you are looking for another take on candy crush it will serve that purpose. What I don't understand is if you need ads that show a puzzle type escape like game to get downloads, why don't you just design that game? Clearly people want it. So make it. Bait and switch tactics are for losers who don't want repeat business.

False Advertising!!! It's a challenging (i.e. rigged toward "encouraging in-app purchases) match 3+ "Gems" knock off with some fun characters to try to keep you playing. It is NOT AT ALL as advertised. The game in the ads would be a level of magnitude more fun but, no, we get false advertising, ads, an a game that eventually becomes nearly impossible to advance in without spending real money.

i really enjoy this game, fun way to kill some time or something to zone out to laying in bed unable to sleep, lol. giving it only 4 out of 5 though for 2 reasons. 1. Sometimes easy level are INSANELY hard and hard ones REALLY easy. Feel its a bit of developer trickery to use specials. and 2. Winning free lives time is fun, but kind of annoying it ticks away when it cant be used. Events end late at night when Im getting ready for bed and I either waste the time or cant play to save it for later.

I love this game for the most part, but getting very upset with two aspects. The 1st is some levels take too long to pass them. I think if you use all your lives 3 or 4 times you should be able to pass on next level. I shouldn't have to spend real money to buy bombs and stuff. 2nd when you use bombs and stuff. They always drop them where they are useless. Waste of time and money.

This game is great for the exception of how u get stuck due to the game lack to actually allowing you to get ahead unless you spending gold coins. I have been in many situations in the game where i have cleared the items needed except for 1 (such as butterflies or acorns) and it slowly trickles in 1 by 1 till u run out of moves and u need to use gold coins. That alone can ruin the gameplay...

This isn't the game I saw in the ad. The ad showed two people trying to get away from a shark and the game is a match 3 style fruit game in between each level some stupid bald guy rebuilds a garden. It's boring and slow and takes up alot of space. I Uninstalled the app. Based on the reviews, I am betting the game company is going to leave a cut and paste response saying something like "Thank you for your feedback, we will forward this to our developers... " It should go to marketing, idiots!

So much to get to do so little . Everytime I turn around it needs an update . Right now I'm waiting for one and it won't load geez . I pretty much at a stand still with this game. UPDATE well this is day 3 trying to update for the last hour it's just spinning circles . I've spent a lot of time on this game , if I'm not mistaken I'm at level 300 + but I'm not going to keep something that just refuses to work !!

-1 star because the new ads are misleading. Otherwise, this is a great match 3 game. I have NEVER had to buy currency to finish a level - the harder levels DO take a bit of luck but I save my power ups until I am really stuck. There are always little challenges that earn you power ups, or infinite lives for 30 minutes (which stacks) so go for those!

This game cheats so bad. Developed challenge levels where you would get free bonuses. Then took away the bonus and made them so hard to pass that it removes any bonuses you already had just so you'll spend more money on their game. What a load of bull. Gives less and less bonuses as time goes on and makes you pay for more. But not me!! I'm out and not another dime for them! ✌ They took away even more bonuses!! I used to play this game every day. Now, hardly at all. I hope you all leave too

The usual match 3 however, there are no vertical/ horizontal blasts (removing several tiles/ pieces) only larger explosions , making the game more difficult. Also the wild card will not copy power ups. The alure of the game however "freeze the spider" and the like do not exist and the developer is blatantly lying to its would be gamers. - Recommend avoiding.

The game is neat as it progresses. It is pay to play which is ok. Got to about level 50 or so before I couldn't pass the level anymore without purchasing boosters. Uninstalled it after that, but it was mildly entertaining for a day. I think the pictures of the game are a bit misleading. Its a straight match 3 game but they make it seem like a puzzle solve.

It could be a very enjoyable game if the drop game wasn't designed to make you lose. It makes so I had to go through chances faster, then of course to get more I could pay more or wait a stupid about of time. This does not make playing a game enjoyable in anyway. Also it should be said that it's a drop game like jewel quest or candy crush more then anything else. Also after just one day I uninstalled the game!

It's an overall well crafted game with challenging puzzles interspersed with dialogue and garden building storytelling. If you're playing with minimal purchases, reading some of the online forum blogs and videos is helpful. It takes a bit longer to progress through the game, but it's doable. Graphics are especially good and the game play obstacles are amusing. One of my favorite games I rotate through.

Challenging and a brain teaser. Great game. Some levels seem impossible to beat without boosters, but keep trying, they are beatable! I have been playing this game for months and haven't spent a penny. I would like to see a few more levels between the extra hard levels. I recently played a hard level, then extra hard, normal then right back to extra hard. That gets a bit frustrating. Overall, its a great game that I'll continue to play for a while. love it!

I've played this game before and it is pretty good which is why I am giving it stars, but its advertising is completely different from what it actually is. So anyone who comes with the intension playing a game of 'fixing things using the right equipment' would be naturally disappointed when they get a game where they need to play match to fix every damage there is. This misleading advertising is what cost the stars.

After nearly a decade of play, I uninstalled today. As the years have gone by, gameplay has been stacked more and more against the player. Ex: the reward wheel. With over 3k chances at it, I've only won the jackpot a handful of times. Frequently I move a piece one direction and the game moves it another, wasting my move. If you buy the in-game helpers, they will almost always be placed in the least helpful position possible.

It was a fun game. You just have to keep buying packages and other things to keep the game going. Also as the levels get harder the more bombs and spiners you need. But they limit it so you can only have 1 of each. Which some levels the screen will switch to a second part of the puzzle with less than half the amount of spins you started with on the first half and no extras to finish the puzzle. Makes you pay coins to continue. I wasted too much money with no rewards.

The levels rely more on if you're lucky enough to get the pieces you need over any form of actual skill. Lots of nonsense hurdles to jump. After recent updates I can't even use this as a casual time waster as I'm bombarded with so many updates and events that it takes me 5+ minutes to even get to the game. Probably going to uninstall soon.

After the most recent update, I can no longer use the power-ups from the Treasure Hound as I want. I can't go out of the frame and restart it attempting to get the rainbow blasts side-by-side. I know it seems trivial, but I play this game to relieve stress. Being above level 10,000 the frames are increasingly difficult, as they should be, but putting the blasts beside each other helps with the difficulty and makes play better for the user. I'm disappointed and will no longer be an avid player.

I like the game BUT it makes you buy stuff I don't want.  The garden is so cluttered with stuff that it's overbearing. When progressing to another level, it makes you spend 3 stars to play when you only gain back 1 star if you complete the level.  It makes you spend stars when making a phone call on characters you don't even want.  I'm about to delete and try something different

The game is completely different from what its advertised as. Despite being lied to the game turned out to be fun at first. But then it becomes this thing where I can only advance spending money. Its clearly programmed to generate combinations that exhaust turns. no problem spending a few bucks here n there but the system becomes more greedy for purchases which isnt a game at all. You run the risk of losing even players who dont mind spending money occasionally just fyi.

I downloaded this game because the ads showed pictures of saving a guy by making correct choices. And all the ads I've seen are based on that premise. Even the images in the play store portray that idea. I've played all the way up to almost level 2000 and I've not seen one such thing, the game is a stupid match colors like candy crush except it's a much worse version! DO NOT DOWNLOAD IF THE ADS BROUGHT YOU HERE! You'll be very disappointed.

Improving the garden is interesting or some may consider it fun, but the way to improve it is playing a mini game extremely like Candy Crush, only the game is harder and designed to get you to spend money to pass them. You have to play the mini Candy Crush like game in order to do any improvement to your garden. It gets dumb real fast. The only reason you may want to keep playing is to see the garden improvements, but i don't think the amount of time to play all of the mini games is worth it.

I really like this game it is fun and I enjoy creating/ designing things so I think it's a pretty good game. The downsides like others have mentioned is having to pay for coins, it's not at all what they advertise there is no saving another person like in the pictures infact it's a matching game. So for what it is a great game other than the false advertising so I do recommend it. Hope this is helpful ;).

The game is okay sucks how many coins you get when you're finished with a match it has to sit there and save and save. Definitely should be giving out more coins than one coin every explosion. Definitely should give out more prizes with the bonsai tree instead of unlimited life for 30 minutes or an hour. Not everybody can spend money on it game application which I understand I choose to play it so I have to go the difficult way just because I can't spend money on an app.

** Updated Review.- about a year later - 1600 levels beaten :) & i still Love this game and still play any time i get a free moment. - **Original Review-- Addictive. Fun. Exciting. The One thing I would change, more coins for beating levels, or just in general.. stuff is too expensive to only make that small amount of coins for beating levels. Otherwise, love it.

You guys should update combos. On most games you can combine 4 and get a bomb. Passing levels a lot harder and frankly a waste of my time. You don't give enough tries per level, all in all, this game is just a money grab. the levels are way too difficult, it's not fun spending months stuck on a level. I haven't been able to progress in a long time, just to complete a task requires way too many stars, and some of the tasks are plain stupid. why should it cost 2 stars to meet people. Uninstalled.

ZERO STARS!!! Just based off the completely dishonest advertising. Fake x's in the corner so it's just slightly off the real one. And I actually fell for the pick your adventure BS they put out there, but that's not the game at all. It's an old, tired, boring strategy game with no real strategy... But most importantly, a completely different game from the demo ads. I don't know how they're allowed to pull this bait and switch stuff. I hope they get sued out of business.

While the game is colorful and the graphics keep you engaged, the set up of this game leaves alot to be desired. You spend money for coins but when you beat a level the coins given back are less than what you spend for powerups. I feel this game is a huge money pit designed to compel you to spend your money, especially with hard levels. Other than what ive said I enjoy playing the game. I want to believe the makers that be will assess how yhey are pleasing pay customers.

I downloaded this game because it was advertised as something else. When I saw it's a mach-3 game I rolled my eyes but gave it a try. Some levels are so damn hard and some are too difficult. Also the daily prize wheel, never ever seen it. I was ready to uninstall untill the character got a dog. For dog's sake, I kept it. 2 stars because of false advertising and the developers goal is to get money out of your pocket, also link to download this game and that game, again with false advertisement...

This is a GREAT game, please don't get me wrong, I love this game and play it but their is a problem with it and here it is. *1st Problem: Need to be able to win more than 1 star at a time. You should get prizes with like 5 to 6 stars with the prize. I just don't feel it's fair to only get 1 star for each completed level. *2nd Problem: Their is, NO 2nd Problem, this is a great game otherwise. The graphics, controls and everything else is amazing as well. I love this game just fix the star.

Sigh. I used to love playing this game. I've been playing for a while and have even spent real money on it. I really wish I hadn't though, because now it's almost impossible to finish levels without spending money. They make the extra games so difficult to complete (needing so much energy to clear one obstacle or 100 pots to create one pair of scissors, for example) that it has taken the fun out of it. I'm going to cut my losses and delete the game. I'm done. You've lost a loyal player.

Update---I have to stop playing the game as It's become impossible the levels in this game dont make much sense I have played so called normal levels that are incredibly difficult taking 20 to 40 attempts to finally win and the so called hard and extremely hard levels are easy. I would say that one in four "normal" levels is actually set to hard. it feels like the game cheats and gives you hard levels for some hidden reason which takes away from the enjoyment of the well designed game concept.

I downloaded this game a long time ago and enjoyed it for the match game it was. I eventually uninstalled because the levels became almost impossible to beat. Fast forward a year or two & I keep seeing ads for this game that are nothing like what I knew the game to be during prior play. I pull it up in the app store and see game stills reflecting what I saw in the ads, so I downloaded it. NOTHING FROM THE ADS ARE IN THIS GAME! What the heck. Misleading and deceptive. Uninstalling it.

Fun game, at the beginning, but that toon advertising the game about sliding keys has nothing to do with it. The game is horribly rigged to get you to spend money on it. The levels don't work the way they're supposed to, and the number of attempts you need to finish a level are purposely cut short. I have frequently been 2-3 moves from finishing only to lose the level and forced to start again. I do not recommend this game to anyone!!

Candy crush with a silly side game. This is still that frustrating game with an add on. Starts off fun and you start to breeze through until you hit the money zones, hard levels that require paying for boosters to beat or just days of playing without advancing. I have never spent money on an app and never will, shame on you guys who do. These type of games prey on money paying individuals so if that's the entertainment you seek then maybe this is the game for you.

My husband and my favorite game!! We play just about every night, for 7 year's!! Addictive, fun, interesting life & story, animal friends, awesome graphics & sounds (love GS theme music, this game is always turned up) very customizable & great personalities for all the characters!! It really has a way to bring you into the game & keep you going back! ** I know for a bit there Levels were to hard and we were having to pay for boosters every time we played but seems now they're back to normal!!

The game itself isn't necessarily bad, but there's a "bait and switch" issue since I got here via an advertisement. The same goes for "Homescapes". The advertisement shows characters or rooms needing help or repairs, and the player has to select the right item and apply it to the correct person, broken appliance, etc.; however, it's just a glorified match 3 game once downloaded. Disappointing.

I really enjoy playing this game but I recently had an issue with one of the levels and the feedback wasn't very helpful. Please make an update so that butterflies dont take more than 3 or 4 moves to show up. I went more than 10 moves with no butterflies and lost my winning streak. Very disappointed because this game is amazing otherwise. Would have given 5 stars.

Level 12306 here and ready to stop. Have spent money on the game and used to love it, but it has just become impossible to move forward without spending any more money than I already do considering one doest not really get much for the money (expensive). Impossible to beat levels without boosters, and to make matters worse, no treasure hound any longer, just magic hats which we all know don't help much at the highest levels.

This game would be fun if all the levels weren't all the same difficulty. I have used all my boosters and coins and have been stuck on a level for days at a time. It seems impossible to get past a single level without coins and boosters and it's not fair or fun. Just frustrating. I like the fixing the garden part but once I'm out of stars then what

Overall a fun game. Harder levels take an inordinate amount time and resources to solve so the game becomes less fun and more frustrating to play... Will probably uninstall it soon. Additional -1 star for getting preachy about climate change. A recent update (10/03/20) has made firecrackers, bombs, dynamite, etc less effective at charging the rainbow blast-thing. Thus it now takes longer for the rainbow blast to "charger" and you wind up burning thru your moves without completing the level.

First I will say that I like the game however after playing it , I have started to hate it as well. The reason I tried this game is the misleading ad that showed the mini game, there was only three, also, since the last update the game is virtually impossible to play, glitching, freezing and extremely slow to load and play. Also, I am not impressed with the cost of playing this game, there is very little payback for winning and completing levels.

I've been playing this games for years. Level 14,000+. I spend real $$. Every update gets worse. I hate the mini game anymore. Every update is the same bs mini game. Before, they'd at least switch between 2 diff mini games. Now it's basically the same damn map with a few changes in background appearance. The farther you progress in the game, it becomes IMPOSSIBLE to win levels without spending real $$ & even then, you still don't win. I'm uninstalling. Creators have become GREEDY. Not worth it.

I've been playing from the first day it was out. Some levels are harder than others, some not hard at all. It's a game of strategy, so if you're good at that then you'll love this game if you have trouble, keep playing. I dont use the advertisements to get money, I take a break from it and move on. Suggestion: instead of just giving a life to friends it would be nice to also give the extras like, the hammer, glove, rake, etc... no negative comments, I love it and play everyday!

Got to about level 560 and uninstalled, it became obvious it was a case of bait with easy levels and switch by throwing in some hard levels more and more often hoping you'll spend money to buy in game currency to purchase more lives or items to help you pass the level. Lack of Ads worth 2 stars, 1 star for enjoyment up to a point.
