Story line is cute, like that I can choose to interact with it, or skip, and whether I chose to complete tasks or not doesn't affect ability to move to next level only if I beat the previous level. Also like it's either I did or didn't best the level, no go back because I haven't connected enough starts, gems, diamonds, are whatever due to only 1or 2 out of 3 on a level. Hard levels are hard levels. No matter which match 3 game you choose they'll always be a hard level you can get stuck on for days, every weeks depending on the'power ups' you've collected. My one complaint about Gardenscapes is more than once I've come levels with rocks that have to be cracked to remove, and they have to be removed to beat the level. I've spent weeks playing and only ever have one or two options of moved from the very beginning, none of which allow the pieces to drop so that a any type power up that would break apart/crack the rock can be formed. Unless one can be contacted on a daily spin this makes the level impossible to beat. IMO there is simply something innately wrong with that. Three initial layout of pieces should allow for the creation of at least one of these items. It's never completely random, but it should be at least possible no only 3 match options for every move allowed.

very poor game experience, this is by far one of the most greedy games on the app store. they designed the game to force you to spend real money to be able to advance to the next level,you move a piece and it moves in the opposite direction of where you moved it. gives you what you need when you have 1 or 2 moves left because they want you to pay for more moves and buy the power ups. too bad you can't give negative ratings, horrible money hungry bastards messed up a game that could have been fun

This game was great, it was perfect relaxing, nice, but then you started to get hungry for money, and then started false advertising and I mean FALSE it showed completely different things when I first downloaded this game I was so happy it was amazing, I got bored of it and started playing different games, I got an ad for the game and thought wow they made the game alot different, nope the same. If you were mislead by the advertising please don't download.

Game was NOT like the ad. The ad looked more fun. I still played it for a while and it was OKAY until I couldn't beat a level without a power-up or the game decided to let me win. As the difficulty increased, choices generally became fewer and my frustration higher which I think is the whole point of the game so you buy power-ups to win. Finally I asked: why am I punishing myself playing this?

The game used to be fine, but the ads got so bad and inappropriate, that I am deleting the game in protest. And they added horrible minigames to make it look like the ads say the truth... the quality of the game slipped to match the awful ads. Absolutely offputting. This used to be my go-to match 3 game, but I want nothing to do with it anymore.

I loved this game at first, despite not getting to actually choose many of the items in the garden. The game had a great balance of difficulty and interest. But no more. Yes, games are supposed to get harder in higher levels, but they're not supposed to be impossible. I found my limit in level 934. There just aren't enough moves to complete it without monetary investments. It's not fun being stuck and seeing no way to proceed, and that makes this game like all the others, unfortunately.

I play this game from time to time and enjoy it from time to time as well. The reason I gave one star to this app is that the game makes it challenging and difficult to beat sometimes and after some frasturation you start paying money to beat certain levels. Sometimes you never get to pass levels without spending. This is a very dangerous game for younger or older.

When you download a game it is to be enjoyed. It is an escape to the one who chose to download it and play it. When its downright unplayable and not enjoyable whatsoever and just stuck for weeks on one YES ONE level its honestly ridiculous. Maybe if it was a playable game more would stick around. I am in the 6000s of levels and its the only game I ever play for over a year and im about to delete it. It isnt fun anymore. No wonder others delete it. WASTE OF TIME! KEEP UR TIME & $$$$ & sanity ppl

I am now at Level 1447. I have noticed that the difficult level comes on every 2nd game. In addition, the difficult games are impossible to complete without boosters and the countdown is short. 10-15 to complete a difficult level. I always have to wait 24-hrs to get 1 booster. I'm getting bored with loosing every 2nd game. I am seriously considering uninstalling this game.

Ok. So I have been playing this game since it came out. Here are my thoughts. And these apply to homescapes too. #1 no more decorations!? Events used to be actual decor for the garden. Now it's pay money for a stupid thing in the corner. #2 Streak breaker levels. If you know you know. #3 the false advertising for the games? Y'all are better than that. Overall not mad. Just disappointed. I don't mind spending a little money on the game, but lately? It's getting dumb..

False advertising! I downloaded the game because the ad I saw showed the gameplay as a game where you drag and drop tools and other other items to clean up and repair areas. Instead this is just another typical match 3 game. Uninstalling this lie of a game and not wasting another second of my time on it or any other game made by this developer.

This game is a scam. You will never win without purchases. No matter how you design your garden you are forced to play more games and to make changes to it. You have to keep getting things that are random and costly. You play challenge games to win coins inorder to complete the task. The catch you get maybe 100 coins and the rest are banked which your are required to purchase in order to use. Not fun and relaxing.

Game is fun for a 100 levels or so, then it turns into a money pit, can't progress without throwing real money at the game or struggling on levels constantly. Also, I'm not seeing the fun puzzle the game was advertised with (Like some sort of multiple choice on how to address problems, step on scorpion or spray it)... So if you got suckered into downloading this game for what the advertisement depicts your going to be disappointed like me. I will be uninstalling the game.

This game is pretty fun, and I like it a lot. The only problem I have is when you fail a level. You get the option to add five turns or concede, and if you hit concede you get an "Are you sure?" message and you have to concede again. My problem is that there is no "Are you sure?" message when you buy five turns and the buttons right next to each other, so if you mis-hit the five turns button your 900 coins are gone faster than OJ in a Bronco. I get they want us to spend and buy coins, but really

So, I get to level 7500, and I have lost daily spin, not getting magic hat or others similar boosts when win levels, I don't get training grounds, or team quests. I guess this makes not playing an easier decision. Dealing with Cup contests was bad enough when you run out of regular levels. Lot of puzzles for the Cups with lousy rewards while we wait for regular levels that you do 40 of at a time and don't last near as long as endless Cup puzzles. Making a decision to quit playing an easy choice.

I downloaded this because of the ads. It seemed like a problem solving, puzzle type of game. It's nothing like the ad. I mean absolutely nothing like the ad. It's Candy Crush. It's terrible and completely false advertising. It's like ordering a pair of Nike's and they send you a can if tuna instead. I don't understand why they would make ads for a game that doesn't exist.

Game was fun but now it seems like the only way to advance is to pay ie buy something. The regular levels now are very difficult and I also find it strange how sometimes I do no get the powerups for completing levels as if there is a cap to it. I'm tired of spending money and will find something else if no changes are made

This game while fun at times is designed to make you fail to purchase content. You are given a specific amount of turns per game on a level that is 100% random in terms of pieces. Once you get up in levels you are not given enough moves to possibly complete levels and forced to use coins which you would most likely purchase. The Ads for this game are misleading as it plays nothing like what you see. Its a matching game. You have to match 3+ of the same fruit to remove. Dont recommend

I love this game, Homescapes as well, The other thing I love about it is although you can spend real money, you dont have to spend it to progress in the game. Im also playing the fish one. adicted...?EDITED: I still love these game but i think when you get free time it should only tick down if your playing or its not much of a reward who has 3 or even 1 hr to play a game? I think if u have time dont let more be added but let it be played. EDITED: I took off a star as some levels far to hard.

Along with many other players, I'm very disappointed with this last update. I'm 15,535 levels in & I just want to play a matching game. Let me exit and restart the level to rearrange the fruit to the best configuration. Also, I don't like these "competitions" saying you're out of levels - yet we play levels (for no stars) in the mean time. It doesn't make sense. You can reuse levels from thousands of levels before. Please just let me play the game for stars so I can continue decorating!

Terrible game. The images and ads are misleading. They don't involve those puzzles and mind games. It's just another version of candy crush with some garden storytelling. Though the UI is good and the levels really get amazing as they get harder with a lot of boosters. But the story is awful and the ads and images about the game are misleading. I went till the sixth say and only 4 such puzzles. :/

Misleading Game, not what you see in the ads. Levels get very difficult to the point where it can take many many tries to pass a level to get one point and to accomplish certain tasks requires several points. Would seem the game is rigged to frustrate you to then spend actual money to get the tools to pass levels more easily. Can only attempt a few times in a row before u either wait 20 minutes to get a single life or pay game coin or real cash to keep going. Dont download not worth it.

False advertisements everywhere that is promoting the game as a different style than is. Plus, once you reach a "peek" noticed the matching game learns from you to stall out ability to win by a calculable numbers of moves to try and force in-game purchases to get that last move needed to beat the level. When you're stuck like that for a week with this mathematic cycle, it makes the game no longer fun to complete anything cause it wants to make you purchase something to complete someone you want.

The advertised content is a bait and switch. This is a match three game. Not the strategy game pictured. I have made it to level 664, but have spent way too much money to do so. Not free because at this point I've spent over $100. Two stars because it is engaging but falsely advertised. Unlimited lives would raise my rating.

The game rips me off my coins & hearts! I used coins to get more moves twice to beat a level. I beat it, and the moment I did, the game crashed, when it reloads, it has taken my coins & hearts but did NOT acknowledge that I've beaten the level! I spend more time on loading screen and dealing with crashes than actually playing the game. Some (a lot) levels are next to impossible to beat without coins and/or boosts (& they're not even the hard levels!).

This game requires no skill whatsoever, and I don't mean it as a complement. You are completely at the whim of luck as to what objects drop that you can use. It forces you to use hard to acquire items to complete levels in the obviously inadequate amount of turns alloted per level. Unless you like to spend ridiculous amounts of money on these pay-to-win games, you are destined to become frustrated long before you are entertained. I gave it one star only because I couldn't give it zero.

It was fun up until about level 1700, but even before that I noticed that it's a constant push to buy buy buy. Now, it's Every. SINGLE. LEVEL. The designers will bs you and say, oh we've made every level winnable. What they neglect to tell you is that nearly every level is only winnable if you purchase power-ups or continued play. The hard and extra hard levels are indistinguishable from the regular levels. I'm uninstalling.

Been playing long enough and well enough to reach level 1438, so I can assume i don't just suck at it. I have been stuck on this effing level for over a month. I keep popping in to use my lives, but just can not beat this level. I REFUSE to spend money, so I guess you're going to miss out on my ad clicks too. 2 stars because I enjoyed it up until now

I love this game. But some levels are way too hard. You lose all your boosters on the challenge stages if you lose - why not make those optional or give us a view of the level? The seasonal passes are good but also depends what stage you are at in the game and if you're prepared to spend more money on it so then not so good.

False Advertising!! I initially installed this game because of the ads I've seen (save the person by pulling the right pins) for it in another game. The real game was boring and didn't give you any real ability to decorate or anything. I removed the game a bit ago but finally (after I kept seeing that blasted as) decided to come back and leave a rating and review. If I could leave no stars, I would!

At level 5900. Thank you Gardenscapes for such a great game and great story line. Regretfully, I am about done though. The levels are just getting way too hard. I am increasingly unwilling to make increasing expenditures to keep things going. I will really miss Austin and friends even though they're just computer generated characters. Some things just become impractical after a while. For those of you just getting started, enjoy. But just know where you will stop when the time comes.

Initially really liked, found calming & would play for hours. However, noticed that, especially when I was in a guild and/or during a challenge that I wouldn't be able to pass a level unless I used up almost or everything I had. Then when challenge ends all of a sudden I can pass the level, easily, with no boosts. Also, they are really stingy. Played for only under a year and got the jackpot once. Even saw the wheel glitch a couple a times right out of it. Just not fun anymore.

Amazing game. There are no glitches! Interesting design options keep me striving for another item. I have been playing this game for years. My only complaint is that I often get stuck. I work 2 jobs and have very little time to play. There are lots of chances to spring forward though. You should check it out! 👍👍💗😎 I am sad to sad i just purchased a new phone and list all my progress. i feel really bumbed about this. wow. 😨

It's been on every phone I've had since launch. Edit: I haven't played since 2020, really. I stopped because it felt like I was paying for a new decoration every month, and I have to agree with other, more recent, reviews. The game is fun, but up to a certain point I became completely disinterested in the levels and game play, and just wanted the story. Its just not the same as it was years ago..

I agree that the advertisements for this game are inaccurate. This is a matching game & it should be advertised as such. However, I do enjoy the game itself. I like that there are multiple challenges every few days that reward you with extra help to beat future levels. I take advantage of unlimited lives whenever possible. I have not spent a single penny on this game & I'm at level 1300. You don't need to spend money to play.

This game is really just a worse challenge version of bejeweled, candy crush, others like it. A fun puzzle and test of perseverance? It doesn't reset the same everytime, so it's really just a game that's based partially on luck and high difficulty, hoping you lose patience and pay money for bonuses that they give out too infrequently otherwise. The jewel part of the game is what matters for stars to advance, and you rarely get the mini games that looked fun as advertised. Don't even download it

Terrible game unless you are into spending money every 5 minutes. They make certain levels impossible to pass unless you buy coins which allow you to continue play to be able and finish the level. Deleting the game completely..glad I didnt give them any money! I have played a few playrix games and they are not for me.

Fake Fake Fake. I got this app because of the endless ads for it where you fix rooms and problems by choosing the correct tool. Looked silly but fun. Started playing the game and it's just a boring colour match game with endless micro transactions. Emailed to ask when the advertised levels would appear and was told that it's not that kind of game and they are "sorry for the inconvenience caused by the ads", sorry my foot, I still see endless ads about this game that doesn't exist.

I truly enjoy the game in that its equally challenging and at times easy going. The longest I've been stuck on a level was 4 days and that alone keeps me coming back. I do, however, have one thing I've hoped you'd have changed by now and that is that "I" get to choose where AND when I use my boosters. I hate needing to use more than 1 booster a game because most of the time they show up to close to each other and when I use explosives, I've basically wasted one of them.

This is my third review! The other 2 has been deleted! Again! The ad for this game is misleading. It does not represent what the game is about. After a certain levels you wont be able to complete levels so you have to use help but if you run out of them you have to spend real life money to get more. Avoid at all cost

They have made a very bad game. After playing 2 or 3 levels, you reach a hard level. Then after playing 2 or 3 levels, you reach a super hard level. Then after playing 2 or 3 levels, you reach a special level. And after clearing everything, what do you get? Collect 900 coins and everything is finished in one go. I have uninstalled it for the last time and will never install it again.

Starts out okay, but definitely not as advertised. It's a totally different game than any of the adds led me to believe. I'm four days in and already stuck on a level because I can't get the required items without paying. Seems to me this is just a money grab without the advertised game options anywhere in sight. I'll give it a week and see if anything changes.

I like the concept of the game but some of the levels are literally impossible to beat without having to pay real money to buy power ups, that's a bit scammy therefore I uninstalled. I get that you want to make money off your app but come on. Make the levels a bit easier or make the power ups cheaper. 900 coins for 5 extra turns, but you only win about 60 coins for beating the level. Ridiculous.

The ads bated me with interesting puzzles to solve, but those appeared only during the first few rounds of play. I stopped playing because I came to a round where I spent about 50 USD to get through. Obviously, others had succeeded, but if I'm going to spend that much money, I'd rather just buy a game and play it....

I have been playing this for a while and I really enjoy the game but I think the events are too difficult to complete. I would like it if there were separate levels for the event instead of having to complete my current levels to earn points towards an event. I find the high levels to be quite challenging and so I am never able to beat enough to get an event completed. I tracked it once where I didn't spend stars focusing only on event points, had 72 stars and STILL hadn't finished the event.

It's just NOT worth it.....This a game is fun, "BUT" you only get 1 star per level completed, and when your trying to build your garden which something takes 2 stars, it takes forever. And the higher the levels, as you know, it becomes more difficult to complete. Not worth it at all.

I love it. Honestly my only major annoyance is when a level requires you to get butterflies, and you only have a few more moves left and there are NO BUTTERFLIES on the field. I waste moves just waiting for another butterfly to enter to get a chance to get it! Argh! But other than that, yeah, I love this game. I close my eyes and see tiles of fruits. No joke.

Decent enough game. Hard and only suitable for those that really like a challenge. A lot of patience is needed. The occasional need to spend some money does come up, but not in large amounts (a buck here or there). Constantly being asked to rate the game (even after doing so) is highly annoying (please stop).

Not at all what was advertised. The ads make it look like a bunch of mini-puzzle games. No, it's a Candy Crush wannabe game surrounded by a time-wasting, money hungry story. I don't care for games like Candy Crush and I don't care for this game at all. Next time, just advertise the truth and I won't bother with the game or the negative review.

It is all about the money now. They have diminished the rewards you receive. It is so minimal now. You need to use your power ups all the time to pass a level. I have this on my iPad, and the last update took most of my won avatars. Also, it is the same 'adventures' weekly. I liked it when they did the merge games and got new/different decorations for the house. I wouldn't waste my time or money on this anymore.

Tired of match games! i played this game, as well as homescapes, for about a month and then uninstalled them both. im so tired of great games having the "matching" games to earn a bench or couch. Cant you figure something else out to earn items? These two games are fun as far as repairing things and designing rooms. you have ads that make us choose items for certain problems in the game, those are fun. Matching game= NO FUN!!!! Such ashame.. please change.

Candy Crush has done this before and still does, but better (and I don't even like CC that much). The advertisements for the game are completely misleading. It pretends to be a puzzle game when it's just trying pathetically to be Candy Crush. I get it in terms of advertisement, this isn't the first time to be another game but worse, but have your advertisements for the game be actual game play. Even EA does that.

I used to truly enjoy this game, but at level 190+ (where I have literally spent MONTHS on trying to complete individual levels) the game is now honestly just pay to play. I don't mind spending actual money in a game, but when each level is costing $5.00 or more to just be able to complete it and move on to the next, it's honestly just not worth it to me anymore. I am going to be uninstalling this app today, and it makes me sad, but I am done with the overall cash sucking disaster its become.

This is such a misleading game; do not download it! As so many people have written, the main game is actually the matching game (like Candy Crush) and after some time, there is no way to pass levels without paying for extra tools. Do not be fooled by them. Shame on these people for the false advertising: you rarely get to play those minigames. (Those are minigames titled, "help Austin make sense of his dream" and if you pass it, you get a reward going towards the matching game!).

Recent updaes have made this game so challenging that it is obvious that the developers are expecting people to pay to play. For instance, my current level has 17 moves to collect 40 items - 32 requiring more than 1 match. There is no way that is going to happen without multiple boosters. Since I am strictly a "free" player, my only strategy is to play the same level over and over and over (dozens of times!) until the algorithim finally allows me to complete it. THIS IS NOT FUN!!!!!

Takes too long to get through a task without spending money. The green items that you have to get have to be on the silver (at least one) in order to get them. Deleted game before because of this and considering it again. Can't afford to keep buying coins. Won't be long and I will be deleting this game again along with homescapes.

I have been playing Homescapes forever (currently on level 2500), but would get stuck often waiting for more lives, so I decided to try Gardenscapes to pass the times when I'm stuck. I'm currently on level 225, and have been surprised at how different the games play. This one is much easier to level up, even though it doesn't include a lot of the matching powerups from Homescapes. It also has a ridiculous amount of contests to make making money and earning stars go super fast. Still, a fun game!

It's no longer fun. I've spent more time playing levels over and over because they're too difficult to beat. You loose boosters easily. Once I beat a level or two then I'm stuck for days and days. I've bought a few golden tickets and the rewards are expensive to earn. To build your garden up takes too many stars and the adventure levels use way too many lightning bolts and offer little value in return. I'm no longer having fun.

It's a very fun and addictive game. I don't like how long it takes to accumulate stars. If you all could consider making the harder levels worth more stars, and consider adding stars on the lucky spin. You could also add stars to a purchase package? Update 8/25/22, Still playing, not as much as I used to, I just think about how far I've gone and don't want to give up.

Sucks. Costs money to keep playing. Constantly trying to get you to buy tokens and invite friends. The ad for the game looks like it's a cool solve the puzzles, kind of game with funny animated situations. You only get to play those scenarios after you have achieved a level and it takes tokens to achieve levels.

Love this game have been playing for quite a while now and not bored yet. I agree with the many other reviews that some levels are extremely hard to complete without power ups which are expensive to buy. Love the side events they have made it five 🌟 game for me instead of a four 🌟. Keep making it interesting and I'll keep playing 😊........ A year on and have enjoyed the game and have spent a bit of money. But time to give it up, levels are too hard UNLESS you spend money. Bye

I don't really know how to rate. I love to playing but lately it won't load. When it does it is slow and gets stuck. Have to shut down . I have spent over a hundred dollars only to hit the play on and it takes my coins and locks up. I deleted this game and reloaded it. Now it will not even open. After all the time and money I have spent it makes me furious 😤 as of 4/4./21 still having same issue. Game freezes have to go all the y WY out and try again

There are stages where you won't win until the game decides that you will. It's not skill, it's 101% "luck". So you have to wait until you get, say, 30 min of infinite lives and rush as many attempts at a level as you can. Some levels 100% force you to spend coins to get more lives. When the game doesn't do that, it's actually really fun. But that's so infuriating when it does, that it almost doesn't make up for it.

While it's an interesting game, it has a few irritating points. First off, their ads mislead you into thinking it's a survival game but in reality it's a item matching kind of game. 2nd, if you need an extra life to finish a game you have to pay as much as you pay for 5 lives. 3rd, some levels are just plain unfair, e.g: to eliminate butterflies, or dynamites etc. the game doesn't give you the required amount immediately, you have to waste a turn to make it happen. Please correct these dev!

I've been playing for almost 8 years and what drew me in was the smooth graphics and animations that made me feel cozy. After the last update everything is bright, ugly and plastic-looking and the new explosion animations are nauseating, not nearly as satisfying as before. The game now looks like a loud, aggressive slot machine and not chill and inviting like before. I could ignore it before but the imposing of in-game purchases has become more aggressive lately and it's really off-putting.

It is indeed a good game ,quite interesting and exciting for me! But lately I've been facing a weird issue today all day. I'm at level 2100+ and the game wouldn't allow me to play or do anything on screen! It is just stuck on one scenary with nothing to do about it. It is really annoying for me! I would appreciate an explanation and somehow a solution to my problem! Other than that, I appreciate the company's effort and creation. I do happen to enjoy their games.

It's an amazing game, very addictive. BUT it is super hard. No free in game credits to give you a boost. The game gives you little moves and time to complete the tasks. After level 70 it took me at least 10 times to get a level completed but on average it takes 20 lives. Play it if you don't believe me and read the other reviews.

This was nothing like the ad. I thought once I got the garden set up it would be the "use logic to help the player survive" experience in the ad but I just ended up planting flowers, cleaning, upgrading furniture, and playing a cheap bejeweled knockoff. It's not a bad app but it's not my thing. It shouldn't have been advertised as something that is a minor part of the game if anything. I played over 20 levels of the gem game I have yet to see the help save the people game I saw in the ad.

I really like this game. I had an issue with not receiving a reward and I contacted support and they responded quickly and gave me my reward. The only reason I'm not giving it 5 stars is because I do think you need to spend money to buy power ups because some levels are very hard without them and you don't win enough to help with those levels. Not everyone can spend money so their progression will be stalled. Other than that it's a great game, the puzzles are fun, and decorating is fun too.

Look at youtube video and you will see now there are often (maybe always) 6 less moves in the levels I checked. You must rely only on luck now. Its killing the game. No point of playing if the only way to pass the level is by buying bonuses... too bad... And please stop showing kids it's good to cut trees to put sculptures !!!

I've been playing off and on since 2017. It's still a great game to revisit. I thought I'd lost my save but the two times I connected to Facebook it didn't connect so I tried again and it's back. However much I dislike timed puzzles, I still enjoy a good challenge once in a while.

it very seldom lets you win tokens or move ahead without spending real money! stupid! even if you buy coins it cost so many of them to continue. if it weren't for this.. it would be a very fun game. Over a weeks time..I have spent over 60.00 (stupid..i know) and the levels are so hard you can't beat them without help! who ever designed this game sucks!!!!

The game was fun at first. Then I only got to the level of the fountain, sweeping the yard, & planting the garden. Then all of a sudden there was no more duties, after completing the puzzles. I prefer CSR racing 1&2 & Empires and allies & bubble pop & word puzzle. Disappointing.

I was enjoying the game until I came across some levels that are unbelievable. I surpassed 2 by restarting my phone, and a completely different level showed up. I won't be trying any of the other playrix games.

I kept seeing ads for this and all its variations. The ads make it seem like it's a choose your way out of situations by giving you multiple options below the scenario. It's not the game that was advertised. It's a three matching game. Super fun for the first day you play and then the levels get incredibly difficult that you have to spend money on to even get a chance of winning. I've been on this level for like 2 days and it's extremely frustrating. Very little reward. Many other similar games that are better in my opinion.

The game is advertised as a puzzle game of trying to figure out what way to not have someone get hurt, instead it's literally just a candy crush knockoff with building your "garden". Basically winning a game gives you one gold star to do anything on the list of chores and fix ups around the place. FALSE ADVERTISING basically like every one else has said.

This game begin to lag so bad when using powerups i can't even play it like before because of this, it's ridiculous. Extreme lagging only when using the powerups i just close the game. Game used to be great. But after 1. Increasing prices 2. Decreasing rewards 3. Pushing dishonest ads in other games 4. Pushing heavier monetization practices and now 5. Just be honest! I constantly see the ads depicting one game and I had a feeling that it wasn't to be true. I only downloaded this so that I could write a review. When I first started playing this game I really enjoyed it, then the updates started, since then the game takes forever to load, if I'm lucky I may be able to play one or two levels and I get the green screen, reload, reload, reload, reinstall, reinstall, reinstall, had to reinstall again, now I can't download, says pending. love this game! every level is fun and I love that you don't have to purchase anything to get past levels, you just have to have patience and try again. I am uninstalling this game. The challenges are unattainable if you don't spend money. The puzzles are frustrating. All a game of chance and there are no chances to get through sometimes. Downloaded this game thinking it was something it is not. Great game, spent lots of time playing and appreciate the lack of ads... HOWEVER... As stated by others in the review - DO NOT - I REPEAT - DO NOT EVER SPEND ANY MONEY ON THIS GAME. Would be higher because its an enjoyable game. It just gets frustrating when you play the same puzzle 15 times and its clear each time when you have no chance to win without forking over more and more money. Some puzzles have too many obstacles with the limited moves you get. I downloaded this game because the ads lead you to believe this a unique "stop the disaster" game. In reality it is a puzzle game that you must pass the levels to continue the story. The newest update is terrible. I can't even move forward into the game to get back where I was. I played this game for years but my disappointment never escalated until recently. The level became harder than ever after the first time i purchased golden ticket. First off I'm only rating it with 1 star due to advertisement. Its the most annoying thing ever. Starting the advertisment with the scream is irritating to no end. Okay, so for starters, i am writing this review because of the new ad that was released. This game is really fun and i have been playing it for several months. Thanks~

It's is just like other match 3 and remodel games. What sets it apart for me is the team aspect. I love working as a team. And you need help because it seems like many of the levels are just too hard to pass with the number of moves given. There are "hard" levels and that's fine, but even the regular levels are sometimes almost impossible without spending money. After many tries I think you should be able to skip it and move on. It's not fun to play the same level 50+ times.

Great! .... Until it's not. You cruise along until you hit one level that you can't seem to beat without boosters. BUT WAIT! You can BUY boosters. Lame cash grab. Honestly, I'd be okay with paying a one time fee for this game if it came with extra boosters and infinite lives. But getting stuck at a level for over an entire day is not fun or relaxing.

It's a good game when you can get a good run. But being at the higher levels, every level is hard or superhard. Or, the pointless pink levels that are just there to ensure you lose your boosters. Most of the levels you need to pay to get through it, and even then having all 3 boosters isn't enough. Rubbish. So many times I open the game and I suddenly get a time of free game play, but that's not always a time I can play, so it's wasted. Pointless to have a game you can't play. Deleting.

The game is absolutely nothing like the ad they keep running on facebook that lets you "play a level without downloading." Total false advertising and very deceptive. Games that do this should be banned. Makes you wonder what else they lie about.

Love love love this game. Love the way you can talk to the dude....love how you can change your stuff around. The games are challenging, wish you won more money....some of the levels are extremely hard. Hard to complete task. Some levels are TOO hard, especially if you can't spend money to get boosters. As many others have discovered, I found this game to be a "bait and switch" exercise in disappointment. However, I'm not a 5-year old with parents who don't care what kind of game charges their kid wracks-up. Uninstalling, and will not even consider the other games by this developer.

Originally 5, now 2. Are they under new management? The ads for the game are completely wrong. You have to match rows of at least three (think Candy Crush) to complete different puzzles. The game itself is fun! But the levels are now nearly impossible unless you use a powerup. They are provided via challenges (and forced tornaments) weekly, but are purposefully placed in the most inconvenient spot so you lose then pay money to continue on. Went from recommending the game to calling it trash.

A decent match 3 game. Great art for the decorating portions... horrifying, Uncanny Valley art for the humans, which like to stare directly into the camera and your soul. Also, repetetive events get spammed every time you open the app, leading to a lot of unnecessary, annoying clicking through them just to get to thr actual game. Not worth the fuss imo.

I used to play this game a lot. Once I realized how much money & time I was wasting on it, I decided to uninstall it. Then Fetch offered a ton of points for playing it, so I reinstalled it. Coins are expensive & the amount you earn per level is ridiculously low. I have no choice but to quit playing again. GREEDY, GREEDY, GREEDY!

I have played this game for quite awhile found it to be frustrating at times as some levels were so hard to beat. The usual match-3, pay-to-win dross plaguing the mobile gaming scene at the moment. Those aspects are fine, and maybe even better than average, but the low rating is earned by the ads for the game. Basically, they depict situational puzzles and looked worth a try. In reality, they don't exist in the game and are just a hook to get you to download another boring match-3 grind that pesters you constantly to exchange real-world $$$ for in-game points and meaningless shinies. Uninstalled.

Im still playing the game as its a good way to kill some time. If you're looking for a fun relaxing game this isnt the one. Some times the game glitches and you move a piece one way but itll go a different way causing you to lose the game. The higher level you reach the more money you will need to spend on passing the levels.

Looks like they're back to their old bait and switch habits. Sadly I fell for their add that promised that they would have the puzzles mini games. Problem was at around level 35, the puzzle mini games went poof like a fart in the wind. Before level 35, it was alternating between the standard match game and the puzzles which I could live with. After level 35 it turned into a straight match game, no more puzzles. Don't bother with downloading this game if you thought they'd be giving you puzzles.

I used to love playing this game, been playing for awhile. Didn't mind the every so often in game purchase. Learned long ago that Playrix (makers of the game) are ALL about money. You end up spending a fortune trying to get a head in levels. Needs more chances to extend play, like more chances to get the power helpers. Levels seem too hard to succeed unless you have or pay for the extra helpers. Bonus items/actions should carry over to next game play, like unused bombs, etc. Too many times to push buttons for next set.

Downloaded cuz I saw ads of the fun minigames, it is appearantly just a match puzzle, if the ratio was aight would've kept it. Game is what it is, I'm just disappointed since it's not at all as the advertisements I've seen.

It's frustrating because you have to use several lives and take days to beat some levels. Depending in the time you spend. Be aware that the farther you go in the levels, the fewer moves you'll get. And game makers have changed moves provided in the last several years. One level that had 25 moves in 2019 had 17 moves by 2020 and now has 13 moves in 2023. It's a push toward more in-app purchases, but it's only convinced me to delete the game. There's no point in playing if I can't pass a regular level for several days - and the next level is a Challenge mode level that destroys any gained boosters. Not my idea of fun

THIS GAME IS A SCAM. I cannot describe how angry this game makes me. The ads are a completely different game!! The real game is an uneventful candy crush type of matching game. Don't download if your expectations are based on the ads, or better yet, don't download at all! Its sad that your game is so boring that you make a fake game for ads.

So an updated review. I really enjoyed this game in the beginning even though the ads were misleading. False advertising. This game is one of those f2p games that they advertise on Facebook. I'm all for advertising. I could find great stuff. The game sucks. Most of the levels are impossible to get through from the first time (levels 4000 and up) unless you spend real money. It used to be very enjoyable game. Finally putting this game to an end. Got to lever 1996. Had to clear 4 glasses and dynamites. When playing the game will only drop 3 dynamites. Been playing this game since 2017 and honestly it's my favorite phone game. Normally I do a lot of RPGs and MMOs but this is a nice change and keeps my busy during my down time. Feel like i get stuck on each level, i'm achieving nothing fast. the chests used to be easier to get to the best one, now it takes longer. Have been playing this game since COVID 19 lockdown. It was fun back then. Currently at 8416 and it gets frustratingly annoying after level 8000. Stop making every single level so hard to beat. Some of the red levels are next to impossible until you lose at it so many times or you use cheats. After playing for 6+ years i might delete the game after all. It's nearly impossible to pass a level without using power ups (even with them it's still hard to pass one) or spending gold for more moves (almost every time im one move away from finishing the level). Also there is no more treasure hunt only magic hats that bring way less rewards.. You ruined the game so much, it brings only stress when it was made to relieve one...

Honestly this game would be cool if you didn't have to spend actual money to get to the next levels. But if you don't have coins to buy moves you have to spend money to get more. Only reason I'm still trying is to earn points for a different game. Definitely deleting when I get those.

Awful. Designed only to make you spend money. Can't be won without extras no matter what they tell you. Did not use to be this way. It use to be challenging but fun. Now it's just a money grab. Challenge levels are only there to take away your hard earned boosters, so you will buy more. I paid for a pass, can't even finish it because the levels are so hard, and I've played for years. Sorry guys but this game is impossible.You should learn from King. Candy crush is still so addictive after so many levels. I have the feeling that this game was created with the sole purpose that we should pay to pass the levels. It's a shame because it can be a very good and funny game.

If there were two modes, one to pass the time, and one to advance and earn coin/boosts, I could see myself playing it more often...

False Advertisement! I was drawn to the game by the advertisements showing adventures where one would need to help the characters -- decide which tools to use to put out a fire, escape an animal, or other situations. The review you see and what the game actually is, is deceiving. It's something like candy crush and u earn couns to fix up the garden. No solving a getaway. No maize! Some of the games are to freaking hard. It's like if you don't have real money to spend sometimes your just stuck. Stull. Upset at group challenges, remodels, any seasonal challenges. All dont give you enough time to complete. Pink challenge game takes all your achievements, hinders passing of levels. I can not agree more with the "taking the fun out of the game" comment. With the level of, you can beat this level when you purchase something. Tricked to install. Thought it was a trap game to try to figure out how not to kill the guy. So I was duped into this candy crush style game. You will get hooked. They make it difficult to pass and will force you to buy coins if you let it. Play the same level many times and they will eventually let you pass by arranging the items to your benefit. Will probably delete soon as it gets boring trying many times over to pass. Update - 4/6/2020 - got tired of all the bs. Uninstalled and feel free.

Id give 5 stars but...one, they advertise a much different puzzle game. Two, once you hit a certain level it becomes basically impossible to move on without using the help tools. Which eventually drives you into a corner where you have to buy stuff to continue or be stuck. I spent days using all my lives to try to pass and eventually gave up.

It's a match puzzle game ala "candy crush" and it's not terrible for what it is. My 1 star is because their ad is entirely misleading and the game is nothing like what they advertise. I thought the idea of a escape puzzle was cool, I did not expect 14 candy crush puzzles to meet me before I realized it was all a farse. FALSE ADVERTISING, remove the ads or take the game down.

Still playing!!Great game! Puzzles are challenging! I enjoy the interaction with butler and his friends page.super cute to read his posts and pictures. I enjoy fixing up and choices of what things should look like as far as color and what flowers. Only thing I'd add is butterflies and birds maybe fish in fountain. But im still early in game never know what ill unlock! keep up good work!

Great fun and can be quite addicting! Overall it's a very interesting yet simple game (in a good way of course!) The hard and super hard levels come very frequently though and I just can't help but wish there was even more ways to gain quick boosters. Witty storyline too and perhaps some unexpected plot twists would add to all the fun! #stilllovinit 😀

I play this game for a long time now and I recently purchased the Golden Ticket to progress faster and get more out of playing. Turns out that I wasted my money. Every third level is a hard one and I am stuck for days with no gold or items. Clearing lvls turns into a thing of luck, eventhough I spent actual money on this game which should give me an advantage, at least a small one, somehow. I also got the wrong event recently. It's frustrating and I will probably stop playing soon.

Fun game to play and challenging as you move forward. Sometimes, it's so hard to beat a level I fall into buying coins. Also, I continue a level over and over again, strategizing how to get around it without buying more coins. That requires patience. I have 3 stars because it will not allow me to continue to play without updating. I'm not able to free up enough space at this time.

What a crock, I played this for an hour and so far there's no action like the ads show. I thought I would be helping a character escape difficult situations, instead it's some candy crush like game. I never got into the endless candy puzzle games. I would give it 0 stars if possible for completely misrepresenting what the game is. Piss on your silly puzzles.

The game is fun at first and the graphics are neat but after a while the levels get impossible. The harder levels do not give you enough moves causing you to either pay for extra moves with game money, or other things with real money. Also, since these levels are so difficult, you lose lives easily and it takes 30 minutes for just once life to renew.

Don't be fooled. I had this game installed and still see ads for it where you pull pins. It is so falsely advertised it is ridiculous. My opinion is "liars." It is a cheap, cheesy game and nothing like they show. And I see an ad and it says only so many people can complete the levels. I never saw the levels they displayed. And they tell you how many downloads they have. Probably almost as many of uninstalls.

Waste of time. Advertised as a completely different game than what it is & it's ridiculously unrealistic. Each level gives you a goal of collecting a certain # of things but only gives a tiny amount of moves to do so. Example; one of the levels has the goal of collecting 50 leaves & 40 flowers. You have to grow the flowers by the batch (which takes 3 moves minimum per batch), and you only have 27 moves to complete all of this. You only get 5 lives & must wait 30 min to regain 1 life. UNINSTALL

This game is an example of how gambling addiction begins and why it's an endless cycle. You have to keep on purchasing items within the game to keep this inane garbage going on. If I could I would have given it zero ratings. Don't spend your hard earned money on buying game coins to achieve a goal that has absolutely zero achievement in real life.

I really like this game but I there are a few features that could really come in handy. For example, being able to pause the time won as rewards to be able to use at later time if you wanted to take a break from playing. Currently, there is no option for that, if you won about 30m, 1, 2 or 3hrs, it just runs down (countdown) whether or not your playing.

Some levels are obscenely difficult which may lead some players to get stuck for days. Infinite life rewards are immediate and often occur at inopportune times. Mundane tasks such as answering the door takes stars. Ads show item choice scenarios with problem solving as part of the game. Its not. If they allowed level skipping, this would allow less skilled players to progress, but not get all the rewards. Also add the choice of when to start infinite life rewards, this game would be much better.

Money grabbing game. It was great in the beginning but after getting into pass first level or garden you have to play games for every single task. The game even make unnecessary tasks so you can spend more money. Like a cat mysteriously get stuck up a tree and you have to pay for that. Then they are tasked that you have to do twice because the first one wasn't good enough. Example the fountain. I got it done but then the pump didn't work even after I played to get it fix up the first time.

Fun game to pass the time. With the recent update the pieces start flashing almost immediately to show you a possible move. I wish they would either give you the option to disable this or at least have a 5 second minimum before it flashes, it's really annoying and when you're trying to look for the best move, I don't need some flashing pieces to distract me. Other than that it's fun.

I don't like the fact that I was trying to play a puzzle solving game like in the demos it shows and I was let go this game, not cool and very misleading, falsifying pretty much, still looking for a puzzle solving game, some of the levels are way too difficult and time consuming especially if you get the 30min or higher infinite lives. I am enjoying the game disregarding the issues I stated.

False Advertising!!!! The ads for this game show it as a choosing game. Where you are attempting to help various people in different scenarios survive or escape danger. When you download the game it just a matching game, where you get stars for completing a level then use that start to " fix" something in the garden. Such as sweeping or picking out new benches. There is no scary clown chasing someone that you are trying to help escape. There is no family stranded in the attic. Hate This Game!

The later levels, for the most part, have absolutely nothing to do with skill. They are basically crooked pachinko games, forcing the player to play the same level for hours until the computer takes pity and solves the level. I'll revise my rating when this actually becomes a playable game again. Oh, and the gas cannisters? Worst game design I've ever seen. Update: your tips are laughable, and my earlier post stays true. Not impressed.

I have a love/hate relationship with this game. It's a great time killer and fun, but sometimes the Hard or Super Hard levels are ridiculously impossible without powerups. But, if it were all easy I probably wouldn't play it anymore because it would be boring. I'm at level 721 after just 2 months. seriously, you can become an addict waking up at 2am when your lives refill just to play again.

Some of the Super Hard Levels take days to beat don't keep throwing bombs and and power up at them. There is a problem playing the treasure hunt at the water park. I have found all 40 chest but the game keeps posting 39. I found an online map that shows where they are all marked and went through it 5 times even marking for each chest on a piece of paper. You should fix this. Other than that great game.

Game is nothing like its ads! No logic puzzles. It is a builder theme, restoring a mansion . You must complete Candy Crush type boards to pass levels. Otherwise, an engaging game. Drawbacks: higher levels nearly impossible to beat without in-app purchases. Really do not design your own garden. The butler makes all of the decisions. You just occasionally choose a colour or style of an item. Takes 2 1/2 hours to refill 5 lives. Unless, of course, you purchase them. Better than most!

Mandatory Contests made me give up. I really enjoyed this game and building my garden. There were challenging levels, sure, but that's made it fun instead of just flying through levels. At first the contests weren't constant, so if I wanted to play I did, if I didn't I took a day or two break. But now the contests are back to back and there's NO WAY to opt out. So I finally uninstalled the game, which is ashame because it was really fun.

I did a review for this a long time ago. I ended up deleting it for a while because I got bored of the matching games. I downloaded again because I saw the ads about the puzzles and thought it had been changed. The ads are nothing like the game at all. Its a match 3, earn points, follow the story. You get so many lives to spend playing the levels, and the you earn points to move forward. Its not like the ads where you're supposed to choose which option will let you move forward.

I enjoy choosing the way things get made. The game play is fine. It requires buying coins to get past certain levels, but that's pretty typical. There are glitches intermittently; the whole game just shuts off sometimes, especially when you have all of the helping tools. I do find it obnoxious that the ads for the game show that there are mini games; there are not. At least not at this time.

Edit: The ads I've seen lately falsely advertise how the game is played. Please don't let the ads ruin the impression of such a fun match 3 game. I've played long before those ads showed up. I liked that I can put together a garden as well as play a classic puzzle game. Highly recommend it. One thing i would like to add, please allow the option to not have unlimited hearts to apply automatically. I would like to use them when i have the time to play instead of wasting that bonus.

Love this game so much and have been playing it for a very long time now! The only thing that drives me nuts is when it seems like the game is trying to prevent you from beating a level. I'll often get to where I should easily be able to finish a level on the first try, but then the fireworks just seem to "forget" to go for the right pieces, or no more acorns will drop (or whatever the requirements are to fulfil) for the last 5 moves. Otherwise, I'm on lvl 1695 and I haven't spent a dime!

I really like this game, but over time it becomes a bit boring to play games with the same pattern on each level (even with different levels of difficulty). I hope the developer will add some short games options as alternative, or maybe make a different type of game for each level (like puzzel, find objects, find the differences, problem solving, logic, etc.)

Always love these games, have played them all but this one is challenging. Just when you think you might pass the level your out of turns. I have been stuck on some levels for days before advancing. I am a little frustrated on the special events because I can never get very far, the higher levels are much more challenging puzzles. Amazing graphics and always new areas!

Update: 6/11/19 - The game has been crashing all weekend and into today so far 5 days total now. I'm assuming there's something wrong with the server because Homescapes (the developers other game) won't open at all! Frustrating...please fix! Original post: Great little game, very addicting. Love the new puppy feature with the separate puzzles. However, I feel there is a slight overkill with how many stars are needed for some of the challenges. Overall, I'm a fan.

As others have pointed out, the game is nothing like the many ads that I have seen. The ads show a problem solving game with actions and consequences. The game starts with candy crush style puzzles. You finish puzzles and upgrade a house. I looks like it will take hours of play time to get it the puzzle in the ad. Not worth it.

It's not a bad game at all. HOWEVER, I don't particularly like when I'm trying to stack these hard to come by coins and I'm prompted to purchase a booster and inadvertently purchase them when hastily trying to quick click past the message leaving me to trudge along trying to collect coins again. I get that the goal is micro transactions but I'm not paying for a free game.

I like the idea of combining two different games into one. But the game is really slow in two ways. First it's literally slow. It takes 30 seconds to go from one level to another. Second the progress of decoration is also slow. I played more then 200 levels but I only decorated 2 gardens. There are very unrelated tasks that you have to complete rather than decorating and it takes a lot of time.

I'm updating my review from 2016 to adjust the new updates of the game. I always have a lot of fun with this game and I appreciate the difficulty in levels. I am very displeased with these new "challenge" levels. These levels are impossible to beat without putting all boosters on and even then it isn't guaranteed. If you don't use any boosters and lose you also lose ALL of your progress from the hat or the chest which then puts you back at square one. It's getting quite annoying.

This is a standard match-three game, despite some of the ads on other games that show it as a pin-pull game. The game is fun - I like the stories, the special events and the ability to create (for the most part) personalised garden. But it is almost impossible to complete some levels without spending money on "coins." The amount won per game (50) is grossly disproportionate to the amount needed to pay for power ups (900+). Becomes less and less fun to have to play the same level over and over.

Advertising needs to be honest. I downloaded the game thinking it was puzzle sorts. But it's just another candy crush with some playing around with the garden. Plus I am stuck where I am forced to buy a garden decoration compulsorily. It just doesn't have option to close the popup. For getting a puzzle which appears once in a long while, you have to play candy crush all the while and decorate garden, that's not something you show in the ad. Deleting it.

It's was fun at first but I find the pace for developing the garden way too slow. Even if you buy items for an event you basically have have to put your life aside to collect all the perks (and you may still not make it in time) which is ridiculous. I'd gladly pay for the game outright but with all in app purchase games when I do the math on the cost over time I could buy a small house over the course of a of couple of years... Even with the regular "discounts".

Sets you up to spend money. The levels you see in the ads are in-between matching levels. Game has beautiful graphics and an interesting story. It's fairly easy to play until you get to level 418. There is no way to beat this level without boosts. The only other way to get boosts outside of beating levels is to buy them. A total rip off. I was thoroughly enjoying the game until this point. Don't waste your time or storage space. 👎

I am on level 1562 and never once had to spend real money to continue to play, I really like this and is very addictive. However I do agree with other people about the fake ads, why would they make ads for a game that is not even part of the game. Matchington mansion is the same way fake ads. I play gardescapes and homescapes and love them both, but i wanted something different and if they actually made a game with what the ads show that would be great, because it looks fun and challenging.

I really enjoy this game. However as I progress into upper levels, they are really hard to beat. Even the "easy" levels. I can't complete the seasonal house decorations or the room renovations because I can't beat enough levels. Some levels now take days to beat. I'm starting to think about quitting the game because I can't make headway in the special events.

It's too slow moving with garden options, which is why I downloaded it. I'd prefer more garden options and simplifying options as well. The algorithm is really rigged on some levels, especially when there are no side challenges to give help. I really don't like playing the same level over and over an entire day or being promoted to spend money when it knows I have in the past.

The rewards are a bit skimpy and I think for some of the levels, especially the hard ones there should be at least 2 or more stars given and the amount of coins needed to buy things and continue should be lessened, or more than 3 needs to be available for the current cost, since it's so hard to accrue coins without spending so much real cash. Other than that the game is great.

2017: After playing this for quite a while I can definitely say it's addictive. The only drawbacks, for me, is I would rather be able to replay levels because some of them are pretty cool and eventually they get repetitive. And it would be more motivating if it didn't take a million stars to do every little task. Also, I sometimes start hoping Austin gets run over by one of the passing vehicles. Edit 2023: ugh

Three stars should be awarded for super-hard levels, two for hard levels and one for ordinary levels. Reduce the number of stars required to carry out a task. 4/5 is way too many especially when there are two stages to some tasks. It's also really annoying that you can't decide when to use the free lives bonuses, they are applied immediately to your game. It would be great if these could be saved for use at a later time

Like the game, I'd play more. Love when the flower came, made it more interesting. Infinity lives let's me play longer. Shouldn't have to work so hard to start the next day, after all, you completed the level... Not enthusiastic about the new options for purchase with bonus cash, a little boring. Still waiting for more options in other areas of the garden, "coming soon".

i used to like this game so much because it's fun, and i could not wait to unlock the new past of the garden. but lately, i have mostly stuck in one level for quite sometimes, and finding out how sometimes even the most powerful power up does not work at all, it's a waste of time, power ups and annoying. not to forget the coin is still hard to collect, only when the dog training the coins i get is doubled. i hate it when the coin for decoration set is bigger than the coin i collect from each level. i used to rate 4.5 stars but now am sorry if i had to rate the game 2 stars only.

I like the game, but the latest Hidden Treasure mini game is full of glitches and shuts down the app. Normally, there aren't any issues. Looks like everyone is having the same issue with the latest ship decor feature. It keeps crashing. The developers of this game, need to uninstall the ship decorations that they just installed. You can't play at all. It just crashes!

Can't stand the fact notifications turn on every time I open the game, once I turn the notifications off they should stay off. The reaction time is too fast in the settings when swiping. It mistakes my move and makes the wrong move. This happens to everyone I know who plays the game. Deleted the game for almost a year. Maybe half a year. Doesn't matter. Reinstalled it a couple days ago and already deleted it again. The game is still just as worthless as it was last time I deleted it.

Thhis game has huge potential to be the fun, relaxing game it's touted to be. The problem is the same as every freemium on the market - you're forced very quickly into a pay-to-play corner. It's beautiful. The levels, when I'm not stuck on one for days, are challenging and fun. Overall, it's a great game but I'm tired of being stuck with no out except to pay large amounts of real money. Also, why do your ads have NOTHING to do with the actual game?

I've had this game for over 4 years now and I really love it. It's one of the best (with Homescapes) match3 Ive played and I've tried many but I keep getting back. The game pieces, bonuses and boosts are nice and clear and easy to see and recognise. One minus is the notifications for the event and mini events. I don't care for the added "boat race" but I'm forces to watch the "here is how you lost" snippet.

False advertising! While the game itself is a pretty decent match-3 game where you earn "energy" to make yor garden prettier, there are no trace of the levels shown in pop-up ads for this game shown in other apps. If you expect "catastrophe" or "escape" levels, you will be disappointed. I would easily give 5 stars for the decent implementation of the match-3 genre but give only three because of their deceptive ads. I will modify my score when I see true ads for this game.

Some levels are rediculously difficult. If after a couple weeks of being unable to get past a level, I have to give up and have a friend pass it for me. (This friend is a gaming genius). The weekly having to update the game is also a hassle. If I didn't have so much $ invested in the game I would delete it. I also dislike the seasonal decorations eliminating previous decorations I already had.

The good thing of this game is that it has beautiful graphic and that's it!! The gameplay is so bad. You will have to wait like 25 minute to get a life if you fail. Some of the levels are impossible to beat without boosters which cost thousands, but you only get about 60 dollar after you beat a level, and beating levels is the only way to get money beside spending real money. I have been stuck around level 78 for ages! Goodbye gardenfreakingscapes!

It's fun but takes way to long to finish a day.... Would be super cool of you could look at your team members gardens as well. Kind of a bummer that you cannot visit other players gardens. It also seems like you need to fail levels 100 times before you can beat it. It seems almost like it is set up to let you fail. I still enjoy the game despite that.

I truly love this game but, I wish you would bring back the exercising part more often. Used to be once a week, now lucky to get it once a month. Now I get stuck on levels forever. When the exercising part was on there, I could get coins to get power ups and move on. I can't afford to just buy them all the time. I gotta eat. I faithfully watch all the ads when they come.

I have played this game for years. I am at level 3232 and now all it does is frustrated me. I have played a single level repeatedly for a week before passing it. The events are absolutely impossible to do at high levels due to the difficulty. So, it's finally time to do what I should have done a year ago. Games should be fun, not infuriating. I did like the little story lines and the characters but no longer enjoy playing it. Goodbye Gardenscapes!!

The match games suck, 5 lives is never enough when you get into higher levels, its very aggravating when it should be fun and entertaining. It's a shame too cuz the story and graphics are really nice. So tired of playing the same level over and over until the game decides to give you enough power ups, bombs, etc., to get you to next level! Having to play a level 15-20 times before you can advance just blows!

I see the game still takes forever to load. Fix it and I would love to play it again. Back to homescapes only. This next one is for both homescapes and garden. I really dislike that the game constantly shows you the lock box everytime, as well as the level up on the side games. Like really we can go in and see for ourselves. Please take it aeay from popping up ALL THE TIME. THANKS

It used to be really good and I didn't mind spending some cash on this game but it's just straight up sabotaged at higher levels. When challenges are up you always end up being short of time or stuck on levels (or both!) at which time there's always a "convenient" sale happening where you can buy event extenders. I've decided to no longer spend money on this app because of it.

I play everyday. Got a new phone, the Pixel 7pro and this app won't work! How can I fix it? I really enjoy this game. I do think that it should be a bit easier to get stars... for example... maybe the harder levels should give 2 stars and maybe you can do other things to collect stars as well... it makes the game kinda boring when you get stuck on a level and can't do anything....

Impossible levels to beat with 10 moves that require money spent on the game and even if you do spend some, you still are targeted to make sure you don't "cheat" (if you travel a lot through time zones, avoid this game). I have completed levels and in 2 or 3 occasions somehow I'd have to take it again -for some reasons I haven't checked- and that's frustrating. Only good things are the nice people in the game and the customer support.

Very addictive, but the constant addition of new in-game events is actually too much. I just want to play the levels, not be continually urged to buy golden tickets, redecorate something, or install Homescapes as well. And it's pretty clear that the game increasingly wants you to pay for boosters to get through levels. Not sure how much longer I'll keep playing. *update* I am sick and tired of the constant in-game badgering to download Homescapes. Please give the option to turn these off.

**FALSE ADVERTISING! the adds they play have nothing to do with the app! This game is way to frustrating. At first it was fun and relaxing but now all the levels are difficult, you dont get enough moves and the power ups cost way to much for only getting a little bit coin when you pass levels. The hard levels are literally impossible it takes weeks just to pass them. This game is fun and the Idea of it is cute but the game would be so much more fun if most of the levels weren't so difficult!

This game gets a 1 star rating for false advertising. All those "save the characters" puzzle-type mini games you see in ads don't actually exist. The game is just a run-of-the-mill match 3, and it's not even a very good one. You waste so many powerups and in-game currency trying to pass levels, only to fail over and over again. Not worth it!

I really enjoy the building of the garden in conjunction to the match 3 gaming. The only negative is that I'm progressing very slowly now that most tasks cost an average of 3 stars. Still, I'd recommend this game.... Updating to drop the score. I've spent money on the game to get not lives etc... But they've basically made it now so you HAVE to spend money in order to get certain decor. Since then I'm no longer making any purchases. I prefer to be able to have the choice to spend money on a game

I like this game...BUT...there are too many difficult levels. I like a challenge...But...I spend days trying to get through levels and the reward is cheap. I am considering Quitting the game. It would be a good plan for you to watch the ads that are on this game.. I was playing at about ten oclockish at night and there was an xrated ad that popped up...NOT Impressed. Hello again I like some of the new changes, they are nice, but I am not thrilled with the "have to buy the coins" with real money. Getting coins is difficult at best, but the changes make it almost impossible. Also why is it so hard to get the shovels.. and why are the hearts taken out of the wheel??? When the game gets too difficult or starts to require real money for too many things People quit the game... this is a good game!!!

I used to enjoy this game immensely, it has nice graphics, fair "plot" and interesting game mechanics. It's really good at keeping you in suspense about the next areas of the game (yet to be unlocked by you). Unfortunately, recent marketing of the game is just abysmal at best and overall degrades the quality significantly. I really wish that game marketing team would come to their senses and stopped false advertising.

The game is not what is advertised. It's just a block swapping and matching game with a side quest of tedious side "quests" to advance the garden. There are no puzzles. Those falsely advertised puzzles were the only reason I downloaded and tried the game. The tile matching often requires good luck or boosters, all of which are expensive. There are minimal coins; it's very much a "pay to play", kind of game- not even "pay to win", just "pay to play"
like the rest of the Ai or computer ran games, its only fun for a few levels then the amount of progress you can make or fun you have is directly tied to how much you spend. Game gets an F

First off I would like to say that I do absolutely ADORE this game. Its cute, fun, and has a interesting storyline that keeps you coming back. I just started playing again recently after a long hiatus, and there are 2 big issues I've noticed. 1. The the extreme lagginess. Apparently this is due to a recent update. 2. The rate which you earn "cash" to buy themes for completed areas is way too low. I'm past the main zone, just started across the river, and have only completed 3 of 9 sets so far!

This game is highly addictive! But I think slightly more coins should be awarded for passing a level. I also hate the one time challenge levels! They are not beneficial, only a disadvantage. They just stuff up your win streak and most of them are made to fail and IMPOSSIBLE to pass without using multiple types of costly boosts. You should get a CHOICE if you want to attempt the challenge level or skip and continue ahead like normal.

The tasks are so silly most of the time. Honestly, to play a super had game for 2 days to finally win and it has earned me a phone call to order something to then open the box and it's a rake. Come on! This is the second time I installed the game hoping that this had improved and about to delete it again. Also, I have onky had 2 chances to watch a video to win a prize in the past 2 weeks. iclt can be discouraging. You need to allow the development of the areas happen a bit more quickly.

Had to downgrade my review. Absolutely love the game itself. It's customer support that's the problem. Th only way to contact Customer Support is through the app and it's all automated messages! Twice I had issues and tried to report them and got no response! The first one was an event they were doing and the event kept crashing and I was unable to complete it. This last one I bought a Golden Ticket, I have the receipt from Google Play and it was sent to them, but it never showed up in my game.

Update Dec 17, 2020. It's been made much easier to play with boosters included in levels for free. It's so enjoyable now. Maybe spend money to get coinage you may need but so far it's relaxing, enoyable, fun, comforting getaway. OLD REVIEW: It would be a great game if you didn't have to spend twenty bucks an hour to get past levels. It's too dificult without an engineering/physics/math degree and impossible to progress without spending alot of money.

Got my hopes up...thought the game had changed after not playing it for a while. Redownloaded it after I saw an ad for a different type of game. Nope! It's the same matching game. What's with the false advertising? Uninstalling and downgrading my previous 5 stars to one. If I could go less, I would. False advertising just to get your downloads number up is NOT cool. Poor form!

I have been playing for at least 3 yrs. Spend lots of money on this. Seems the more levels you play alot more stars you have to use. And I don't like how you only get 20 money on the green money to redesign the areas. It takes forever. Always 5,000 or 6,000 just to get one design. I love this game but it's getting annoying. Tired of spending thinking bout deleting it. More money you spend the less is getting done.

The only thing I liked about the game was the fact you could decorate your house while playing 3-match games. Back then it was a pretty new concept. However, it's again the kind of game they make too hard to play without spending money or becoming immensely frustrated. Not to mention they, like mindless sheep, decide to use false adverts like all others. If you can't haul in players without it, you're no good as developers. If your game was like the ad, I'd rather play it, it'd be actual fun.

I played it for 2 years and it is a money stealer. The levels have a certain pattern in which it forces you in the corner to spend some cash or die. The same level is super hard the first time and super easy the next time. It's hard to prove money making algorithms but make the experience much worse. I really liked the game but I will stay away now from all their games. So I deleted Homescapes too.

Update: I contacted support and they got the awards added to my account with no issues. The support team was nice and the issue was fixed quickly. I have been playing this game for awhile. My original review was in 2018. Today I sent an invite to my husband and he played it past level 7 and I have not gotten any of the rewards that the game says you will get when you invite friends and they play past that level.

I surprise I played for this long because I don't like match games but this one is fun but it has too much going on with events and it's losing it fun factor. Also for some reason they changed how many stars we get on very hard levels. We usually get two bit now we get just one, which is so unfair. The reward for a very hard level should have better rewards not same as every other level. It makes beating the very hard level (purple levels) so not worth it. Wish they change it back soon.

I use the love this game and have played it for months, but the lasted update ruined it for me.
