Looks great, and starts strong... But then quickly devolves into a pay to play model that doesn't really allow progress unless you shell out a continual stream of cash. You know it's bad when there's an option to pay $100 for some items and coins. No thank you. I'd much rather spend that kind of money on two or three really good Switch games.

Needs a lot of work. I've gotten as far as level 3100. Pros: - Game is fun - You can upgrade your garden Cons: - A lot of levels are needed for upgrading garden - Too many pointless tasks - Level difficulty doesn't matter. Easy levels are sometimes harder than super hard levels. - Forces you to buy coins for power ups and extra moves. - Too much clutter after restoring an area. Garden feels cramped and overwhelming. All of this needs to be fixed.

Not as advertised. It's just a version of Candy Crush. You never get to figure out issues like the ads say. I played for a couple of hours and never got anything but making the garden nice, by playing games. Seems wrong to advertise a game with the ability to fix problems and or escape issues, then all you do is play a version of a more popular 3 alike game.

Misleading ad. Nothing different than Candy crush or any 3 point match game. Not engaging enough as well, first few levels and I already feel bored, it was one of those, "oh I've seen these type of games" but are you willing to shell out time and frustration in higher levels? Just seeing how big the game map is that you have to "fix or gardenscape" already made me feel overwhelmed. Maybe they might incorporate some minigames throughout the gameplay, who knows? But for now it's an uninstall.

The ads shows puzzles that are not even playable, I've played for a while and what's being advertised is not what the game actually is. The higher you go the levels get harder and you are constantly having to buy coins to continue the progress of the game or start the level over until you get it done. Other than that the game play is good and the graphics are decent.

It was totally false advertising. Every ad is about chosing an option and even the app's pics on the play store are about choices. I downloaded the game twice and it had not a single option like in the ads appeared. Truley dissapointing. Maybe if there is a separate game with the choices, and there wasn't any false ads, then I would really like this game. I'm not saying the game is bad, it is just very misleading.

Edit on November 26th: I had to uninstall the game!! Unfortunately, even after messaging and waiting for a few days - No one from Gardenscapes has said anything, or offered an advice. Disappointing, as I'm one of the players that has purchased many things throughout the game! Hope I can restore that! I've played this game for 3-4 years now. I updated the game and I can't play it. It keeps telling me Connection Lost. I tried on different internet connections and nothing. Please, fix the issue.

Worst game EVER. Do not buy. It will freeze in the middle of a super hard level, crash, you will lose your boosters, your coins, & your standing in whatever event you are in. It is insanely hard to beat levels without boosters. Unfortunately I spent over $100 playing this game and it crashed three nights in a row at the same time. CS support was confusing, in the end they did nothing but tell me to free up memory. I did & BOOM..same thing. PICK ANOTHER GAME PLEASE, this one is terrible.

It's cute, but... so Uninstalled. I like to think I'm of OK intelligence & can successfully manage a matching game. This and the mansion game - it's as if you can win up to a point and then repeated games lost, lost wait times to recharge ... don't give me a game where I can make the home or the garden 'better' and keep me in a loop for games, and days, on end. Very disappointed.

I really love this game, it's challenging, and very addicting, I also really like the story... From level 90 and up some of the puzzles get pretty hard and they sometimes take me a few days to get lol ... I have noticed that it's high battery usage for this game, it's the highest one I have, and I just hope they fix that part...But I do recommend this game... Don't make a decision from just the first couple of levels,, play at least five to ten before you decide, I'm sure glad I did 🙂

Fun game until you reach the hu higher levels where you need to collect certain pieces to win. It can cost you over 5000 coins just to get the pieces on the board you need. It's a rip off!

THIS IS HORRIBLE! if i could give it 0 stars I WOULD. the ads are very misleading which was the reason i downloaded this game in the first place. in the ads, it is saying that you have the choice to save your character. the ad that sent me was the one where he was stuck in a well i was very exited because i used to think it was a boring, house maker with a budget. so, i tried the demo game ad and it was fun. it turns out that it is just another CANDY CRUSH GAME. DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS!!

I saw this game a lot and thought it would be fun. I downloaded it and played to for a bit. I could not get past the levels, it does not tell you how many moves there are left so you run out quickly, and if you buy more moves it gives you 3 one time and 5 another. I have tried to get 1 star at least to get the the next level and I have not been able to pass the very easy level. So I uninstalled the game. was really disappointed with it.

I use to love playing this game. Now, it seem as if it out for you spending your money on it. These levels are ridiculous hard even the simple levels are hard. Homescape is so much better because I'm able to have more moves, the power ups are better & the very difficult levels are beatable ( it might take me a couple of tries but I eventually get the wins). This game isn't fun anymore

Unless you spend $$$ to get power ups, you'll eventually but the point where you have none and can't go any further. It's nice to play a game without incessant ads all over the place, but you can definitely see that they get their income from those who buy the power items. I cannot get past level 97 without using them and I have been out. I've tried the level at least 25 times and I don't get the slightest bit close. It's too bad otherwise. Uninstalling...

While this game is extremely enjoyable, I'm very disappointed with the amount of turns given to me on this particular hard level. Only 10 turns...10!! I cannot see how this game is winnable... at least not any way that I can obviously see. I'm gonna play the Halloween game, then likely uninstall it....again. However, if the energy level doesn't automatically refill over time, and it requires me to play the game, then it's extremely likely that I'll uninstall without playing the Halloween game.

The ads are very misleading! I was hoping for more of what your ads showed but because I like match up games it ended up being a fun and addictive. Now it's just frustrating as hell, I play games like this to relax not to be aggravated. I am not very far into the game because I literally cant get anywhere without spending real money to advance. Not something I would recommend to anyone. 50-100 coins for completing a level what a joke, especially when everything you need to advance is MUCH more!

I love this game. It's challenging and fun! Very addictive. Great set up. I wish it took less time to get our lives back. also it sucks that stuff is expensive in the games like why does one little task take 5 stars or why does getting 5 extra moves cost 900 coins but we only win 50-60 coins per level. Coins need to be raised or the amount of coins for lives lowered...there are lots of bugs that need fixed in special events

I uninstalled because this was the not the advertised game. The ads show a game like a Where's my Water? Rip-off with a new theme. It wasn't bad, but I'm bored of Match 3 games. I have so many. I wanted something different, and you didn't deliver. Fishdom is better, even though its ads are the same type of misleading. It's rude.

TOTALLY MISLEADING ADVERTISING! Don't bother downloading if you are looking for the game that you see in the adds. In this game you help reestablish a once beautiful garden. You pick benches, fountains, & other garden decor. You have to play (overplayed) 3 in a row fruit matching game each time you want to complete a task. Overall very disappointing!

Stayed with this game for a few years and several different phones. Used to play it a lot ---- now the levels are so hard - I was at level 3500 - that they are nearly impossible to play. At times powerups and putting actual money into the game seem to be only way to possible to pass the levels. When levels are that hard, the game just isn't fun anymore. Too bad as I used to really enjoy it.

I didn't think i would have to say how disappointed i am in the quality of this game. I've played this game on/off 4 years. I love the game and I've gotten pretty far. The past 3 months or so I haven't been able to play, because the screen lags and doesn't load. When it does load after I restart the game/ my phone, once I would beat a level, the screen wouldn't load.. It would just be black. Everytime.. I tried re-uploading, several times, same result. I sincerely hope this issue gets fixed.

FAULSE ADVERTISING!!! What is shown on the game advertising isn't what the game is actually like at all. It's a story mode puzzle game. I figured I would try this game since I downloaded it. This game does whatever it wants regardless of what is chosen. This is a horrible choice of a puzzle game. Stick with other puzzle games that don't make choices that the player didn't make.

It's good at first when you get on a roll beating out levels and of course gets harder the farther you go. But it gets to the point where you end up using all your lives and can't play again until they reload, then you hardly want to pay because you hardly get anywhere. After you haven't played for some time then play, they THEN give you prizes left and right because you've been MIA. I got tired of this and uninstalled it.

It has glitches, and after a certain level, it's almost as if the bugs in the system are set in place to slow you down because I was caught up in levels and the amount of times the chest specials disappeared or energy levels depleted (when it was over 200 etc.) When I reached for help to even just get the energy I lost back they took 24hrs to respond. Then, when I didn't respond in a few hours the ticket was immediately closed. Now please stop with the ads "that you miss me"

It's fun in the beginning but than it becomes boring working in the same area! Plus, having to use the points towards the animal to move forward is useless. I personally spent too much $$ in this game being too anxiousness to get to the next game only to find the area stays the same far too long, NOT good! AN A+ in receiving rewards with points and bonuses in the beginning only. In ending; IT GETS BORING!!

the fact that it costs 900 or more coins for boosters is a bit ridiculous. The side tasks are a bit redundant &a waste of my time. You need to pass 4 levels to hang a bell? seriously? I'm at about level 2700 & have put too much $$ into the game. The game really needs to be revamped because at this point it's no longer fun just frustrating. The game is greedy that it wants you to pay but gives an extremely low payout ie. 50 coins for passing a level that cost you 4000 to pass. A little help here?

I made it to level 1404. The level is so incredibly difficult that I spent 3 months hoping the right pattern would show up. I even tried following a you tube video but that has extra moves. It's been uninstalled. I'm sure the game designers don't really care as I didn't buy anything, but even if you do but, you'll spend $$$ trying to pass this level.

Yes it's a fun addictive game! Lvl. 2524 But it is extremely difficult. I have been playing for a couple years. I'm at the point where I'm spending 100's of dollars a month, so I can keep up with the current events. At times its cost me 10$ a level. Just stupid! I will stop spending money on this game now. I will keep it for now. after days and days on the same level only beating one level a week its boring, frustrating and just seems unnecessary.

This game is nothing like it is incessantly advertised in pop ups while I'm playing Ruzzle. If candy crush with a storyline is what you're looking for then great, but if you're looking for the moving the key puzzles to figure out an escape you will be very disappointed. I only had one "minigame" during the time I played and it was annoyingly easy, as is this entire game. Maybe young kids will like it, but even then it moves too slow to hold interest. Great graphics though!

I thought there were going to be a lot more of the puzzles shown in the advertisements for the game... didn't realize it was a whole lot of not that and very few (and short) puzzles. Still an ok game, but pretty disappointing at the same time. Some of the levels are pretty much impossible to beat, too.... seems they're just trying to get you to buy coins and stuff. Pretty disappointing there, too. Probably going to uninstall due to more disappointing than enjoyable

I got roped into this game because the ad I saw deceivingly portrayed this as a very different type of puzzle game. The game play is simple - you play "Candy Crush" to win stars which allow you put stuff in a make-believe garden. One thing this game is SUPERB at is getting you to give it money. You purchase "lives" to keep playing if you cant defeat a level in X turns or you buy more turns, which increase in cost each time. If you do neither, you lose the bonuses you collected along the way.

I really like the concept, but they should award more than one star per puzzle, or at least give stars based on your score and/or level of difficulty on each puzzle. It takes a week of real time play (at least in my mom-world) to complete a days work, because of how hard it is to get stars. That said, this is the only game on which I've ever gotten to level 1000, so that's a testament to the game in and of itself.

Love playing but some levels are way too easy while others are down right hard if not impossible to complete any level WITHOUT using one of the powerups. Also getting to different areas of the garden and the multitude of "tasks" costs WAY TOO MUCH COINAGE and way too tedious. There needs to be a way to save the free time. I just got 4.5 hours of free time and don't have time to play right now. I do have a life.

Pretty good matching game. There are a couple things I really dislike though. One is that the pieces often match themselves in air which is too early for when I strategically set up pieces to create bombs after a match. Pieces should fully settle after cascading before the game looks for any resulting matches. Another thing I dislike is at the end of the level of I leave several rainbow pieces on board, they trigger too quickly after explosions or other rainbow pieces. Leaves me feeling a bit cheated out of end of stage rewards. Other than those 2 quality of life issues, I think the game is great.

This game is good but it's a money pit. You can play a level 20 times and lose but spend money and instantly win. Then 900 to continue is extremely high then it jumps to 1200 then 2000 so if you have saved coins you lose them fast. If the prices were more feasible then maybe more people would play. Like maybe 400 to continue and then 600 but the jump is drastic and you lose way more than you win.

I have been playing for many years and id a favorite game of mine and got up to level 1565. Lately the game has been crashing and freezing. When I contacted tech support, their answer was to transfer the game to a better device. After all the years and loyalty to this game and that is the best help I can get. I un-instslled the game and no longer be a customer again

Most of the first 300 levels were fun. Decent challenge and the story was hokey but entertaining; not many levels felt impossible, even the hard/super hard levels. Some puzzles had a little strategy involved. Once I reached level 285 or so, things changed. I ran out of pregame bomb options and most in game tools within the next 25 levels over 4 days. With over 8000 levels, this should never happen. Some levels are hard enough that I didn't even it possible to beat even with buying booster packs.

Misleading advertising about the gameplay. In order for you to achieve the level of the decision making adventure, which is advertised, you have to play tons of games (much similiar to Bejeweled and Candy Crush) before you can progress. I downloaded the game to have fun with the decision options adventure, not to play games of its predecessors, Bejeweled and Candy Crush. Let's get straight to it! I just downloaded the game and will be more than happy while deleting it! Uninstalled.

I've been playing this game for about 3 years now on and off. I just restarted recently, and was immediately reminded why I left. The levels require tasks like , make and explode this rocket,which requires a match 4, but we're only going to give you match 5+ and not count those, oh, and even though you also have to uncover stuff that needs bombs(match 5) or bigger, only the match 4 count, oh and do it it in 24 moves. It doesn't make it fun, or harder, just annoying.

Gardenscapes is a fun game until the scam comes into play. You have a team event and you can't join unless you win a level. Well level 2371 for example is categorized as super hard. Less than a year ago the game allowed 19 moves to complete it. But the level only allows 15 moves this year. I've googled many levels and it's the same story. So if you don't buy coins to achieve the extra 5 moves, you will not make it. Even when using boosters. I will be removing it since I'm tired of the scam. Bye

This game has held my interest for 7400 levels so they are doing something right. I've sent numerous messages to support and clarify that one of my problems is that I cannot see their replies and they need to email me. What do I receive? A notification that I have a new message in app. No resolution. The game cheats sometimes and refuses to let me win a level. It sometimes does not award my power up winnings and I even have pieces that won't move. The game is impossible at higher levels!

I love the game! I do NOT like the "in app purchases"!!! So far, it is possible to win levels without buying power ups etc. However it takes a lot of trys! I also do not like how expensive the purchases are! Other than that, LOVE the game! Well, it was fun and I liked the game, right up to level 137! That level has been impossible to win without buying "in app purchases"! I've got better things to spend my VERY HARD EARNED money on! Uninstalling the game today!

Nicely done so far (I'm at Level 34) Like the graphics, the details, the interactivity with the game was an unexpected delight. Only 1 Star rewarded upon completion of each game puzzle. However, as long as only 1 or 2 stars are needed to do the projected projects throughout the garden then I am content with it. BUT as I get further in the game...I hope the "stars" DON'T increase to complete said projects in the garden. Thus, would likely deter me away

Lucky spin prizes not showing up in my boosters, not for 2 weeks!!! The updates and extra levels are cool but you can't really enjoy them if you are on a higher level and takes so long to beat one level. I can never really compete in the fireworks or orangey extras because it takes way too long to get through levels. AND, you have to use all your coins and boosters to try to get through one level and most of the time you still lose.

Fun addictive casual game. Unless you spend real money on boosters, once you go above level 2000 be prepared to spend days stuck on a level. Also the pop ups when you start the game can be tedious, some times i have to close out four popups promoting some drivel before i can actually play. They pop up one at a time after you close the other one so it feels unending. Oh, and the required updates are too big and too frequent.

Have been playing this game for almost 5 yrs now. Originally gave it 5 stars, was fun, a good time killer, and was a good balance of difficult levels and easy. Having said that, now whatever update the did in my mind has changed the game for the worse. It feels like any time you go on a run of levels it seems right away a hard, super hard, or challenge level (the dumbest thing they thought of) happens very quickly. It's almost like the algorithm they use wants you to fail. Game is annoying now.

False advertising with a fake demo. The fake ad makes the company look like scamers. In the demo ad you had to choose between several objects to resolve a problem, but the gameplay of the actual game is not like the ad. The gameplay for this game is a puzzle matching game, which is fun, but not the same as the ad, I would like to enjoy both types of games and not be tricked into thinking I'm downloading one type of gameplay but end up with a different gameplay instead.

Please consider removing the decrease of points for season events when there is a failed attempt. It's hard enough to pass levels and it gets expensive to proceed (most require boosters and coins to pass). Especially when you pay for gold pass, i think points should not be decreased when a level is failed. I support in-app purchases for a well-made game; but it is getting expensive and not fun to play.

The game is cute, and the play is smooth, I play offline, so not bothered by ads. 1 star rating is because it's such a waste of time. No one should spend 3 weeks on one of these levels. When given a free hour of play you can guarantee that you will spend the entire hour on one level, so hardly a free hour of play. Just a free hour of ads for most I would guess when game decides to let you win, the whole screen fills up with ludicrous amt. Of bombs. So its TOO obvious that you've been locked out of winning until that point. All playrex games are the same in this aspect.

This game is designed specifically to drain money from your credit card. The AI is rigged, so that any power ups you either win consecutively through beating levels, or through payment, are wasted - most land in dead spots where you're forced to use them. It is a game that is almost entirely luck based, with no real strategic sense of achievement. There is no real definition between normal, hard and super hard levels - a player can spend days or weeks stuck on a level regardless. Overall, 1/5

Downloaded the game based on the ads shown and expected it to be something like puzzle. But it was nothing like the ad. Hard levels to ensure one ends up spending money to buy lives/other resources. Very disappointed. Will uninstall it in a while.

Been playing game for quite sometime. above level 1700. noticing that when I set up colors to fall and create bonuses the game will take 3 and leave the other 2 or how ever the combination falls. Changed from 3 stars to 1. I have been playing for 5 years and it keeps getting worse. Rewards for the challenge round are puny. Most of the rewards are puny. I've played this game for a very long time, even purchased quite a bit, but now, the levels are almost unbeatable. I've been playing this game off and on for years, and upon returning I can't believe how disgustingly greedy it's gotten. Having trouble getting into the game to play it. It loads, but jumps out before completely loads. This has been going on for two days. I even uninstalled it and then installed it again. The game is fun but as you get higher, the moves becomes less and less, and you can't solve the puzzle, without spending money. Ridiculous, it takes forever to pick up some little coins, but it takes only seconds to spend all them, because for only 5 moves you have to pay 900, and another 1200 coins for 5 more moves, stupid.

I get that there is a limit to the amount of levels and garden expansions/decorations the writers can add.... but who wants to play a game they can't beat?

Not even close to what was advertised in the playable ad. I thought it'd be a game where you progress a character based on choices and each has a different outcome. I really love this game because of the difficulty balance of the levels; some of the levels are frustratingly hard but some others are fairly easy! I have been enjoying the game, even though it's not the one I thought I was getting. (Was meant to save fish). I like the game but when close to wining a level, then I am taken to a screen, where I purchase tokens to continue on my level plus other bombs aka " garden kit" after u make the paymet, you are supposed to be taken back to your current level to finish the game, but it did not, because it didnt take me back to game in progress. Game was fine but was expensive because many levels could not be completed without boosters. I kept playing but at level 528 game started crashing every time, wasting boosters and lives. It may seem fun, but it is designed to use up you coins and not let you win levels. The Reason? To get you to spend money on the Game. There suggestions every few levels to spend. Misleading. I only downloaded it because of the "Can you help them survive? " type ads that are like little choice puzzles. Well I have had it over a week and it's bejeweled basically. I loved playing the games and going on the adventure. But after reaching level 60, the hard games started to get ridiculously hard, but with patience and a purchase, I managed to get to level 70. Great game but some levels are impossible. I'm at a high level and has been playing for a few months. I enjoy the game. False Advertising!!!! So if you came here because you saw one of there ads where you fix up the place and if you select the wrong tool you accidently destroy it, then prepare to be disappointed. First off - the ads are incredibly inaccurate, particularly the one that says it is. This is a matching game not a puzzle game. Secondly - I played this games YEARS ago and it was great. Been playing this game for a few years. Gave it 4 stats cause of the false advertisement of the game play that I keep seeing. Its not what the game actually is.
