If you are planning to download the game for the puzzle games, then don't waste your time, these are misleading ads. You will only come across a puzzle every 20 or so level and it's not even good. As for the game it's like candy crash game, but the levels are designed that you after certain levels you have to pay real money to get preks to help you clear the levels, because they can't win within the turn limits, so you'll need to keep spending money on it over and over again to continue or else

UNINSTALLING. I've played over 30 levels and this game looks NOTHING like the ads. Its just a basic match 3 game. I held out hope that something like the ad would eventually happens but no such luck. Totally false advertising, a complete lie. The game maker know they cant market it so they show you something that isnt even actually gameplay. Good waste of time, can be fun. But not what was sold to me in the video ad for the game.

One star because I can't give less!! After a few levels it is totally pay to play. The matching games "bejeweled like" are completely unrealistic to achieve after the first few levels. Not enough ways to get boosters without paying and not enough reward for winning. I installed to play the brain puzzles (pulling the pins) and I only got one or 2. Completely false advertising!

This is the game you're looking for, as in there are no pop-up ads, ability to play offline, purchasable items but they are not necessary in order to advance in the game, create or join your own interactive team and compete together, there's plenty of lvls and new areas added often, very challenging and overall just a good game. If there's any negative, it'd be that it takes 25 mins to regenerate a life and it only stores up to 5 lives, so every 100 lvls beat should give us an extra banked life.

Deceptive advertising. Really annoyed that the game mechanics are NOTHING like the ads imply. This is a match 3 game like Bejeweled. That's it. I actually used to play it, and it is a fine match 3 game where you win levels to expand (and select from 3 preset decoration choices) a virtual garden, but it absolutely does NOT have "choose the right tool to help characters through puzzles" scenarios. Really resent the lying just to entice people to download the app, and will be uninstalling it.

If I were to leave a review a year or more ago, I would given it 5 stars. I have been playing from the beginning and my level was in the quintuple digits. But they keep slashing the rewards you can win in favor of the monthly gold pa$$ that so many games are adopting. The levels can be ridiculously hard, even the "easy" ones which forces you to have to use boosters that are not easily won. So long gardenscapes. I don't mind spending money until you force my hand. It's #5 grossing for a reason

I enjoyed your game until I got to level 94. I've tried it with multiple power-ups and probably around 50 times. I am great with a game being challenging, but there is a difference between challenging and hoping you get lucky. Every game should be winnable if played right, but at this point I'm certain that your interest is in me buying something which isn't going to happen. Also, this game was advertised as a pull the pin game, but is nothing more than another glorified candy crush. Uninstall.

Played the game for a while and then uninstalled due to the fact that the game sucks, takes 3 days to play 1 level because of difficulty. Reinstalled about a year later and I'm going to uninstall again, was just now reminded why I uninstalled the 1st time. This is supposed to be fun but instead just frustrates the hell out of a person. I refuse to spend any money on this app therefore you want to make it impossible to proceed without spending my money. That's it, thanks for turning something that should've been a great way to relax and enjoy turning it into one of the most frustrating game ever. Same with Homescapes. Thanks for wasting my time.

I constantly get stuck on a level for 3 or 4 days. It's obvious that I'm not given a fair chance to win the level. And it takes forever to refill lives. I think it's time to delete and find a new game. Update...... this game totally cheats you out of a win. I had 1 move and to clear the path for the glass to drop off. The glass jumped over a row when it clearly should have dropped off to win the game. The only good thing are the graphics.

I downloaded this game based on the ads which falsely depict the game style and play. I was very disappointed, but gave it a shot anyway. It's addictive at first if you like candy crush style games and renovating/decorating a garden, but the tasks are pretty mundane and annoying. You use points to greet a character, prepare tea, call the repair man, before you actually repair anything.

What's with the lame story line and the impossible ( buy my cheat) puzzles? All you advertise are pick the scenario type games. That's the whole reason I downloaded in the first place; the second time as well. Was gifted some advantages as a welcome back, so played for a bit. Got to level 87 and still no pick the scenario games. Lame. Back to the trash bin you go.

I really love the game, but find it too greedy, and obvious about it. High costing boosters, like 900 points to get 5 more turns, so that you can win 50 points! A safe with 12,000 points in it that you MUST buy to get. As you advance in the game, the price, in stars, increases to 2 or 3, but winning still only gives you 1 star. I played it madly for 3 weeks, and realized I spent way too much money on it. I can't afford to play it much longer, and will have to delete it. So beware, it bites!!

Love the game. Don't love the high cost for more turns, the very conservative awarding of one star at a time and low amount of coins earned for completing a game. Interested in fixing the gardens but really dislike having to waste buying power to make a phone call or find some dudes hat. Just want to improve the garden without being fleeced.

I've enjoyed this game for years and playing just for the fun of it, not caring about events and not stressing over being promoted/demoted to another league. However, the decorations - it is impossible to earn enough cash to complete unique decoration sets in specific areas. They are just too expensive. The game creators goal is to spend real money in the game, which I have no intention of doing. I am on level 1500+ and have yet to see a mini game. Stop pushing us to install your other game!

I love this game, but after I hit level 1000 I've had problems with the app closing during the match 3 games. It started happening about every 45 minutes, but over 2 months it escalated, and now I can't even play one. I've reported this a couple of times, with zero response. I've done the usual things to fix it on my own: reinstall, clear the cache, update everything... and this happens on both my old Fire tablet and my new one. Guess I can't play my favorite game any more. Soooo disappointed.

it's a pretty good game - if you have the money to spend on micro transactions in order to beat some of the levels. otherwise you'll find yourself sitting there for hours on one level, trying to beat it. Maybe it wouldn't be so frustrating if there was another way to receive hearts besides a.) paying for them or b.) connecting to Facebook in the hopes that someone you know plays the game. why not just allow people to friend in game to get more lives?

I gave this game 1 star because it isn't anything like how they advertised it. In the advertisments it makes the game look like a fun multiple option game. But really it is a rip off of candy crush. Also some of the levels are impossible to beat and it cost 3 stars just to do one thing! Also it cost 900 coins for extra lives ( They only give you 5) which it is impossible to get that many coins. I suggest that before you consider getting the game, you should read the critical reviews.

Great graphics and could be 5 star but I would like to be able to move to other garden areas without "finishing" (over decorating) one first, and to be able to play different games to get there. It's possible to level up without spending $ but this can mean playing the same game over and over again which gets BORING. If you do choose to spend $ then you don't get your money's worth. Lots of potential but way too repetitive for me with low payoff. Be fun to have some dark decoration options, too.

O boy, just when you think you can give a new and better review, the game comes and do this. I have been playing this game since 2016. And I am thinking of deleting the profile and entire game from my device. Getting stuck on levels for days on end, getting 3hours of free live, but not winning a level in that time. 🤬 Spending a lot of money and not getting levels. Fix it, or your going to loose players.

Extremely misleading advertising. This isn't a puzzle game at all. The game is just a glorified version of Candy Crush. After a few levels it's practically impossible to gain enough credits without sittinf through some idiotic ads just to get the moves necessary to finish the level and get your points. You should be ashamed of the misleading nature of your ads, they aren't even remotely close to what the game is.

I was enjoying the game I've reach level 867 but now it has just stopped. I've restarted my phone, checked the app itself, powered off my phone and it still won't open. If I have to reinstall it and start all over I won't be playing anymore. Also, I agree with the cost of the power ups being insanely expensive. 1900 coins just for 3 rainbow spinners?! REALLY!

The best thing I ever did was delete this game. I downloaded it for what looked like a puzzle based game (based on the ads) which turned out to be misleading as those are only mini games within the called nightmares. However the worst part within this franchise (?) seems to be that the higher you get, the more impossible the game will basically become for one to play. One will either spend days on 1 level or money to buy power ups, which trust me will quickly add up.

it's too hard to advance and get rewards most of the time. and I HATE when it slides a "buy this helper" screen in when I have painstakingly saved my coins for more lives. it's sneaky and it pisses me off. It , like other games I play, should have a two-click system for purchases, even if the coins are imaginary. I don't want 3 damn discs for 900, I want 5 lives. I'm about to quit it.

Lots of Negative Reviews & 1-Star Ratings: The ad for this game is fun, exciting and likely very challenging. I've seen the ad multiple times and decided to install. Within 2 mins, I uninstalled...not good. The typical match 3 game, and who knows how many levels you have to complete to get to the adventurous level in the ad. Strategic marketing, but very misleading.

The game is great but one major frustration concerns saving one's progress during the minigames. Typically, I can start a match 3 minigame, be interrupted and come back to it. However, it has happened a couple of times where I've been playing, got interrupted and when I've come back, I've lost my place in the minigame, lost a life and any boosters I had as well. That's ridiculous to be so penalised for coming out of the game. Developers please sort this out!

Used to be fun. Now every other level is either hard or super hard, and, like others have said, if you don't purchase things then your stuck on a level for days, even when using your boosters. I see the responses to others who have said the same thing, and while yes it is "possible" to beat the levels without purchases it takes days to do it. It stops being fun on the 3rd day of being stuck on a level. I wouldn't recommend this app to others.

In the 700s on levels. Haven't spent too much on this game. After playing a lot (2-3yrs) there are things about this. Having to spend and what seems like rigging to force you to spend. I understand you got to make money. But, you get to certain levels that require butterfly's or firefly to pass I will go 5 to 7 turns with it not producing the required things needed. Making me run lives. The one time I spent was to test this. Now I go months not playing. Ruins a otherwise fun game.

This game sucks!! The further you get the more your penalized!! I got to the 2 thousands and you get stuck for DAYS and this causes you not to be able to advance in the mini games so the game demotes you. You can be a platinum level but they say, "we're sorry" and drop you down even though you've spent hours playing. Spending actual cash is a waste!! I spent my $4.99 for holiday events, but again you can't reap the rewards cause you're stuck for days on one level. Its ridiculous!!

My only major complaint is the levels skill ratings. I have beat levels at times, labeled "Super Hard", without the aid of a booster quite easily, while struggling with average levels, even with boosters. It just frustrating to be working on a level for so long, wasting boosters, just to earn the minimum reward, when the level is supposed to be an average one. Apparently the levels difficulty, need to be re-evaluated and adjusted.

Knocking it down two stars because the advertising is misleading about what the game actually does. I downloaded the game because it advertised me saving characters through decision making in difficult situations and I am on level 1317 and the game is still just matching fruit and decorating a garden! Pretty irritating. I have even spent money to see if I got to certain level, then it would be part of the game. Nope. If you enjoy match games it is cool. Same issue with Homescapes.

Not a puzzle game. The ads for it show a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT game and give no indication or even hint at the type of gameplay to expect. DO NOT BE FOOLED. This is candy crush with an annoying storyline. Not a single puzzle or brain teaser to be found, just mindless 3-swap boards over and over. Was bored to tears but stuck with it for a few hours hoping something interesting would unlock. Learn from my mistake and do not waste your time. It's not worth the 30 seconds it will take to download.

Wonderful game, lives take too long to renew though. Can the time possibly be lessened? Thanks PLAYRIX. Also, it would be good if the moves that are left after a game is won, be brought forward to the following level. For eg. I had won a level using 4 or 5 moves with 24 moves left, i lost all those moves - wasn't cool at all. This needs some serious consideration Playrix, as some levels don't have a lot of moves. Next, more coins at the end of game would be great - too little coins given. Why???

The game is perfect. I love this game very much. But when I synced my last game on other device to my Android mobile, type "OK" and press ok, my game is stuck and freezed. I can't do anything but only clear task and run game again. And then my game has been synced. Would you fix this bug, please? It's only occurred on Android Mobile. My iPad can press ok and app is not freezed.

I was doing so well until I reached level 57, I've been working on this level for 2 months now. I'm not sure if it is a glitch, but too many moments I dont touch the screen and some of the objects move on me. kinda frustrating, I have been playing homescapes for the same amount of time, and have no issues like this. thinking of just giving up and deleting the game all together. especially if I purchased extra items to help me beat the level, and it did me no good. truly a waist of my money.

Being able to customise the garden is the main draw, and keeps me constantly wanting to go back and play to finish up decoration. Only 3 stars because the levels are too difficult - I need at least 30 to 50 tries on average to pass them now, which may lead to the downfall of this game. As it is, I stop playing daily, instead I play other more interesting games, and only returnn to GS once in 2 to 4 weeks, more often longer. This will be the downfall of GS

Game is linear-- no option to choose a different order to which items you clean up/build. The structure is you play a candy crush game to earn the coins that convert to the stars you need to perform tasks. Graphics are good, but game play gets tiring after a short time. In addition, false advertising. The ad showed the guy in a series of mazes with obstacles. The goal was to remove the obstacles to get him out of the maze. The actual game is like farmville, garden style.

Despite being a fun storyline there are several issues. 1) When you get to the higher levels you don't get a sufficient amount of moves to beat the levels. 2) When you buy more moves you only get 5 extra with each package, it doesn't vary so you may end up spending quite a bit to try and "win" the first time. 3) No choice in completing tasks. I don't like birds and didn't want birds in my garden, but it forces you to get them. Overall, this game and in-app purchases should be restructured.

The game has been reworked so that the hard and extra hard levels vastly outnumber the regular levels. The number of moves allowed has been decreased as well, making the levels impossibly difficult unless you pay for powerups. The events are also impossible to win because the amount of "tokens" needed is astronomical and the amount earned per level is VERY small. I used to enjoy the game, but now it is far too stressful and no longer the relaxing game it used to be

There's some fun, but it's more frustrating than it's worth. The cost of the bonuses is out of balance to the level rewards, the game play is restrictive, and the level the game depends on being willing to buy lives or bonuses is not worth it. I don't want to waste time or money on this. Sadly, if it had resembled either the ads or the free online varients, I might have kept the game a bit longer. I liked the butler and the story.

Gameplay is very addicting and fun, but doesn't have anything like what the ad was showing; choosing from several items to try to fix the damage to parts of the garden, and getting it wrong would break the part more. I've seen nothing like that in the game (would have made for 5 stars instead), and it's not the only one to incorrectly portray the play style. Otherwise it's a very fun game and I like having the choices of what design to ise!

Standard match 3 game. It's fun and I like the design aspect of it. My complaint is mainly you don't get the bang for you buck. I like that each task requires you to have stars to do it but there are so many small tasks that it makes it annoying when I've put in quite a bit of time to a level and all I get out of it is finding the rake. Then I have to do another level to actually clean up the yard then another to bury the leaves. Also don't get the constant redesign of the same game mechanic.

I liked this game at first. I enjoyed the concept of completing match-3 levels to help restore your garden and by proxy further the story. And that was fun. And I even enjoyed some of the more challenging levels. But it got to the point where the levels became TOO challenging to the point where levels were no longer a test of my puzzle solving skills, but whether I had the right buffs and items (and gold) to pass. Around the time the lily pads were added is where the game stopped being fun.

I really love the premise of the game. The issue is that the rewards are not equal to the effort invested. You need more and more stars to complete one task but even high levels don't increase how many stars you get. I'm over level 400 but I feel like I haven't accomplished much because it takes so many stars for each 'day' to complete. The puzzles should be rewarding more stars every so many levels (not just hard and super hard puzzles). At level 400 you would think a puzzle would be worth 2-3.

Such a nice and fun game! BUT... the levels are to hard, even the ones that are not marked as hard, you can play them for days. There are to many stars you need to collect for a just small part of task. And of course if you want to pass the levels, you need to buy boosts... which you get rarely for free. It would be such a nice game if it is easier.

Not as advertised in the ads. Claims you can progress in the game without making purchases, but, in my experience so far, this is not accurate. Keep getting stuck on a level for days. What few coins I get disappear quickly because the cost to buy boosts is ridiculously high. And the option to watch a video to get coins has never worked! This would be a very fun game if some of these problems were fixed. I especially enjoy the garden design aspects, or would if I got to do more of it.

Overall it's a funny game with good graphics and simple gameplay. It's not directly a p2w but you can spend lots of money on this game which bothers me a bit. It also crashed a few times without saving the level. When that happened the boosters I used in that level were gone but the level wasn't saved as successfully done! Some bug fixes would be nice!

Fun game at first and it's lots of fun decorating the mansion and reading the story. But after a certain point you have to pay to play basically because the levels are impossible to beat. Like you have 10 moves to destroy 80 squares or to collect 60 cherries and 50 yellow blocks. I spent $50 in less than 4 days because it's impossible to win without buying extra moves especially on the difficult levels. Wouldn't recommend you play past level 30 at most.

The game was pretty good for a while. When you get into the higher levels, some seem impossible. It takes me over a week, and all of my power ups to beat some of them. Also, the latest mini game only gives you 15 items vs the 50 previously. Hardly worth playing, especially when you can't earn them by beating levels. I'm quickly losing interest in this game.

Game can be fun. However, there seems to be multiple layouts for each level. And only one or two is a winner. Expext to spend days trying to complete one level. Odds are in the house's favor. It is the same for their sister game, Homescapes. Spending money is completely optional and not required. But without spending major bucks, you are at the "board layout rotation" mercy before getting a favorable layout. You will see this by level 27.

I've been addicted to this game for 2 years now, and I would've given it 5 stars if it weren't for a couple of issues I have with it. First, when pieces fall and should form an explosive, many times the pieces clear too quickly and the explosive isn't there. Pieces shouldn't clear until all are settled. Also, the orangery flower gave more rewards. Now we have a bonsai tree that requires more levels cleared but gives less reward, no boosters until it's completed. Otherwise, I love the game.

It would have been nice if the game was actually like the ad. Instead, it's just another matching game with intermittent pauses to listen to the butler talk on the phone. 30 minutes is too long to wait for a new life and some levels are too complicated. I like a challenge but not "mission impossible " every time. Especially when it takes 50 tries to get past a normal level and they only let you accumulate a max of 15 lives. On the plus side the graphics are great and the decorating is fun.

Very addictive. Challenging but attainable tasks.....Now I am level 5900, they have drastically reduced the number of moves for many levels. Playing the same level over and over is Not fun and they refuse to change it back. Also added "bonus" rounds which only wipe out any booster you are lucky enough to accumulate. Such a shame, I enjoyed it before.

This game is so much fun! Love the random things Austin says as you tap on things in the garden. However I find it wrong that some levels force you to purchase things in order to pass them. Which is why this game will never get five stars from me! Beware some of the butterfly levels people if you don't have the extra 900 coin to keep going you'll have to purchase them because the level will not give you the correct amount of butterflies durning game play to pass it unless you buy stuff....

I love playing this game but I can't help but feel like anytime there is a cool addition, like right now is st.pattys day decorations. And whenever those are going they give a near impossible level to play and I am stuck on it until all the time is gone and I miss out of the decorations. They make it so I have to pay to move on sometimes. I have missed out on alot of the extras cause I refuse to pay everytime. Coincidentally, I can pass the level as soon as the event is over.

Great finish to a nice game by very greedy company. Let me explain. Graphics are sweet, a nicely drawn set with detailed characters and garden pieces. There's a storyline that you can follow, but the transitions between scenes is a tad too slow. The main reason for playing is the puzzle side of the game. It works great, but has a few flaws. The thing is, it's designed so you always end up with one move short. Pay up and you get more, or for power-ups. Irritating, but you get over it as you go.

Installed the game and wasn't happy that it was completely different to play than the advertisment made out. But I gave it a go and managed to make it through to a level in the 200s(?) while refusing to buying any extra items, super frustrating at times with the really hard levels. But now the game won't start at all! keeps saying "connection lost" and that I need to connect to the internet for it to load.... there is nothing wrong with my internet! I guess I will be uninstalling!

Yet again this is a game that once you reach a certain level you're stuck unless you spend money to purchase buffs or more moves. This game started out fun but I have been on the same level for the last month and shouldn't have to spend money to get past it. The controls stink. Half the time the game does not register what piece you are touching, which is a programming problem since I don't have that issue on other match 3 games. Also I have learned that the longer you play each day the levels get harder meaning if you pass so many levels in a row the game decides nope your not going any farther today.

Contacted support to report an issue on Tortuga event in great detail with pictures. Was missing just 3 things from total completion of the event. In the end their response was that there was no issue and ended the conversation. Apperantly making 99,9% of the event with more than enough time to spare and making the report on time, there can be "no" issue. Sure I like to waste my time reporting problems and not finish what I started (screenshot of my progress was included in the report) 1 star

the game is okay, there needs to be an option to turn off hints, the moves they want us to make are pointless anyway, just to waste turns. it's very annoying. it's also annoying once I've lost I have to always confirm that I want to leave and lose everything. and the levels are too difficult to have so many pointless tasks like "look at chest" followed by "open chest" and between them costing about four stars? it's not worth it.

So I gave this game a great review when I had first began playing it, now I'm a week in and really can't help disliking it. It's addictive at first, the puzzles are challenging but do-able, now I'm only on my third part of the garden and I am getting stuck at every turn. You literally will use up all your lives trying to get through one puzzle only to move on to a harder one. I had to uninstall this game, it's not worth the time and effort. Go ahead and download but you'll see my point soon.

I had a wonderful bonus of 4 hours of unlimited lives. Thought this would be great to help complete the Christmas decorations. I spent the ENTIRE 4 hours trying to conquer 1 level. Needless to say I am frustrated. This is supposed to a fun game. When one spends all of the unlimited live time on 1 level, that is just rated hard, the fun is lost. ps It would be great if a person could bank some of the unlimited life time. 4 hours of continuous play is a waste.

Im getting tired of my game closing when I try to click on the expedition option. I've made a lot of progress in the jade turtle story, and now it won't let me back in without my whole game shutting down. Also, you claim that all the games are winnable without purchases, which is technically true, but the game actually has to just hand you the elements you need to win.

Fun game. Very addictive. The only thing I dislike is having to use real money when you run out of things. I would rather have an option to play a game or two outside of the regular play for power items and coins. UPDATE: For some reason, the game reset to the very beginning. I had made it a long ways. Unless it can be fixed, I'm uninstalling this app!

I have been playing Gardenscapes for years now. I would have good luck mostly, and also times when it was more challenging. I always thought it was a great game until about a year ago. It started NEVER progressing... I couldn't get ANYWHERE! I had nothing to barter with and couldn't even win the most basic area's that I've played 100's of times before!! I finally, deleted it. Now I've been seeing ads for it. It looks different. Does it really have the fires, floods, accidents now like it shows?

Not sure why people complain it's hard, or think they have to pay money to pass. I can be stuck on a level for 2-3 days, unlike CC where I could be stuck for a week or more. Use the boosters wisely and it's fine. Fun and amusing game, occassionally mis reads the swipe (possibly just requires calibration of touch sensor) Update: seems to miss combos, or gives unexpected combos when explosions happen.

Overall, I love the game. I can be stuck on a level for days then win with moves left over. It's challenging enough, but please, please stop having so many events piled on top of one another that constantly open popups. There's already an icon to click if I want event info. Likewise, I hate the mini games. They're childish and for supposedly being logic games it makes no sense at all to have them in this game. It detracts from the experience. The challenge levels are fun though.

The puzzles are broken, randomly generated bits of hell that make this game a nightmare. The price for power boosts or extra lives is ridiculous compared to what you make for beating a level, the goals they give you for events are ridiculously high, and the ratio of difficult to normal levels is way out of balance, so it's nigh impossible to get or keep the free boosters. I'm past lvl 10,000, but I'm done with their money-grabbing. I'm uninstalling, and if I could give less than one star I would

The game was fun for about a year, now it isn't relaxing at all. It takes so many stars to complete one task. You have to grind if you want to advance in the storyline. The main reason I'm giving it only one star is because it broke my phone! A brand new phone only had it for three months! After I updated the game my phone started crashing when I played it , so I stopped and deleted it. But even after that my phone kept crashing and after two weeks I got the blue screen of death. Thanks a lot😡

I've been playing this game sinr 2017, and I havent changed my 5 star rating until now. For the fifth time in the past 3 days, the game crashed just after I purchased the play on function to get 5 more turns to continue the game. This resulted in me losing the levels AND a total of 4500 coins! The has been stopping a lot larely as well, though that usually is for a brief moment and starts back up where it left off. The stopping is annoying, but not as bad as 4500 coins lost!!!!

Why aren't there any levels like you advertise? That would be a fun level between the decorating (ie: "Help butler go on a trip!"). There are definitely kinks to work out. Tasks that take several stars are lame, some of the hard levels should reward more than one star. Also there's a glitch where it doesn't recognize you've done part of your multi-star tasks so there you go back to one (trimming hedges, for example). Good for passing time, but could be a lot better!

levels are way to hard to beat when you get higher up. you have to spend a week or more just to pass one level. all they will say is that there is tips on our website to help each level but those still dont work. there are way to many extra hard levels. please make it easier to relax and enjoy the game rather than get frustrated because you only needed to collect two more things but ran out of moves. Same problem with homescape. going to delete both soon.

Nothing like the ads. The ads on socials draw you in thinking it'll be super fun, quickly realize it's not like that at all.. Okay I'll give it a shot.. But once you get a few "levels" in, it's absolutely impossible to beat. The tutorials make you use up your boosters all at once so you have nothing left for the hard levels. It's just a ridiculous game. 100% not worth the storage it takes up or the battery life it drains.

Game is wonderful, challenging and cute. My garden looked beautiful. Then I uninstalled. It was fun and challenging, until it became ridiculously difficult. Levels became too hard to complete with one star per level even when things cost three stars. They are all beatable, I know, but it's all up to luck. I was also a bit disappointed that the developers had zero confidence in there game. False advertisements aren't nice.

False advertising... A good game; great graffics, story line, characters, challenges, and developer involvement. But I no longer play. If you've followed here from an ad, know that the actual game is NOTHING, repeat NOTHING, like the ad/s, & why I've stopped playing. I am sick & tired of seeing the ads that differ so extremely from the actual game. It's a match 3 game; collect a star from a level and use it to clear a challenge that lets you choose the colour of flowers. That's it.

Really like this game, except I do not think the bombs should count as moves. The game is hard enough sometimes. And I've been thru 4 levels now where I am supposed to get 4 glasses of tea to the bottom, but I waste all my moves just waiting for the last glass to even show up on the board and by then I'm dead. Very irritating, I like games to be challenging but not pointless.

Apparently Playrix's MO is to make a misleading ad that looks fun but is nothing like the actual game. I saw an ad for a game where a couple was lost in a cold landscape and you had to choose what to do to keep them safe; this game is completely different. As far as the ACTUAL game goes, it's just another match 3 game with a little twist. I wouldn't mind playing it if I could turn hints off. It takes away all the fun if it shows me what to do whenever I don't make a move for 5 seconds.

False Advertisement. You were shown to do different thing on the ad but when installed, its just like candy crush but harder since each time you have to earn a star to complete a challenge. I played this before but because of the ad showing a different kind of game that I like, I downloaded it again. But nothing changed and what's showing on the ad isn't there at all.

Unistalling. First: The advertising is lying to us. Completely. The game is about something totally different. Second: It's is a quite entertaining game but they made it in a way you would have to expend a lot of money if you want to continue the levels. After level 74 or so, the game is impossible to success without the bonuses, which you won't use only one per level, probably 2 or 3. I would recommend to read all the bad comments before download it.

So disappointed. This is the second time I've updated after a long break and lost ALL my progress. Last time I contacted devs and they restored to an estimated level. There was no way to know how far I had gotten without connecting to Facebook (which I don't have). I had completed hundreds of levels, developed at least 3 sections of the garden. 👎 Not cool. Otherwise the gameplay is like every other match 3. Beat levels, earn stars, use stars to clean up and decorate. 3 options for decorations.

Was very disappointed! ! I NEVER write reviews but I dont want people to waste their time and be disappointed the way I was. I had seen multiple ads of the misleading game. In the ad, I seen situations where you have to choose from 3 items to fix the situation. After downloading the game, it's nothing like the ad. Very misleading. I think if the game was as the ad shows, it would be a very fun and interesting game.

Overall, it's a decent game but it has its issues. It's simple and easy to play, more so than some other match 3 games. I don't like the fact that you're automatically entered into competitions that require you to collect things when the punishment for not collecting enough is demotion through the ranks. At least give the option to opt in, because you don't always have the time to play. Also, 3hrs unlimited energy is excessive.

Note to developers: this game is all chance. there is no opportunity to strategize. I try to drop item into a sequence and they will get interrupted mid fall ruining the sequence. or i will get 4 items drop in a row only to have the first 3 disappear instead of all 4 which would give me a rocket. No one can be "good" or "bad" at this game.

It's been a fairly neat match type game, with a few different twists, along with the extra play to complete various tasks to evolve landscapes in more and more areas. The one problem they have with the game is that they rate many of the levels incorrectly. A number of levels are ridiculously hard, and some are still marked as normal, if not hard already. They need to rate the levels in more varieties. Such as normal, difficult, hard, & super-hard, etc. Plus rate them a little more appropriately. Then maybe also give a tiny bit more rewards (like an extra star or two for hard & super-hard). The newer events help with progress some, and without certain ones it is ridiculously hard if not impossible to proceed. The really high levels (above 2,500 or so) some have gotten super-duper hard. With new events to get more decorations and whatnot (like Halloween and others) have gotten nearly impossible to earn all the new items being such a high level. Tone down the difficulty, or make it easier to earn things more quickly.

My favorite game of the dozens I have tried. I've been playing for over a year and its still challenging. Also one of the rare games you don't have to pay to play. As long as you are persistent you can score high in the contests without spending any money at all. Absolutely the best puzzle match game ever. Plus it has a fun story line with lots of choices on how you want things decorated. I love seeing the areas I unlock become beautiful.

This game is fun and addicting. But the level designs need to be looked over because there are so many that I got stuck on for days at a time. I'm getting tired or the repetitive nature of me continuously losing no matter what I do. I guess if I used real money in this game I can go through the levels with ease, but then that means this is a money grabbing game. 😞 Really game designers, you couldn't have done the levels less frustrating?

Very fun game, however extremely hard to get past levels without spending money. I think levels should gradually get harder, however, levels are named "Hard" and "Extremely Hard" almost from the very beginning. You have to complete levels of gardens to get power ups which take forever to achieve. Love the concept but I'm uninstalling due to the amount of money needed to play the game!

I like this as a match 3 game, and enjoy building my garden, but the ads suggest that it is a very different style of game. At no point do you solve any problems. Even with the choices you have, they are limited to decorating the garden, and sometimes I do not like the options provided by Austin's taste in landscape architecture. The advertising is really misleading.

I not sure who told the developer that people enjoy playing "hard" and "extra hard" levels that you have repeat over & over & over again. It is so frustrating to have to play the same level 100 times or more before you can move forward (I've been playing for a while, and am at a high level) I continue on because I enjoy the fixing up the garden aspect of the game, but, honestly, I've reached the point where the frustration outweighs the enjoyment and i probably won't play much longer

False advertising. If you were brought here by the obstacle course ads, THERE ARE NO OBSTACLE COURSES. It is all matching sliding pieces to bring down or collect pieces, to earn points to then restore and decorate sub-gardens, or points to use to apply their solutions to occasional problems. But I will still give it two stars, because other than not being at all the game that was advertised, it's quite engrossing.

This game crashes constantly!!! I've played it for the last 5 years or more, and it used to be something to pass time... But lately it's began crashing so much! Mainly after I purchase 5 additional moves to help me complete a level. So once you go back into the game, you've wasted money as it doesn't let you stay on that level that you just bought more moves to complete you go back to the beginning of it. Contacted customer support and they've not been any help!!!

I can't give this game a terrible rating because it was very fun to play up until after the treehouse frame was built. Then it became virtually unplayable without pumping money into the game. I would rather either have ads in the game or pay a reasonable, one-time fee for a fun mobile game, rather than have a Kobayashi Maru scenario that is impossible to beat in order to force people to make in-game purchases. Like I said, still a good game and worth checking out.

Its beautifully designed, the animations are terrific. A lot of fun but, some of the levels are impossible without spending at least $4.99 to pass thru. So it isnt really worth that price. They helped us out with a "golden ticket" at $4.99 which buys 8 tries rather than the standard 5. There are lots of ways to get thru levels with boosters, asking friends, joining a team, and claiming gifts, memos that contain coins etc. I'll probably reinstall in a few months but need a break.

7/11/2020 UPDATE: It's been a while since my last review. For quite some time now I hardly play the game due to the game always getting stuck. It's seems the higher the level one gets the more the problem of it getting stuck happens. I gave this game 5 stars before, but now I'm dropping it to 1 star due to its technical problems. Sad, I use to love playing it everyday. Now I rarely play it. Gave it many times for the technical problems to be fixed but I'm thinking to uninstall it soon.

Beautiful game and a great twist on Match-3 games, but having to complete a level for the most miniscule of tasks gets pretty tedious. Plus it seems the more you progress, the more levels you have to complete for most tasks. I'm already past level 100 and I've only completed two areas. Combine some of this pestering multistep tasks, especially the ones that aren't even really related to restoring the Garden.

I used to love it, but the further I go the harder it becomes. I mean, the hard levels are ridiculously hard unless you spend money, and even the easy levels take me too many goes! I never get past about 4 levels when we are trying to grow a flower or bonsai, and don't get me started on the dog training levels! I'm thinking about giving it up. I dont think one star is enough for each level because it takes so long to get ahead, and I can't afford to spend money. 😐

The game is fun! It really makes you think about how to solve the puzzles! The only thing I find myself wishing for is a back button to undo a move (but maybe that would make the game too easy!). I also wish for more variety about choosing a character as an avatar to my liking. I had a small amount of options to choose from. There were mostly white characters and a few ethnic looking people. I would also like to choose/decide how my butler looks the same way I would like to choose my avatar. 👍

I decided to try this based on an ad in another game, but the ad was completely misleading. It showed the garden in disarray, and you would choose from a set of tools to repair (or fail to) broken parts. The real game involves being assigned random things to fix by your butler (why is my butler telling me what to do??), and you have to play a match-3-tiles game to earn stars to complete tasks. It's boring. You can't skip tasks and the puzzle aspect had nothing to do with repairing the garden.

FALSE ADVERTISING! The gameplay is not what is advertised. There's no matching tools to fix problems. It's just a regular match 3 game. From the look of it, it seems like it's in it for the cash and reading the "good" reviews, people have spent a pretty penny on their gameplay. If the gameplay matched the ads I wouldn't mind keeping the game or spending money, but falsely presenting something is a big issue to me.

I saw different ads over and over for this app so I finally decided to try it. The gameplay depicted in the ads is no where in this game. I looked online for info hoping I was wrong. I didn't want another match 3 game; I was more interested in the logic aspect depicted in the ads. I was very disappointed in the very misleading false ad. It's truly amazing the lengths someone will go to try and convince you to try their product and give you something completely different, even if it is "free".

Love this game, have it over a year, nearly on level 2000. Updated it and the game has not worked properly since. Kept freezing each time I beat a level and would have to go out of the game and back in again to play each time. Had just under 4 hours of free play, alot of bombs etc. Have trouble shooted. Uninstalled the game and installed again and the game wont even start now. There is obviously a bug in the game. Help!! I want to keep playing!

i cannot deal with the timed levels. Or the timed bombs . i have uninstalled the game twice. I just re-installed, and it is on level 651. I'm through with it. I was hoping to start on level 1,as to enjoy acheivements and progress. I can't afford this game. When I bought boosters, someone started logging onto my account and drained my credit card. I changed my password but they are still attempting to login 10 to 30 times a day. I do like the game, but I can't win.

NOT as advertised The game itself is a creatively done matching game. The difficulty curve is too steep for a casual game, and almost requires the use of purchased bonuses to progress after only a few days of play. Additional time investment doesn't help you, as it's level based. But the real reason for my low score is the game is NOTHING like the pop-up ads for it in other apps. There's no "choose the right item to fix the problem" component to this game at all. It's purely a matching game.

Constantly makes moves I didn't do. Have to press the 'x' button 12 times for it to actually work. Repeatedly gives the same notification as if a 3 year old is playing. Always asks about facebook even though I have never and will never have one. Forces you to see the storyline. Doesn't allow you to use your unlimited life at a later time. Extremely annoying to have suggested moves constantly flashing. And when you want to exit the game it takes an entire 30 seconds to clear your screen.

I downloaded the game because the puzzles looked fun in the ads. Instead it's just a bunch of match three puzzles with some extra steps. It's cute overall, but since it was advertised as one thing and is another altogether, it has that going against it, for me. The way the puzzles are structured with limited turns, it really is more about luck than skill or strategy, which is really annoying. This is especially apparent when they want you to pay for extra lives.

Game is definately NOT as advertised. Not even anything close to what was advertised. Tried playing just to see if maybe the parts advertised were in some sort of bonus but no. I did end up enjoying the game and still play. But it was very mis leading. A suggestion for improved game play would be to have the infinity bonuses. (Eg unlimited lives for 30 min) be sent to your inbox, not just automatically applied. It's frustrating when you are ready to log off & you get a bonus like that. Wasted.

I played this game for years, I can assure you that it will never be what you saw in the ads. I used to love this game, found it charming, played it daily. Something changed. It got to the point where you couldn't progress without money, there isn't an option to turn off the aggravating hints, the game constantly asks if you want to buy an item, a life, more coins, buy to continue, buy a safe of coins, etc. Old players are disadvantaged- & there's not enough space to type everything you'll hate.

It's just a standard matching game. The storyline is inconsistent and painfully slow, regardless of difficulty each level only earns 1 star (used to complete goals), it sends you back to the garden after each level instead of just letting you continue playing and you don't have any control over the garden you're supposed to be building, it's 100% dictated by your "butler" (who either did or did not work at the house before you lived there, depending on... who knows what). Weirdly good animation.

I like being able to decorate with flowers, but so far each garden ends up looking over the top and totally choked and gaudy. I wish there was an option to go and delete features for those who prefer a more minimalist style. Also, I wish there were more options for flower combinations to choose from. i think the dialogue of the characters is obnoxious. The old man talking like yoda is offensive.

I am not a fan. This is a frustrating game where passing the "hard" levels is nearly impossible. you need to purchase items with your own money, for instance, as you earn money it goes into a safe. but to access the money you must purchase the safe for $2.99. The items are not worth their value. even with the few power ups you get for $15, you still cannot pass many of the levels. save your frustrations.

The game seems to cheat you as you move to higher levels. The game requires spending a lot of money just to move to another level. Then you lose interest. Do nit like decisions made for me to select an item or move to another section if garden or switch to an entirely new garden away from estate. Do not like some of the selections for garden. You have to use vendor's selection to customize garden. Many are poor selection.

So far, so good. I'm only here for the mini games, so hopefully they stay every other level. The ads are a ruse because they don't show the Candy Crush ripoff levels and the design distractions, but as long as the minigames are readily accessible, I'm good. Once they're harder to reach, I'm done. Homescapes has better levels and better tools, but few minis. So we'll see. False advertising, though, from the jump.

I, like many others, downloaded this game with the expectations that I would be choosing between items that would best support the character to help get him out of certain situations. I have yet to encounter ANY of those types of situations. So far its a candy crush game to earn stars to fix up a garden. I have made it to level 45, I am stuck and have yet to see anything like the advertisement. I refuse to buy coins or items just to beat a level in a game that is nothing like I expected.

I installed it because it was an ad for another game. The ad is nothing like the actual game which is a shame. In any case, the game is fun but like others mention, very frustrating. Not enough turns are given to even remotely come close to beating certain levels. As mentioned, spending money is required to advance further without "chancing" a win at most levels. I uninstalled it because I won't spend that kind of money and when you can't beat a level after trying 50+ times, it's not worth it.

The game is too hard. Takes forever to complete puzzles and takes too long to advance. Too many parts to completing tasks, ie: 1 star to make a phone call, 2 -3 stars to have the task done, then something breaks, another star for the phone call, 2 more stars to fix it, etc, etc, etc. Good if you have a lot of friends that play if not they just want your money.

Absolutely ridiculous. It begins very fun and casual, but evertually the levels get frustratingly difficult. You'll lose all your coins trying to beat the level because it's impossible to do so with the amount of moves given, and the only way to get more coins without completing levels is to buy them. I have Homscapes as well and that game is the same way.

I really do like this game. I've gotten pretty far to level 3000 or so. I guess it's a testament to how addictive it is! However, some of the levels are WAY too hard. I find myself getting stressed out over a game that's supposed to be relaxing! And the red 'hard' levels pop up too frequently seemingly at random. Maybe make them come up like every 10 levels or so?

The game is fun and challenging. Some puzzles are difficult, but sooner or later you can solve them. The story is is a nice way to progress through the game. The animation and sounds are very pleasant. The demo of the game is misleading. It makes you think that you choose different options to fix problems, not a match 3 similar objects in a puzzle. Overall its fun.

It's fun and aesthetically pleasing as you progress and provides a nice challenge. It is however a bit ridiculous sometimes. Having to get stars to look at a package, then another to open it, another to send it off...you sometimes just aren't motivated to get stars because you aren't seeing any progression, it feels like an awful filler episode in a good series. Other than that, good game for time wasting. Edit: Lowered my rating for false advertising. I used to play this game and find ads for it all over but they advertise something that certainly isn't Gardenscapes. If those ads get you more people installing, then create a game like that. Don't falsely advertise before you get taken to court for it.

The ads for this game involve escaping a bad situation. I finally downloaded it, it seemed interesting. But where the heck is that! It's a candy-crush-esque game with fixing up a house. I have 0 interest in that. I wanted to solve the puzzle of the escape part. I've been playing for like 2 hours now (in total) and I still haven't gotten to any escaping. Uninstalling. Edit, because I can't reply your reply: It's not even a general idea. It's false advertising. No. Make the ad game instead.

The main reason why only have this two stars is due to the false advertising. The engaging "choice" games in the advertising are nowhere to be found in the game. It's a puzzle game similar to candy crush. That's misleading and should be illegal. In addition, the game is very monotonous and repetitive. You beat levels to gain coins and then use those coins to upgrade your garden. It's just a never ending game of clicking and waiting as different parts of the garden are being upgraded.

A lot of the levels are impossible to win. No matter what moves are made, no way to win. Play for days not winning. Update: At level 2738, I think I have gotten pretty good at it, but I'm laid up and have been playing this level for 2 weeks several times a day, have used extra moves and all the power things several times. Game is diffently programmed to not allow you to win. Can't get past it so time to uninstall! Update, if I could rate it lower I would, There is a difference between random and

This game is nothing more than a money pit. After a certain level there is no way to beat the levels without multiple boost and even than it might take several tries before completing it. Other than the "puzzles" the game is great I just wish the was an actual way to play it. All the games like this are the same, they have great stories but unless your willing to shovel out cash there is no way to play.

The first thing you should know it that this is really not a relaxing game at all. If I had to pick one word, it would be Frustrating. The second thing is the characters of the woman and child you see in the ads actually barely feature, and instead of renovating the garden (the part I was actually interested in) you have to spend almost all of your time doing crazy random fruit-machine levels. The levels quickly become hard (or impossible) and you can't skip, or watch an ad.

A very fun & relaxing game! The levels aren't impossible too pass, but do have some challenge to them. The stories are cute & characters are lovable. It's quite a good game, and I'm quickly becoming addicted! The ads weren't misleading either as they do often have mini-games with what they advertised. My only problem currently is that some of the mini-game levels glitch out and I can't see the water. I can still play it, but the lack of visuals can mess up some gameplay at times.

Deleting. Some of the levels are a VERY hard!! I would definitely change a few things with the game. I was playing this game to relax, but lately it has become stressful. Sometimes you okay the same level for days without passing. One of the things that I hate the most, is that when there are no more moves, the game forces you to use your bonuses, plus they place them where they want them in the game!! Hate that!!

I have removed this game. Too many changes over the last year that have made it less fun and more frustrating, shake feature on bomb detonation, added back super hard levels, etc. It got to the point where I felt the main game goal was to get me to use all power - ups and have to buy my more to advance. There are a lot of match games out there, if it's not broke don't mess it up by continually adding things. Maybe concentrate on making good levels rather than just getting them out there.

I dismissed this game after two years of play, but they woo'd me back with gifts. It really is a fun and relaxing way to unwind, but getting stuck on a difficult level for three weeks, just causes anxiety. I'm on one of the troublesome levels right now, and I'm getting tired of losing. I may have to delete you again Gardenscapes?! Sorry! 😕 I am terribly sorry that I must delete this game from my apps. It is no longer fun. I've saved up points and powerups. Spent $1 - $10 for not.

Picked this up last week. Really enjoyed it. Challenging but not stupid. The story is cute. Gave this game 5 stars.  Now, only 1.  This is a GOOD FUN CHALLENGING game but it is really just a glorified cash grab.  The rewards you receive are not enough to keep playing without spending money.  The coins you receive for beating each level are not nearly enough to keep purchasing bombs, gloves, rakes, dynamite, etc.  and again, you're spending money.  You need the extras in order to beat the hard levels and you definitely need them for the super hard levels.  Then there are the regular levels that have the honey, the hard honey, the honey pots, the carpets (or whatever they're supposed to be).  You get no warning they're coming up in the next level unless they're part of a 'goal'.  You need to be pretty much 'perfect' in order to beat these levels without any extras.  As for the 'Cash' to purchase the extras, why?  They don't add anything to the game play.  You get no reward for it and honestly, I've found the majority of them to be useless to the garden I've created.  I'm on level 429.  I've spent the last dime on this game that I'm willing to spend.  Too bad I won't finish the game.

This is a high quality game which took a lot to develop, so I don't mind spending some money on it. However, as others have mentioned, it does eventually become unplayable. I rage quit on level 412. Absolutely impossible. I used multiple boosts and coins and couldn't get past it. A shame - I could have been a months or even years long player, with a regular budget for it, but quit after a week. Adjust your algorithm if you want to keep players.

I used to love this game, but it's become increasingly frustrating. It almost always requires either coins, or boosters to pass levels, but I've put up with it. Until now. I'm fed up. The addition of multi-level games and "challenge levels" is an obvious ploy to strip players of boosters between the levels. Playrix has just gotten WAY TOO GREEDY. I understand you need to make money, but it's become ridiculous. I'm off to search for a new game. Which makes me sad. And angry.

The game itself is great. I especially like the visuals in the garden and the cute story. However after only a short while the levels become excruciatingly hard. In fact so hard that you are almost forced to buy boosts and/or retrys. And it's not like buying a premium account for an adequate price. You'd have to pay after every few levels. If you are not ready to pay unhealthy sums it becomes unplayable after just enough time to make you addicted. Stay away from this!

This game is a money pit! Beware!!! In the beginning it won't seem to cost much but the longer you play and the more levels you beat the higher the cost will be to move on to the next next level. Levels become increasingly difficult to the point of impossible to beat without costing additional money to purchase special tools. Very addictive game and I have enjoyed playing very much but I refuse to spend anymore money on it!!! And since I have taken that stand I have not been able to move forward. Fun game but beware it is a money pit!!!

Been playing for about 2 weeks, and it's not the game, it is portrayed to be. I was hoping to help characters get out of situations. Instead I am playing a version of candy crush. The game is slow moving, and the rewards are not enough to continue play, and beat the tough challenges. There is also so many competition s going on, it is just too much. Super disappointed it was not the advertised game, that I was constantly seeing. Removing it.

The game has great animation and I like customizing my garden. I've been playing for years and now the "easy" levels are getting difficult to beat. I feel like the amount of moves available have been significantly lowered. The pink "challenge" levels are terrible. The only way to advance is to use your boosters (and then waiting a few days until you can collect more). It's getting to the point where I'd have to spend more money than I'm willing to in order to advance to the next level.

Horrible game!!!!!! They just want your money. I've tried one level countless times and I can't seem to beat It. I ran out of coins and items trying to beat it and now the only way for me to get an edge on it is to wait for my daily spin (and save items for days) or purchase items and coins. Well you set up the game so you have to spend money way to go. I will not be spending money!

All the ads for this game showed entirely different gameplay of what the game actually is. It's just a bland, run of the mill matching game that does nothing that the ads imply. I wanted to play a game where I had to figure out how to fix and repair things, and the only actual gameplay is solve a matching puzzle, get a star, spend star and repeat. Not a fun game.

It's very fun, levels are still possible to beat without the boosters but easier with them. I don't like is that there is a lot of unnecessary things happening while rebuilding the garden like the guests are always coming through and you must do stuff for them that costs you stars. I want is to decorate/rebuild the garden not pull some helicopters off of the roof. Too many things going on, some of the missions require 3+ stats, gets irritating. All I want to do is to simply rebuild the garden.

This could be an enjoyable game, but as it is it's just another "pay to play" aggravation. While I don't mind supporting developers, I DO mind when the PTW element is over the top, and this one most certainly is. 900 coins for 5 extra moves (and you'll need them for a good many levels) is ridiculous when the reward for completing the level is about 60 to 70 coins. I'm deleting this one without hesitation.

EDIT: Too many unskippable animations and pop-ups. Ridiculous. The game is fun, and the stories are cute, but once you get to a certain point some of the levels are literally impossible. Not just difficult— they don't give you productive moves. It's an underhanded technique to get you to spend $ on the game. It frustrates me because I DO already spend money on the game. Too much! I buy every golden ticket and will often buy packages or coins. And it's never enough to Playrix.

The advertisment for this game is very misleading. It's still the same match 3 game that gets more difficult, and nearly impossible to beat levels without buying boosters. I stopped playing it, and Homescapes because it was ridiculously hard to beat a level. Getting stuck on a level for a couple of days is one thing. Getting stuck for days, or even weeks, is ridiculous.

I've been bombarded with ads for this game for ages and decided to give it a try. It is not the game the ads make it out to be. It's a puzzle matching game instead of the choice-driven game advertised. The game looks nice and has basic puzzle matching mechanics, but is obviously designed to encourage you to spend real money (as most games are now). Despite the misleading ads I gave it try for a few days. Pretty boring, very disappointing. Will be uninstalling it.

Some levels will say they're normal, but they will be extremely hard to beat. Be prepared for extraordinary hard levels. I'll be stuck for days on a single level. The garden is super pretty and it is fun to decorate. I wish there were more things to do in the app so you dont just log in, play for 10 minutes with no progression, and try again in another hour or two

Been stuck on level 37 for almost a week now and sick of it. The coin rewards for completing levels are so low that it makes it near impossible to buy any power ups or anything for that matter, and the fact that you have to BUY coins and there's no other way is ridiculous. At least make things more affordable in the game. The ad for the game are extremely misleading as well. Why not MAKE the game the way you ADVERTISE it? I believe the term im looking for is.... FALSE ADVERTISEMENT!!!! DELETED!

The game wasnt as advertised. You cant pass the higher levels without spending money. It will give you bombs to help but place it where you cant use it, like the side of the board already finished. Or it will land on the one spot you have a move, forcing you to use it early. Or it will land on the one spot where you could have made another bomb, thus helping your game. It requires more stars to finish the tasks but you cant finish the tasks without spending money.

It's good for what it is. But, as someone who played the two original Gardenscapes I miss the hidden object portion. That was one of the things I loved most about it. I've played this game since the beginning and will probably continue to play. I love the decorating and restoring aspects and the graphics are great. I do wish that some things didn't need to use stars. Why use 2 stars to call someone when I've called them without using stars before? Also some of the side quests that require stars are frivolous and have nothing to do with restoring the garden. The only other thing I'll say is that I think the majority of decisions should have options not just 60-75%.

This game glitches at the most inconvenient times. In the middle of a challenge the game would just stop working. Once it allows you to play again the only way to catch up is to spend money. Super sketchy shame on the developers. .. update I deleted the game today at 4397. The game load time is super slow. The constant pop ups about events that you have to waste time watching before you can skip and the schemes to spend money became too much. I wouldn't recommend this game to anyone

Falsely advertised as a puzzle game. You know that when a game can't show you what it's truly about, then it isn't worth downloading. The actual game gets repetitive after a while. Since you only get one star for completing every match level, it takes a long time to even do one task. There are many tasks that I found to be useless, and it overall just made my experience frustrating.
