I've played this game before, and the ads are false, garden scapes is a game that is like candy crush, you match 3 or more and have a limited amount of turns to clear the stage, doing so allows you to unlock more of your garden and make it look really nice. Idk why they've moved to these fake ads and screen shots, but it was a decent game when I played it. I'm giving it 1 star because of the false ads.

Ads are NOTHING LIKE THE GAME!! FALSE ADVERTISING to the max!! I loved the ad and it looked like so much fun that I could pick and choose what to do to save the person but however that is not the option here. And same thing with their other game "Homescapes" You just play a bunch of "candy crush" like games to win stars so that the stars can help you to complete tasks and the tasks go on and on and on!! You're cleaning up the mansion but you're not choosing your option like the advertising!

Totally misleading video ad, just like their equally misleading ad for "Fishdom". This game is basically a match-3 game to gain a star that can be used to complete a pre-defined task. Of course there are no limitations on the options for spending money. On that point it excels. Otherwise there is no strategy, no user options, no intellect required. You have to be a mindless drone to like this game. Uninstalled after reaching level 63. What's the point?

I'm new to this game. I love the landscape aspect and the tasks. But the matching game is too difficult to beat after level 39 without spending so much money. I dont mind spending money if I can move forward, but that's not true for this game. I Prefer Township game. I don't have to wait for silly matching games and getting lives to play. I just play. I spend money but I feel that I'm getting somewhere. Won't be playing this game much longer

I downloaded this game simply to leave a review. The ads are infuriating and I really wish it was illegal. Games like words with friends show this games ad after every move. And every month they get worst. I used to be able to simply skip them, then I have to wait to skip. Then they add the pause after trying to skip. Then they make the x smaller and hard to find. I urge everyone to stop giving in to these ads. This company is all about money and not quality of content.

Interesting for a while. Higher levels become entirely too difficult to move forward. I'll go days in a row unable to complete even basic levels, even using additional power-ups. Last update has REALLY made the game hitchy. Freezes, occasionally even reboots. Might be at the end of my rope. Burning through 5 lives twice a day to not advance at all most times is getting boring. Maybe you'll just be better than me.

I saw an ad for this game. Now I never download games from ads but you know what, it looked interesting. It showed this was a puzzle game where you have to remove certain bars to free a man without releasing the spider, or fire, or what have you from its cage and causing certain doom. Sounds cool, right? The actual game is NOTHING like the ad. Downloading was a total waste of time. It may be a nice game on its own but I was looking to play the game that was ACTUALLY advertised. This isn't it.

If someone is looking for a match-3 game with other activities along the way, then fine. But that's not what the previews for this game show. It shows puzzles where you need to make decisions to solve a problem or get someone/something somewhere. Those puzzles looked kind of fun, but after a few hours of doing match-3 levels to get credits so I can put decorations in the garden, I had still not seen anything like the previews. If this is going to be primarily match-3, then they should market it as such. Or if they are going to market it as problem-solving puzzles, then they should give the user that kind of puzzles without having to wade through the match-3 levels, which I can find in dozens (or hundreds) of other games. Match-3 is not why I loaded this app (but it is why I uninstalled it).

I love this game! I do have a suggestion though which would be to have to have an option at the end of each puzzle to watch a video to earn extra lives. Most games have this option and it gives you between 3-5 extra lives. It's annoying to be down to needing 1 or 2 more and you need to spend 900 coins and then if that isn't enough, then it's 1200 coins which is a lot and I always have to buy them and I may not be able to which is annoying! Thank you

I totally disliked that you call this "GARDEN" scapes, but you force us to use our hard earned points on things like a pet. You also force us to change our gardens without giving the player a choice. Show us what designs we can change it to then let us decide if or when we want to change it! It's not easy earning points and there are plenty of places in the garden to fix without adding all the other stuff. I uninstalled the game because I was told what to do, instead of being given a choice.

This game has changed so drastically over the years, it no longer resembles the game I used to love. There is no more decorating of your garden. The decorating part was the foundation of the game. Now, it's all rigged to try to force you to spend money. Stupid expedition after expedition. Unless they plan on going back to the original reason for the game - DECORATING YOUR GARDEN - they need to change the name. Absolutely no gardenscaping exists anymore. Stupid expeditions have taken over.

Game is always looking for ways to get you to spend money. Buying in game items for what amounts to non-existent rewards and progress. Don't fall for it. Also, hate the character Austin. He decides the tasks, many of which are stupid and consume stars. He makes decisions and blunders which cost stars to repair. Plus, he won't go in the game where I direct him if he doesn't "want" to. The dog is pointless. I don't like many features of this, and you will not get me to spend real world money.

I give up. Been playing for years (seriously). And although I routinely spend money to move up to 8 lives, apparently that isn't enough money in their opinion, so they put in levels that are impossible to beat without spending more money...which makes the money I spent on extra lives wasted. Just not fun any more. Uninstalled.

False advertising on what the game really is. I mean the ad is everywhere and looks funny. But when you actually start playing the game, it's nothing like that add. Thus a star being taken off. With that being said, it is a pretty fun and decent game otherwise for me to kick back and kill time while I'm waiting on other things in different games to finish. Graphics are pretty stellar, too.

Fun but this is just another pay-to-play game. Often too few moves for levels which require many more to complete. As many other commenters here have said, one is basically set up to fail so that they can spend real money buying coins which quickly vanish once you start spending them. Nothing is below 900 coins. I get that you have to make money but you charge way too many coins for stuff. Uninstalling before I become addicted enough to actually want to spend my money here on a regular basis.

The game is fun but so many thing just ruin the experience. First the game is basically a Pay-to-win, you can't beat certain levels wothout having to use power ups and extra moves. I'll have an objective like get 5 gnomes, I'll only need one more but there are literally no helpful moves around my objective. Next the game will literally just make moves for me or do something I didn't want it to do. The game will get very frustrating on the early levels which is bad. Don't suggest downloading.

Lots of fun! addictive!! At first. Then you cant pass a level unless you buy something. No skill at all. Just chance as they rig pices in games to fail if no $ paid. Also, lots of updates taking more and more memory and game still freezes or runs slow at times. Wasted a lot of money on this and now have to u I stall and lose all that I have invested in.

I totally love both games and play them on a daily bases . I have spent a lot of money on both games but find it a little frustrating when u win a game and most of the money goes into the safe and u have to pay to get the money out of the safe . Little unfair as it's your winnings . Any chance u can not have the safe. We spend a lot on boosters any way . But over all love the game and will keep playing

If I could give it zero I would. I completed 600+ levels and then couldn't complete a single level on the first try. I uninstalled after being unable to beat a level for 4 straight days. I reinstalled to leave this review. You get on average 15 coins and 5 enegy per level, unless they're "super hard" then you can get around 100. It cost 900 coins to "play on" if you don't beat the level on the first try and it only goes up from there. It cost 20 or 30 energy on average to break one item.

I have a complaint about the difficulty. Recently, I repeat the level many and many times until I got bored with it! I'm sure you didn't study the number of movies as well! It wasn't as difficult as it's now!? Just people with much money can play !!! This is the new message we got. If this situation will continue, I will delete the game! you can't beat the level unless you purchase coins or power!! Really I got sick of it.

All the ads on other games make it seem that in this game you have to solve problems in order to fix a situation but its actually just a 3 by 3 matching game. those type of games are fine but the ads are clearly a lie. Plus when you play the game it becomes clear ealry on the only way to really progress would be to spend money which is not great.

This game was fun at first but now? it's just frustrating! It freezes when I'm in the middle of a game, it takes ages to load, 'to the point of not playing'. You make levels super hard, (I'm not spending my money on your game) - it's exactly that, a game! The garden takes too much data. I'm deleting the game, I've had enough! Goodbye!

This game was advertised as a puzzle game, but I installed it only to find that there are no puzzles and it's a pretty standard 'skinner box' game where the rewards get more and more difficult to attain the further you make it, mixed with an occasional candy switching game. I'm not sure why they'd try to garner interest by using a game element that's different from what the game is. Very misleading advertising.

I don't recommend this game. The game is slow, long and boring. It's not at all the same as the ads preview. It's basically another candy crush game but the rewards are so low it takes too long to accumulate coins per star point to complete each task in order to continue onto the next one. Totally false advertisement compared to what the game really is.

Total con! The ad for this game showed a puzzle type game where you use different objects to save the characters from impending doom. In reality you get a candy crush type game where you use stars to complete tasks around the house. That's one issue. The other issues is that no matter how well you do on a level, you only get ONE star so each task equals a level. Very disappointing.

Very nice game but eventually you will have to spend real money to get the powerups needed to finish a level. What I have a hard time understanding is the false advertising for the game. Why? At first, I thought I downloaded the wrong game. Nope. Your ad is blatently misleading. It is NOTHING like advertised. Makes me a little nervous about how safe this game is.

Great game. I like the variety of challenges, the side stories and no ads. I don't understand why people complain when they can't pass a level. Some levels are hard and take me a couple of days to get through, but if it was all easy or I had a button to skip, where would be the satisfaction to pass a level. I haven't spent a cent on the game and I am around level 2700 in under 3 months. My only negative is that the mini games disappeared after a while. One every 10-20 levels or so would be nice.

I love the game but the description on the recent game where you could get a new cat was really misleading...I spent a lot of money and ended up getting the same result as if I had just played. No cat even though the ad said 'new pet' implying one would get the new pet if you spent the money. I will never buy anything again.

Going to use the same wording as I did for Homescapes because it was the exact same dissapointment. NOT AS ADVERTISED. There are tons of games where you switch around shapes in the app store. I don't need to play another one like that. Would've preferred the version in the ad where you choose among three different choices to determine your outcome...Not sure how this has 4.5 stars...

This game is nothing but a money trap. It lets you get within one move of finishing on your last move. The number of stars required to do tasks increase, while each level is still only worth one star and occasionally two stars. So don't get hooked on this game, because after a while you will never advance unless you're willing to pay a whole lot of money.

Not as advertised! I downloaded this game based on a Facebook advertisement that showcased interesting looking puzzle games that are NOWHERE TO BE SEEN IN THE ACTUAL GAME! It's just a third rate Candy Crush. You have to beat one of the matching games to get a single star. That single star is then used to complete just one task. It's just an incredibly flawed system and it's no wonder they have to lie to you about the gameplay to get you to play it. Uninstalling. Never playing again.

The term "false advertising" comes to mind. This game was advertised in one of my other apps and featured a garden where everything is going wrong, and the player has to use various tools to fix things. This is not actually in the game. Actual game play is your basic match-three type of game, with a kind of story playing out in the background. It's a pleasant time filler just like every other match-three out there, with better graphics than most.

This game is the biggest load of false advertising I've seen in like forever, it's nothing like the adds for the game that are displayed in other apps. I didn't even know it's a match the fruit game till I played it ... It was ok the first few minutes but after that the game is all about luck and really repetitive. Down to its core it's play a game, win or lose build a single object that takes time and then play another match game ... It's excessively boring because that's all that awaits you...

Have been playing this for over 6 years and for the longest time the rewards and prices were reasonable. Not anymore, coin prices have gone up a lot, the rewards are an absolute joke and now even they took away the earnings of the special events. Definitely getting rid of this once my coins are gone. Don't even want to think about how much money I have put into this game but no more it's not worth it. They have turned into money grubbing hogs and don't care about the players who play the game.

the games software isn't complete so once you accomplish a small garden area after working way too hard on the puzzles, there is nowhere else to go. I spent a lot of time building a small area only to find out that nothing else could be done. also, like homescapes, the levels are too hard and in the beginning I did spend money but because the levels are so hard I would have had to keep throwing money at it. I deleted it after a few days

The ad for this game had puzzles, where you would have to move rods in a specific way as to save a guy. After downloading I find it's just another bejeweled type game. Maybe there's something like the ad in there but I thought I'd be trying to complete challenging puzzles. Not move the flowers to get 3 or more to clear the level and earn stars. Real bait and switch game. I uninstalled it after 5 minutes.

Horrible Money Forcing Game!! DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME! Been playing for over a year! Once you get to the 1000s stages they become unplayable unless you constantly keep buying help! That is not a challenge, it's cheating!!! I cannot believe I spent so much free time building this garden to have it wasted by inept practices and extortion like principals! I have spent money on event extras but that, I guess, is not enough! Do not waste your time on this game!!!

Its a great game, love playing it, there are some really hard levels though, and i dont think you should have to do another game everytime you have to do something. like finding the rake to rake the leaves, then playing another game to have him rake the leaves! Those games to find all the gnomes frustrates me, they are hard to do 90% of the time, should have some more interaction with the character too instead of always playing the games in every step you take 😊

This was false advertising! I downloaded the game based on their ads. The ads are basically the mini game you get once a day. The real game is match 3 game (aka candy crush). I thought I would try it out since I already downloaded the game. I'm now at the "soper hard level"...it just wants you to spend money to level up. No thanks...uninstalling!

Very lame, we get the challenge side of the house but when you constantly have wasted moves and not enough moves in order to complete its fustrating. Not to mention the power ups dont fill the meters the same amount on every level, its fluctuating and some boards fill faster while others are an absorbent amount of moves that end up being wasted trying to fill. Pathetic in all honesty, not worth it in the end.

Fun at first, but when you hit certain levels, don't expect to be at them for days or longer, unless you spend money. Your entire game time will only last but a few minutes before you run out of lives. I recommend downloading a PS1 or psp emulator and the isos. It's free, and you can play all day without spending a dime. thousands of games. You don't even need to be online. Just some friendly advice. This game takes a fun time, and turns it into many aggravating moments.

Game is pretty fun BUT.... They ripped me off. I made an in game purchase for the Paris tale theme. Spent a little more than 8 bucks for a unique statue, 9000 croissants and some power ups. I only received the statue. It is nearly impossible to follow the procedure to make the complaint. They want a screen shot of your purchase but you can't upload a screenshot to their in game text screen and they no longer communicate through email. Only 3 days left on the Paris theme. I was hoping to finish.

Deceitful in its Advertising. This game advertises itself, like so many other games, to be an entirely different type of game. One which you have to remove certain pins in order to get the character out of danger. Instead, this game is a gem matching type game and your reward for the coins collected while playing the game, allows you to redecorate the home. How about u developers stop being lazy & actually create a game that u r so obnoxiously advertising.

This game is very fun but the developers really try to force you to pay money. Way too many levels are impossible unless you use multiple power ups and you spend coins at a rate far faster than what you earn them. Really stops being fun. When you buy a power up bundle you expect to last you a month and it doesn't last you for one weekend, it makes you very disinterested in ever buying another

Bit of a disappointment. In the commercial it's suggested that you get puzzles to solve. In the game itself the puzzles are very few. Instead you're requested to play a candy crush like game which gives you very few stars needed to proceed. When you're out of lives you need to wait before you can proceed. As large as the game seems, you would think that they would give you something else to do whilst waiting for new lives.

This is a horrible game. It could be better if you earn more stars per game won. As it is, it takes forever to do anything as far as actually fixing up the garden, and some levels are quite difficult to complete without a lot of power ups. Unless you have the patience of a saint, or money to burn, this game will become very frustrating quite quickly.

Don't download unless you like 'match 3' games! It is NOTHING like the gameplay that the ad shows at all. It is ONLY match games! Very disappointed. Apparently it is a marketing technique that this company uses to get you to download the game thinking that it's going to be a certain way. DON'T FALL FOR IT! Uninstalled for false advertising.

I'm on level 2,334.... I don't like this game at all. Nope. Totally not addicted and play it every day. *sarcasm* Seriously though, it's rare that you can play a game and get past levels w/o having to buy anything with your own money. You do get stuck on levels for what feels like an eternity, but once you pass it, you cruise through a few levels before getting another hard one.

Awesome.. at first! But as I enjoying the game, time and time the levels are getting hard to play with limited moves.🙄🙄 i started to hate this game. Can you make it a little bit easier? And i hate that 1 time big time level, because as i lose, i need to go back to zero so all those power ups and everything are nothing anymore, i have to earn it again and again!

There are better games. A Season Pass is now 2x as much for half as long. We used to get beautiful decorations for the mansions. Now we get ugly statue things for the neighboring parks. And puzzles not even labeled as hard can take a couple of days to beat without using real cash. Why would I want to spend actual money for those ugly park items? It's a lot more fun to play if I don't log in for a month or two. Then I get extra items and can actually beat puzzles for a little while

Its nice to decorate the garden but i agree with some of the comments that most of the levels are a bit challenging and also have so little moves with so many collects or items to uncover and some of the things that you are given to do are just very unnecesary and not needed still an okay time passer when your not stuck in one level for days that is.. 😒

I like the concept of the game however, I give it 2 stars because like many others have previously stated, the game is designed for you to spend your real money in order to progress quickly. Lives take FOREVER to be regenerated, and you need 900 coins get 5 more moves if you've run out of moves at the end of the game. The catch is that you only make ~50 coins on average per game, so if you don't have enough powerups for hard levels, you can be stuck on a hard level for days!!!!!

I waited a long time to review this game. I don't normally review things unless they are really really good. I am well passed level 1500 and I have to admit this is an incredible game. Some levels are easy, some are incredibly hard and some in between. They make the game lots of fun with the competitions that are available and extra additions make going on some winning streaks great for a day off when I just want to do nothing. It's smooth, I never have any issues with it running properly and it's just down right fun. I get sick of most games eventually but this one has kept me interested for sure. Definitely recommend this game. And to top it off I have maybe spent 3 dollars in Google credit on this game.

I've been playing Gardenscapes for about 10 years now and I genuinely love this game, but lately they've made some really questionable changes that really ruin the game. Now, you can only buy one pack of boosters per day. You used to be able to buy as many as you wanted. They reduced the safe from 5000 coins to 3000 coins. They no longer award little bonuses when you complete a certain percentage of an area that's being restored. it's super frustrating.

Unlike some free-to-play games, it doesn't push microtransactions onto your face. Gameplay is simple and enjoyable to the point it might kill too much of your time, but sometimes frustrating due to randomness factor. Update: still playing casually after over a year, still enjoyable even without spending any money.

I'd like to give this game more stars because I've enjoyed it, but every other or third level is either hard/super hard. I just completed a hard level & immediately got another hard level! Then I get a level not listed as hard/super hard, but is actually more difficult to beat! This is supposed to be a game. Fun.I don't want to play a game where every single level takes multiple attempts to pass. No wonder I have never been able to finish a special room! Thinking about uninstalling.

It's basically a candy crush grind. By the time you get to the second map, they don't give you decoration choices, they just "clean" the area and put in default items. The matching part of the game is completely random, no real strategy needed. They also throttle your wins if you don't spend coins.

Had to uninstall because of how frustrating and impossible it was to win a hard level without any power ups. I almost contemplated using my real money to buy coins so that i could continue a level and buy more power ups. I don't like when a game makes me feel pressured to purchase things. It was fun while it lasted. Very addicting game. Wish there were more opportunities to earn coins, if there were, I would definitely have made more progress and had more fun.

you will have to spend money. it's pretty fun but I'm currently stuck on a level that is not possible to beat without purchasing powerups which require real money if you dont happen to have the coins saved. and you cant get anymore coins till you beat the level, so you end up stuck until you give in and spend money, or decide to quit the game

I love the game and the different side puzzles and matches. But some level are ridiculously hard to pass. UPDATE: For some off the wall reason my Gardenescapes team and game was out of the blue the data was removed with no warning of the reason of why and I had to uninstall and reinstall the game just to start all the way back over after YEARS of hard work and dedication, just gone. With no answers as to why it even happened in the first place!! Not Happy At All!!

With the latest update a change was introduced that can only be interpreted as maximisation of ingame transacations: previously you were able to reset a level if the bonuses were placed unfavourable to you. now you cannot do that anymore. making you lose levels and pushing you to spend more real money on coins. There is no other interpretation to the change. I recently spent 99 euros on the biggest available package (I shouldn't have). when that is gone I'm out. this is inexcusable.

All of the ads for this game, are of a problem-solving minigame, which you will barely encounter. Too bad, as that's the part I liked. This game is otherwise nothing, but a boring Match 3, with far too much text. The game to reward ratio is abysmally low. I deleted this after 30 minutes. I will be avoiding Playrix, from here on out.

FUN!!!! Been playing for a little over a year, love it, very addictive. Glad you have provided players with bigger, more rewards, cause we all know it can become quite pricey to keep playing. Especially when you're only given 5 more "lives". You wouldn't care if they cost you only 900 or even 1200 coins each time you couldn't complete a level, but 2000, 3800, etc., no wonder you run out of coins so quickly....and then have to buy more. That's my only upset about this great game. July 2019👍👍👍

The game is fun at first. However at certain point it isn't possible to beat levels without powerups. You can get free powerups by waiting, but if you want to play this game every day, instead of waiting, this is not for you. Also, the minigames are a scam for advertising purposes. They have no relation to the plot or game mechanics. I don't mind because I downloaded the game before the minigames were added. But if you came for minigames, this is a waste of your time.

Great game, Im past level 800 and so far this game has been really great for being free, I havent had to spend a single dime to enjoy it and its not super difficult, I mean some levels are very challenging but not so challenging that you just get fustrated and do not want to play it. Also with each event and extra like the daily spin if you are really on a difficult level it helps out. There is so much to do with the garden and more with each update that I always want to open a new section and see whats next. I have recommended it for others because its relaxing and they too find it addictive. I must say I dont usually play a lot of games on my cellular device but since I got this one I do more now than ever.

I used to enjoy this game, but not anymore. It cheats you out of special pieces ex.: bombs or others from making combinations like you had no idea it didn't give you the piece. You also get stuck for days on levels that are supposedly not hard levels but are impossible to defeat without wasting money to buy special stuff and even then you don't pass it. I'm done with this app.

It's a decent game with a good concept behind it but once you get to the hundredth level and beyond it is WAY to time consuming to beat levels. Takes me about a full day or two to beat some of these levels (which they only give you one star for each, even harder levels!) so I lost interest fairly quickly as there is no way for me to do anything with the garden without stars and it takes me days to get even one at times. Real bummer.

Never played, never will. Installed the game purely to leave this review and will be uninstalling it immediately after. The advertisements for this game on other sites are genuinely disgusting and have put me off ever even considering trying this game. Judging by the reviews that were left by actual humans, the game wouldn't have been worth trying anyway.

I think my favorite part is that the ads are so misleading that even the pictures on the page for this game are false. It's a fun puzzle game I won't lie, but the difficulty just continually rises whether you're winning or not.... Again it's a fun game, but level progression is awful, and seems like it was honestly just designed to make you buy/spend coins

I originally gave this game 5 stars. After playing for some time now, my mind has changed. After reading all the other comments, I agree with most. It's really fun until it's not. 1st, if you're trying out the game for the mini games, don't waste your time. They are far and few between main games. My main complaint and the main for fewer stars is simple. The game creator is greedy. You rarely get all targets. They Always leave 1 so that you either have to pay or use 900 coins(REALLY GUYS!!!)

**Updated - After 3000+ levels, uninstalling because I'm tired of spending a week trying to pass a level that literally starts with no chance to pass without buying something. There's a difference between "challenging" and "unreasonably hard." Note to those who came to this game like I did - the ads for it where you pull the pin are a lie, this is a matching game like candy crush. I've kept playing anyway but after several hundred levels, I've never once played a pull-the-pin game.

This game is similar to other Candy Crush matching games with its own unique challenges. There are some challenging levels that can take days to solve but it's great that you can get unlimited lives after passing one of the hard levels and not have to hope you will spin it on the wheel. The storyline is cute and the graphics really show a lot of time and energy goes into the details. Only disappointment is the ads showed more than just the matching objects and haven't seen it yet. Great game!

I rated the game previously and am only updating on my comment. It is such a pity that creators of the game take no heed to their players complaints. More then 50% of us mention the diffuculty of levels and progression to levels plus winning of stars and and and! Buying lives or boosters are way too expensive! Even the "bonus" levels are difficult. I seldom pass level 3...poor dog...Do something about our complaints please!!!!

Would be a five star rating, even though it's not as advertised, IF it was not nearly impossible to beat levels. I am very good at these type of strategy games and quite frankly have ran out of levels on several. But this game is rediculous! I am honestly on day five of one level! That has NEVER happend to me. Yall should fix this because I am about to delete this game and any others made by these game makers.

Game used to be great... Terrible now. They do new things all the time, and I wait 4 days for new levels. Would be good if the new adventures got you anything, but no coins appear in my account even when I find them on adventure levels...been playing for nearly 5 years, at level 10000 something, and am about to delete.

I actually enjoyed this game and Homescapes, but for some reason EVERY ad I get for this game has nothing to do with the actual gameplay of Gardenscapes. Most of the ads I see involve a puzzle where the player has to free a man- obviously not Gardenscapes at all. There needs to be better standards of quality for mobile game ads, this is obviously aimed at children seeing the false ad and following the link to install a game that they assume is going to be what the ad showed them.

Developers never address the "bait and switch" advertising. I expected a different game but ended up liking the game anyway. Modern version of Candy Crush with a decorating game included. Never buy boosters or coins on any game. Join a team to get free lives. If you can't pass a level sit out the game for a few days. I guarantee when you return you will pass the level. I always get complementary coins and boosters. I am passed level 1800 without spending money. My favorite game right now.

I'm gonna try to be fair with this review, because I honestly gave the game a shot. I will give a TL;DR at bottom. ----- SUMMARY OF ASPECTS: PROS: >The game can be relaxing >The decorating can be enjoyable >It has some puzzle aspects to it (pull the pins, like in the ads*) -- which is why I downloaded it CONS: >The VAST MAJORITY of the game plays (as some other reviews said) as another freaking "match 3" -- this is NOT what I wanted.* -- the pin pulls, which I primarily wanted, are few and far in-between >There comes a point where the random generation of matchable items is too poor for the complexity of the map -- that is, it generates too few matches while constantly increasing the background mapping difficulty ->This has little, if anything, to do with the game's puzzle aspect, or even the matching aspect; by making tiles no longer break or reveal on the first match, there is an artificial increase in the difficulty of subsequent levels. -->This, compounded with the random generation nature of the sliders, creates the unfortunate situation where the maximum allowed moves regularly gets exceeded through no fault of the player --->This issue is particularly bad, because it propagates the next 3 complaints >Failing to complete the level in the maximum moves does not simply mean a restart -- you have 5 lives, before you simply cannot play anymore, until they restore (over time) >Should you want to complete the level, by adding a couple more moves, you must use GOLD/COINS (I think y'all see where this is going...) >Despite what the page link says, I played for a couple hours, and I do not remember seeing ANY ads in-game... NOR AN OPTION TO GET BOOSTERS OR COINS FROM ADS >Let's expand from a few points prior: ->The nature of the game is primarily match-3, NOT a puzzle. ->The nature of a match-3 is primarily a pre-configured map with randomized tile generation. ->Randomization limits a player's ability to play based on _skill_ -- this is particularly true of puzzle or puzzle-like games, as opposed to reaction-oriented or predictive gameplay. ->Failing a match-3 level uses up lives, which take time to restore ->Match-3 "crutches" tend to be destructive "boosters" ->In this game, there does not appear to be a way to collect these boosters WITHOUT PAYING REAL MONEY, unless you want to spend REALLY long amounts of time and hoping for decent random events (like from the daily wheel thing) This creates the BIGGEST PROBLEM POSSIBLE with a mobile game: It is "pay-to-win or wait-and-suffer". You cannot _reasonably_ continue through the game extensively without spending real money. Paired with the fact that this game is primarily rehashed from the other 9001 games like it, and compound that issue with the fact the game does not _REWARD_ you for making the purchase (pseudo-necessity, as opposed to operative and optional investment) ----- >TL;DR: -The concept of the game is... mediocre and rehashed, at best. -It does NOT allow a truly free progression through the game under normal (see: average, predictable) circumstances, even through ad rewards. -The advertisements are misleading, though not completely false. -The "pay-to-win" strategy does not pair well with ANY game, LET ALONE a game that's supposed to focus on decoration, puzzles, and arcade-style play.

By solving "match-3" candy crush puzzles you win stars which you can use to repair and beautify your own garden.  If you like match-3 and want to have your own garden, maybe you'll like this game.  Pros:  * You can choose your own furniture, mailboxes, etc. * Colorful graphics and smooth gameplay  Neutral:  * Maybe you will like the butler, maybe not.  He interacts with you.  "It's all thanks to you, Tom!"  Or "Tom, look at the squirrels!"  I personally didn't like the butler.  He talked too much, and I felt like he was treating me as a kid or as a very close friend, not as his boss.  * The tutorials / hand-holding were annoying because they constantly interrupted the game  Cons:  * You cannot choose where to put your furniture, mailboxes, etc.  You can only choose what they look like * No undo button.  If you accidentally make a wrong move, you're stuck with it
